title: Pork Bolognese Pasta Casserole
subtitle: with Mozzarella Cheese and Spinach

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably ovenproof, pan over medium-high heat. Add pork and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and Tuscan Heat Spice.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir marinara sauce, milk, and 1 TBSP butter into pan. Bring to a boil, then stir in as many chili flakes as you like and half the spinach (all the spinach for 4 servings). (TIP: If you want more veggies, stir in all the spinach.) Cook, stirring, until spinach wilts, 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Stir drained penne into sauce
instructions_json.body: Stir drained penne into sauce. Taste and season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish.) Evenly sprinkle with mozzarella and panko. Top with a large drizzle of olive oil.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Bake penne mixture until panko is browned and crispy, 12-15 minutes. Divide between plates and serve.

title: Pork and Poblano Tacos
subtitle: with Kiwi Salsa and Lime Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Core, deseed, and finely chop poblano. Finely dice tomato. Peel and finely dice kiwi. Roughly chop cilantro leaves and stems. Cut lime into wedges.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine sour cream and a squeeze of lime juice. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper. In a medium bowl, toss together tomato, kiwi, minced onion, half the cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add poblano, sliced onion, and half the Mexican Spice. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly charred, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add pork, another large drizzle of oil, and remaining Mexican Spice to pan. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until pork is browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat under pan to medium low. TIP: If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir in stock concentrate, ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4 servings), and tomato paste. Cook, stirring, until everything is coated in a thick sauce, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds. Divide pork filling, salsa, and crema between tortillas. Sprinkle with remaining cilantro. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: Figgy Balsamic Pork
subtitle: with Roasted Green Beans and Rosemary Potatoes

instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Halve, peel, and finely chop shallot. Strip rosemary leaves from stems; chop leaves until you have 2 tsp (4 tsp for 4 servings). Halve potatoes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil, half the chopped rosemary, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Arrange cut sides down. Roast on top rack, tossing halfway through, until tender and crisped, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat pork dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add pork and sear, turning occasionally, until browned all over, 4-8 minutes. Transfer to one side of a second baking sheet.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Toss green beans with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper on opposite side of baking sheet from pork. Roast on middle rack until pork is cooked through and green beans are tender, 10-12 minutes. Let pork rest a few minutes after removing from oven, then cut crosswise into thin slices.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in pan used for pork over medium heat. Add shallot and remaining chopped rosemary. Cook, stirring, until softened, about 1 minute. Stir in stock concentrate, vinegar, 1 TBSP jam (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4). Simmer until thick and saucy, 2-3 minutes. Remove pan from heat and stir in 1 TBSP butter until melted. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide potatoes, green beans, and pork between plates. Drizzle pan sauce over pork and serve.

title: Tuscan Sausage and Pepper Spaghetti
subtitle: with Tomatoes and Parmesan

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Core, deseed, and thinly slice bell pepper. Mince parsley leaves and stems. Remove sausage from casings; discard casings.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, bell pepper, and half the Tuscan Heat Spice. Cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add sausage and another drizzle of oil to pan. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once sausage is cooked through, add diced tomatoes to pan. Season with salt, pepper, and remaining Tuscan Heat Spice. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and let simmer while spaghetti cooks. After you’ve drained spaghetti, stir stock concentrate and ¾ cup reserved pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings) into pan. Continue simmering until slightly reduced, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Add spaghetti to pan; toss to coat
instructions_json.body: Add spaghetti to pan; toss to coat. (For 4 servings, carefully transfer everything into pot used for pasta.) Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4), half the parsley, and half the Parmesan. (TIP: If pasta seems dry, add more reserved pasta cooking water as needed.) Season with salt and pepper. Divide between bowls and sprinkle with remaining parsley and Parmesan.

title: Chicken Sausage & Spinach Ravioli
subtitle: Dinner’s Just 20 Minutes Away!

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato. Quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites, sausage, and Italian Seasoning. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until sausage is browned and scallions are softened, 3-5 minutes (sausage will finish cooking in step 4). Stir in tomato and cook until just softened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, gently add ravioli to pot. Reduce to a low simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente and floating to the top, 4-5 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain. TIP: Gently shake strainer with ravioli in it to remove as much moisture as possible.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir stock concentrate, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a small splash of reserved pasta cooking water into pan with sausage mixture. Cook over low heat until sausage is cooked through, scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pan, 1-2 minutes. Stir in sour cream and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved cooking water a splash at a time until sauce reaches a creamy consistency.

instructions_json.title: Carefully stir ravioli into pan with sauce
instructions_json.body: Carefully stir ravioli into pan with sauce. Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice to taste.

instructions_json.title: Divide ravioli mixture between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide ravioli mixture between bowls. Garnish with scallion greens. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Italian Chicken over Lemony Spaghetti
subtitle: Lightning Prep

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch-thick pieces. Mince garlic. Zest and quarter lemon (for 4 servings, zest 1 lemon and quarter both).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water, then drain. Keep empty pot handy for use in step 5.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 4-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While zucchini cooks, pat chicken dry with paper towels and season all over with Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Once zucchini is done, heat a large drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest. Once cool enough to handle, slice chicken crosswise.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in pot used for spaghetti over medium-high heat. Add garlic, half the lemon zest, and a pinch of chili flakes. Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir in ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water (¾ cup for 4 servings), stock concentrate, and juice from half the lemon. Simmer until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add spaghetti, zucchini, sour cream, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) to sauce; toss to coat. Add half the Parmesan; season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved cooking water a splash at a time until pasta is thoroughly coated in sauce.) Divide between bowls and top with chicken. Top with remaining Parmesan and lemon zest, and a pinch of chili flakes if desired. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Sesame Beef Tacos
subtitle: with Quick-Pickled Veggies and Chili Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Trim and slice radishes and cucumber into thin rounds. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Pick cilantro leaves from stems; discard stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine radishes, cucumber, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt and pepper. Taste and add a pinch more sugar if you like a sweeter pickle. Set aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine sour cream and a pinch of chili flakes (taste and add more from there if desired; save a little for the filling). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add scallions and cabbage; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Add beef, garlic powder, and 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings). Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Stir in sesame oil, a pinch of chili flakes to taste, half the sriracha, and half the soy sauce. (For 4, use all the soy sauce.) Taste and season with salt, pepper, and up to ½ tsp more sugar.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While filling cooks, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread a bit of crema onto each tortilla, then top with filling, a small amount of pickled veggies, cilantro, and as much remaining sriracha and chili flakes as you like. Serve with any remaining pickled veggies on the side.

title: Baked Mac ’n’ Cheese Dinner Two Ways
subtitle: Keep It Simple with Garlic Crostini + Mix It Up with Honey-Mustard Kale Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince garlic. Slice baguette crosswise into 8-10 rounds (16-20 rounds for 4 servings). Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces.In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine minced garlic, 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4), and a pinch of salt. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and microwave until butter has melted and garlic is fragrant, 30-60 seconds. Stir and set aside (you’ll use it in Step 5).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add cavatappi to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Drain and return to pot.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, in a large pan, whisk together cream sauce base and 1 cup water (2 cups for 4 servings) over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and add cream cheese, stock concentrate, and garlic powder.Cook, whisking, until cream cheese is fully incorporated and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes.Remove from heat. Whisk in cheddar and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) until smooth, 1-2 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Transfer cheese sauce to pot with drained cavatappi; stir to combine. Lightly coat an 8-by-8-inch baking dish (9-by-13-inch baking dish for 4 servings) with nonstick cooking spray. Transfer mac ’n’ cheese to prepared baking dish.In a second small bowl, combine panko, 1 tsp oil (1½ tsp for 4), salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Evenly sprinkle mac ’n’ cheese with seasoned panko. TIP: Not sure if everyone loves a crunchy topping? Leave it off or just sprinkle it over half the dish. Bake on top rack until browned and crispy, 12-15 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, arrange baguette rounds on a baking sheet and brush with garlic butter. Toast on middle rack until golden brown, 5-8 minutes.Top crostini with tomato. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Place kale in a large bowl with a large drizzle of olive oil and a big pinch of salt. Using your hands, massage kale (similar to how you would knead dough) until leaves are tender, 1 minute. TIP: Don’t skip this step—massaging helps the kale leaves wilt slightly, giving them a tender (not fibrous!) texture.Add dressing; toss to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Keep It Simple: Divide mac ’n’ cheese between bowls. Serve with crostini.Mix It Up: Divide mac ’n’ cheese between plates and drizzle with hot sauce to taste. Top kale salad with walnuts and serve on the side.

title: One-Pot Ravioli Bake
subtitle: with Spinach, Thyme, and Parmesan Breadcrumbs

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat broiler to high or oven to 500 degrees. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Strip thyme leaves off stems (you’ll want about 1½ TBSP). Discard stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat 2 TBSP butter in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat. Add thyme and onions, and cook until softened, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add stock concentrates and 2½ cups water, and bring to a simmer.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add ravioli to pan, cover, and cook 3-4 minutes. Uncover and increase heat to high. Spoon broth over ravioli until they're tender and broth is thickened and reduced, 5-6 minutes. If broth evaporates before ravioli are tender, add a splash of water. To keep ravioli from sticking, shake pan occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine panko, Parmesan cheese, a large drizzle of olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Remove pan from heat
instructions_json.body: Remove pan from heat. Carefully fold sour cream and spinach into ravioli until thoroughly combined with broth. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: You should have a thick, creamy sauce and wilted spinach. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of water.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: If you're not using an ovenproof pan, transfer mixture to baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan breadcrumbs, and broil until golden brown, 2-3 minutes.

title: Hoisin-Glazed Meatballs
subtitle: with Jasmine Rice and Green Beans

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Wash and dry all produce. Peel and mince ginger until you have ½ TBSP (1 TBSP for 4 servings). Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; mince whites.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings) and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then stir in rice, cover, and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a medium bowl, combine beef, panko, minced ginger, scallion whites, garlic powder, and 2 TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4) and pepper. Form into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheet. Bake until meatballs are browned and cooked through, 15-18 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a second medium bowl, combine hoisin and 2 TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Once meatballs are cooked through, carefully transfer to bowl with hoisin mixture; toss to coat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green beans and cook, stirring, 3 minutes. Add 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4 servings) and cover pan with a lid or aluminum foil. Cook until tender, 2-3 minutes more. Uncover and let water evaporate. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Zest and quarter lime. instructions_json.title: Step 3

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add carrots and scallion whites; cook, stirring occasionally, until carrots begin to soften, 2-3 minutes. instructions_json.title: Step 4

title: Tuscan Chicken & Pepper Spaghetti
subtitle: with Tomato Sauce & Parmesan

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Mince parsley.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, bell pepper, and half the Tuscan Heat Spice (you’ll use the rest later). Cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.title: Step 6

Meanwhile, trim, peel, and halve carrots lengthwise; cut into ¼-inch-thick half-moons. Halve and peel onion; thinly slice one half. appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

Return to top rack and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes. While nachos broil, empty contents of salad kit into a large bowl and toss to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 7

Fluff rice with a fork; stir in beans and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Top nachos with tomato, pickled onion (draining first), creamy guac, and cilantro. Serve family style with rice and beans, salad, and remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: XL Zucchini “Lasagna” with Beef Ragù
subtitle: 2x the portions for family dinner or leftovers

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ½-inch pieces. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Arrange half the coated zucchini planks in a single layer on the bottom of an 8-by-8-inch baking dish (for 8 servings, use a 9-by-13-inch baking dish or two 8-by-8-inch baking dishes).Spread half the cheese mixture in an even layer over zucchini, then top with one-third of the remaining Italian cheese blend and half the ragù. appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork; cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. title: Rib-Eye Steak with Garlic-Sage Gravy
subtitle: plus Mashed Sweet Potatoes, Candied Pecans & Brussels Sprouts

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Arrange rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice sweet potatoes into ½-inch pieces.Place sweet potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 10-12 minutes. Reserve ½ cup sweet potato cooking liquid, then drain and return sweet potatoes to pot. Cover to keep warm until ready to mash in Step 5.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While sweet potatoes cook, trim and halve Brussels sprouts (quarter any larger sprouts). Peel and mince or grate garlic. Pick sage leaves from stems and mince.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until golden brown and tender, 15-20 minutes. TIP: Tent sprouts with foil to keep warm until ready to serve. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add 2 TBSP water, brown sugar, ¼ tsp cinnamon, and a pinch of salt (4 TBSP water and ½ tsp cinnamon for 4 servings); whisk to combineStir in pecans and cook, stirring constantly, until pecans are fragrant and glazed, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Pat turkey* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat turkey* dry with paper towels. Season all over with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for pecans over medium-high heat. instructions_json.title: Step 5

instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, pat pork* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.body: On opposite side of sheet from pork, toss green beans with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. title: Lemon Sumac Tabbouleh & Rib-Eye Steak
subtitle: Bring elevated, restaurant-style flavors to your kitchen

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine bulgur, 1 cup water, and ½ tsp salt (2 cups water and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until water has absorbed and bulgur is tender, 12-15 minutes. Turn off heat. Drain off any excess water, then fluff bulgur with a fork. Transfer to a large bowl; season with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use in Step 5.

instructions_json.title: While bulgur cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While bulgur cooks, wash and dry produce. Gently crush crispy fried onions in their bag. Zest and quarter lemon. Pick parsley and mint from stems; discard stems and thinly slice leaves. Thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Reserve 1 tsp Turkish Spice Blend (2 tsp for 4 servings) for Step 4.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium heatproof bowl, combine crispy fried onions, remaining Turkish Spice Blend, harissa powder, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Heat 3 TBSP oil (6 TBSP for 4) in a large pan over medium heat. Once bubbling hot, carefully pour over bowl with spice mix and stir to combine. Set aside until ready to serve, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Pat lamb chops* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat lamb chops* dry with paper towels. Season all over with reserved Turkish Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for chili crisp oil over medium-high heat. Add lamb and cook to desired doneness, 2-4 minutes per side. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches. If lamb begins to brown too quickly, reduce heat to medium. Transfer lamb to a plate to rest.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, whisk together 1 TBSP olive oil, lemon zest, juice from half the lemon, sumac, ¼ tsp sugar, salt, and pepper (2 TBSP olive oil and ½ tsp sugar for 4 servings). To bowl with bulgur, add parsley, mint, scallion whites, and tomato. Toss with lemon sumac dressing. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Toast and quarter pitas
instructions_json.body: Toast and quarter pitas. Spread hummus and tzatziki over plates. Place lamb chops and tabbouleh over sauces. Top lamb with chili crisp and scallion greens. Serve with remaining lemon wedges and pitas on the side for dipping.

title: Tuscan Herb Sirloin Steak & Lobster Tails
subtitle: Bring elevated, restaurant-style flavors to your kitchen

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Grate Parmesan using a zester or on the smallest holes of a box grater. Roughly chop parsley. Strip rosemary leaves from stems; finely chop leaves. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces if necessary. Halve, core, and thinly slice pear. Crumble goat cheese. In a small bowl, combine panko, half the Parmesan, a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Place 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) in a separate small microwave-safe bowl; microwave in 10-second bursts until softened (not melted). Stir in garlic powder.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Using kitchen shears, cut along underside of each lobster* shell, leaving meat intact and stopping at tail. Pull sides of shell apart to expose meat (do not remove meat from shell). TIP: If the sides aren’t pulling apart easily, it’s OK! You can still season and cook the lobsters without fully opening the shells.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Cut two 10-inch-long pieces of foil (four pieces for 4 servings); place on a flat work surface. Set one lobster tail, cut side up, in the center of each piece of foil. Top each with ½ TBSP garlic butter. Wrap foil up and around lobsters, pinching to tightly seal. Place on one side of a baking sheet (arrange across entire sheet for 4). On empty side of sheet, toss artichokes with remaining Parmesan, a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper; top with panko mixture. (For 4, toss artichokes on a second baking sheet.)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Roast lobsters and artichoke gratin on top rack until lobsters are tender and cooked through and gratin is browned and crispy, 10-15 minutes (for 4 servings, roast lobsters on top rack and gratin on middle rack). TIP: Carefully open the foil packets to check that lobsters are fully cooked! The shell and meat should be red. If lobsters need more time, reseal and return to oven until fully cooked. Once lobsters are done, carefully open packets to prevent overcooking.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat steak* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak; cook until browned and cooked to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board to rest for 5 minutes. In a third small bowl, whisk together parsley, rosemary, half the anchovy paste, 3 TBSP olive oil, salt, and pepper (all the anchovy paste and 6 TBSP olive oil for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, combine kale, pear, walnuts, half the goat cheese, and as much dressing as you like. Toss until evenly coated. Slice steak against the grain and divide between plates along with lobsters, artichoke gratin, and salad. Top steak with sauce; top salad with remaining goat cheese. Serve.

title: Umami Tomato Spaghetti with Steak
subtitle: plus Toasted Ciabatta

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Mince cilantro stems and finely chop leaves. Zest and quarter lemon.

instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, adjust rack to top position and set oven to high broil. Wash and dry produce. Cut each tortilla into six equal pieces (make this easier by stacking the tortillas, then cutting them all at once). Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Quarter limes. Drain and rinse beans. Dice tomato. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss tortillas on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper; spread out in a single layer. Broil on top rack until crisped and browned, 2-4 minutes. (TIP: Broil in batches if necessary and watch closely to avoid burning!) Transfer chips to a plate to cool. Carefully line the same baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside until Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine onion, juice from half the limes, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 1 minute. Keep covered, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve. In a separate small bowl, combine guacamole, sour cream, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef*; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. In the last 2 minutes of cooking, add Tex-Mex paste, ½ tsp sugar, 2 TBSP water, and a pinch of salt (1 tsp sugar and 4 TBSP water for 4 servings); cook, stirring, until sauce is fully incorporated.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: On prepared baking sheet, layer half the chips, half the beef, half the Mexican cheese blend, and half the queso blanco. Repeat layering with remaining chips, remaining beef, remaining Mexican cheese blend, and remaining queso blanco. TIP: Cut a small corner of queso package to neatly pipe the cheese onto nachos. Return to top rack and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes. While nachos broil, empty contents of salad kit into a large bowl and toss to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Transfer beans to a second large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave until warmed through, 30-60 seconds. Fluff rice with a fork; stir in beans and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Top nachos with tomato, pickled onion (draining first), creamy guac, and cilantro. Serve family style with rice and beans, salad, and remaining lime wedges on the side.

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with oil. Wash and dry produce. Gather into a tight bundle and squeeze over the sink to remove as much liquid as possible.Drain corn, then pat dry with paper towels. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and softened, 3-4 minutes. Once corn and zucchini filling is done, add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create flautas.Place flautas, seam sides down, on prepared sheet. TIP: Arrange your flautas snug on the sheet to keep them from unrolling.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Bake flautas on top rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Drain and rinse corn; dry thoroughly with paper towels. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a large bowl, combine beef*, panko, Mexican Spice Blend, cheddar, salt (we used ½ tsp; 1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper.Form into 10-12 1½-inch meatballs (20-24 meatballs for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place meatballs on one side of a lightly oiled baking sheet (for 4 servings, spread meatballs out across entire sheet). Toss zucchini on empty side of sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, toss zucchini on a second sheet; roast meatballs on middle rack and zucchini on top rack, swapping rack positions halfway through.)Roast on top rack until meatballs are cooked through and zucchini is browned and tender, 12-14 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6

title: Mongolian Khuushuur Organic Turkey Pockets
subtitle: with Spicy Tomato Sauce & Cabbage Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Sprinkle 2 TBSP flour (3 TBSP for 4 servings) over a clean work surface. Remove dough from packaging and cut in half (cut both balls of dough in half for 4).Roll each piece in flour to lightly coat, shaking any excess back onto work surface, adding 1 to 2 TBSP more flour as needed. TIP: If you want to bake the meat pockets instead of frying, preheat oven to 450 with a rack in the top position.Cover dough with a clean kitchen towel and let rest at room temperature for 15 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Halve, peel, and dice onion. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Peel and mince or grate garlic.In a medium bowl, combine coleslaw mix, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, salt, and pepper (2 tsp sugar for 4 servings).Set aside, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes.Add beef* and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until starting to brown, 3-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add half the garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture is fragrant and beef is cooked through, 1-2 minutes more. TIP: If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.Transfer beef to a medium bowl. Wash and thoroughly dry pan.In a medium bowl combine cabbage, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, salt, and pepper (2 tsp sugar for 4).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 15 minutes, lightly dust a clean work surface with flour. Using a rolling pin, roll each piece of dough into a rough circle (you’ll be shaping them again later, so no need to be perfect!). Set aside to rest, 15 minutes more.Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a small pot over medium heat. Add ginger and remaining garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds.Add crushed tomatoes, Sriracha, half the cumin (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, 1-3 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 15 minutes, stretch each dough circle into a larger circle, about 8 inches wide.Place filling on bottom half of each dough circle, leaving a ½-inch border along the edges. Using a brush or your finger, swipe a bit of water around the border. Fold dough over filling and gently press edges together (try your best not to seal in any pockets of air). Using a fork, press along edges to seal.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In same pan used for the filling, heat ⅓-inch layer of oil over medium heat. Once oil is hot enough that a pinch of flour sizzles when added to pan, working one at a time, use a slotted spoon to carefully add beef pockets. Fry until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side (lower heat if browning too quickly).Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate and season with salt. TIP: Prefer to bake the pockets? Arrange on a baking sheet; bake on top rack until golden brown, 13-18 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Divide beef pockets and cabbage salad between plates. Serve with spicy tomato sauce on the side.Divide beef pockets and cabbage salad between plates. Serve with spicy tomato sauce on the side.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add linguine to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add linguine to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To pan with veggie mixture, stir in garlic powder until evenly incorporated.Add lemongrass puree and ¾ cup reserved pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings); bring to a simmer, then add pork*. title: Bulgogi Shepherd's Pie with Organic Turkey
subtitle: topped with White Cheddar Mashed Potatoes

instructions_json.title: Heat broiler to high
instructions_json.body: Heat broiler to high. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Place potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid (¾ cup for 4 servings), then drain potatoes and return to pot. Mash with sour cream and 1 tbsp butter (2 tbsp for 4) until smooth and creamy, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed. Season with salt and pepper. Keep mashed potatoes covered off heat until ready to use in Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While potatoes cook, trim, peel, and dice carrots into ¼-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably ovenproof, pan (use a large, preferably ovenproof, pan for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add carrots and onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are just tender, 5-7 minutes. (TIP: If veggies begin to brown too quickly, add a splash of water.)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add turkey* to pan with veggies and season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Add flour; cook, stirring, until thoroughly combined, 1 minute. Stir in ½ cup plain water (1 cup water for 4 servings), bulgogi sauce, and peas. Bring to a boil; cook until mixture is very thick, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish now.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Top turkey filling with an even layer of mashed potatoes, leaving a gap around the edge of the pan. Sprinkle with cheddar.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Broil on top rack until cheese is melted and brown, 3-4 minutes. TIP: Watch carefully to avoid burning. Serve shepherd’s pie family style directly from pan.

title: Broccoli Cheddar & Chicken Sausage Pinwheels
subtitle: with Ranch & Marinara Dips

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4 servings) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging; place on prepared sheet and roll to coat all over with oil. Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, roughly chop broccoli into small pieces. Bring cream cheese to room temperature. TIP: Place cream cheese packet in a glass of warm water to speed up the process!

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, carefully press and stretch each dough ball into a rough rectangle. TIP: Our rectangles were approximately 8-by-12 inches. The dough is stretchy and the shapes won't be perfect—that's OK!Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make the next step easier!).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes more, reshape each piece into a rough rectangle by gently pulling the corners. Evenly spread cream cheese on dough pieces, then sprinkle with cheddar, leaving a 1½-inch border at top (one of the short edges). Top with broccoli in a single layer.Gently roll up each piece of dough, starting with bottom short edge, to form a log. Carefully transfer, seam sides down, to a cutting board.

title: Pan-Seared Szechuan Beef Tacos
subtitle: with Pickled Red Cabbage Slaw, Sriracha Mayo & Crispy Onions

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise with Sriracha. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine vinegar, half the ginger paste (you’ll use the rest in the next step), ¼ cup water, 2 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt (½ cup water and 4 tsp sugar for 4 servings). Stir in cabbage; microwave for about 1 minute. Stir and set aside to pickle until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

Form beef mixture into 6 2-inch meatballs (12 meatballs for 4 servings). Arrange tortillas on a clean work surface; place a meatball in the center of each tortilla. Working one at a time, cover each meatball with a piece of plastic wrap and flatten out with the palm of your hand until meat almost reaches edges of tortilla. TIP: Reuse the plastic wrap as you go!

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium heat. Working in batches, carefully add tortillas, meat sides down, to pan (we were able to fit two tortillas at a time). Cook until beef is browned and almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Flip and cook until tortillas are toasted and beef is cooked through, 30-60 seconds more. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined baking sheet. Cover with foil to keep warm. Repeat with remaining tortillas, adding another drizzle of oil to pan between batches. TIP: If pan gets too hot during the last batches, lower the heat.

instructions_json.title: Drain slaw; stir in half the sesame seeds

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine jalapeño, vinegar, 1 tbsp water, 1 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt (2 tbsp water and 2 tsp sugar for 4 servings). title: Baja Cod Tacos
subtitle: with Slaw, Chipotle Mayo & Pickled Veggies

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Zest and quarter lime (for 4 servings, zest one lime and quarter both). Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Thinly slice radishes. Roughly chop cilantro. In a small bowl, combine red pepper crema, mayonnaise, lime zest to taste, and chipotle powder to taste. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine jalapeño, radishes, juice from half the lime, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Microwave for 30 seconds. Set aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve. In a medium bowl, combine cabbage, half the cilantro, juice from remaining lime, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4), salt, pepper, and remaining lime zest to taste.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, whisk together tempura batter mix, half the Blackening Spice, ⅓ cup cold water, and ½ tsp salt (⅔ cup cold water and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings) until smooth. TIP: If mixture is too thick, add more water 1 TBSP at a time until it reaches a pancake-batter-like consistency.Pat tilapia* dry with paper towels, then slice into strips (ours were about 1 inch wide). Season all over with remaining Blackening Spice, salt, and pepper.Stir strips into batter until evenly coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a ¼-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat.Once oil is hot enough that a drop of batter sizzles when added to the pan, add coated fish in a single layer, working in batches. (Shake off excess batter before adding.) Cook until golden brown and cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. TIP: To check for doneness, cut one strip in half.Using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate. Immediately season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide tortillas between plates; fill with slaw (draining first) and fried tilapia.Top with chipotle mayo, remaining cilantro, and pickled jalapeño and radishes (draining first) to taste. Serve.

title: Corn, Black Bean & Turkey Taco Salad Cups
subtitle: with Mexican Cheeses & Sour Cream

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 400 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Drain corn. Halve lime. title: Cheesy Kimchi Organic Beef Pasta Bake
subtitle: with Penne, Gochujang Sauce & Cheesy Panko Topping

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ¼-inch pieces. Core, deseed, and dice green pepper into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Add onion and green pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are browned and softened, 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat. Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (2 cups for 4 servings), then drain. (Reserve pot for use in the next step!)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While veggies cook, place 1 tbsp butter (2 tbsp for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl; microwave until melted, 30 seconds. Stir in panko and half the chili flakes (all for 4). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In pot used for pasta, melt 1 tbsp butter (2 tbsp for 4 servings) over medium heat. Add tomato paste, garlic powder, and gochujang. Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds. Stir in cream sauce base and ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (½ cup for 4); bring to a simmer, stirring frequently. Turn off heat; stir in cheddar until melted. Stir in drained pasta, cooked beef and veggies, and kimchi. (TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time until desired consistency is reached.) Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Transfer pasta to an 8-by-8-inch baking dish (9-by-13-inch baking dish for 4 servings). Sprinkle with seasoned panko.Bake on top rack until panko is browned and sauce is bubbly, 10-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta bake between plates or serve family style directly from baking dish.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain.

Transfer chicken to a second plate and cover with foil to keep warm. (Reserve pan.)

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.Heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium heat. Add scallion whites and garlic; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.Add miso sauce concentrates, pork ramen stock concentrate, half the Sriracha, ½ cup cold water, and a pinch of sugar (all the Sriracha and ¾ cup cold water for 4 servings); bring to a simmer. title: Lemon-Parmesan Gluten-Free Linguine & Steak
subtitle: with Fresh Pasta, Brussels, Spicy Almonds & Scallions

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise; lay flat and thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Zest and quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter in a large pan over medium-high heat. (For 4 servings, use 2 TBSP butter and a large high-sided pan or Dutch oven.) (TIP: Be sure to include any butter as well!) Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in pan used for almonds over medium-high heat. Add Brussels sprouts; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and slightly softened, 3-5 minutes.Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 30-60 seconds more. TIP: Add another drizzle of olive oil if pan seems dry.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add linguine to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add linguine to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 1-3 minutes.Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (2 cups for 4 servings), then drain.Once linguine is drained, return pan with Brussels sprouts to stovetop over medium heat. Add cream sauce base and ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4). Cook, stirring, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To pan with sauce, add scallion greens, lemon zest, drained linguine, half the Parmesan, 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and a big squeeze of lemon juice. Toss until butter has melted and pasta is coated in a creamy sauce, about 1 minute. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time.Taste and season with salt and pepper. Add more lemon juice if desired.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between bowls. Top with spicy almonds (and any leftover butter!) and remaining Parmesan. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges on the side.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti linguini to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water, then drain and set aside.

instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, stir crushed tomatoes, stock concentrate, and 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings) into pan with sausage. Season generously with salt (we used ½ tsp; ¾ tsp for 4) and pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook until reduced, 5-7 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Stir sour cream and ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4 servings) into pan with sauce until melted and combined. Add zucchini and drained spaghetti linguini; toss to coat. title: Beef Spaghetti Bolognese
subtitle: with Zucchini Ribbons & Parmesan

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Peel and mince garlic. Trim ends from zucchini. Using a peeler, shave zucchini lengthwise into thin ribbons, rotating as you go, until you get to the seedy core; discard core.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, remove sausage* from casing if necessary; discard casing. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.Stir in garlic and Tuscan Heat Spice; cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add marinara to pan with sausage mixture, then reduce heat to medium. Simmer until flavors meld and sauce has slightly reduced, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Add drained spaghetti, ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (½ cup for 4 servings), and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) to pan with sauce. Toss to thoroughly combine.Separate zucchini ribbons with your hands, then stir into pasta until slightly softened, 1-2 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time until spaghetti is thoroughly coated in sauce.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between bowls; top with Parmesan and serve.

title: Melty Mozzarella, Beef & Zucchini Penne Bake
subtitle: Enjoy an abundant 3-course meal with a main, sides, and appetizers

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to middle and top positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. (TIP: Start with hot tap water for faster boiling.) Wash and dry produce. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick quarter-moons. Grate half the Parmesan. Halve baguettes lengthwise. Trim and discard root end from lettuce; chop leaves into bite-size pieces.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain. Keep empty pot handy for Step 4.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini, beef*, Italian Seasoning, garlic powder, a big pinch of salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until zucchini is tender and beef is cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove pan from heat. (If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.) Transfer beef mixture to pot used for pasta. Add marinara, tomato paste, stock concentrates, and ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (½ cup for 4 servings). Bring to a boil over medium-high heat; cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. TIP: If sauce seems too thick, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time. Remove pot from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add drained penne to pot with sauce; stir to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed. Transfer pasta mixture to a lightly oiled 8-by-8-inch baking dish (9-by-13-inch baking dish for 4 servings). Carefully dollop ricotta all over pasta and top with half the mozzarella. Bake, uncovered, on middle rack until cheese melts, 10-15 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Place garlic herb butter in a medium microwave-safe bowl; microwave until softened, 10-15 seconds. Stir in grated Parmesan, remaining mozzarella, half the dressing, and pepper. Evenly spread cut sides of baguettes with butter mixture. Place on a baking sheet and bake on top rack until cheese is browned, 10-15 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Once garlic bread is done, remove sheet from oven and increase oven temperature to broil. Transfer penne bake to top rack; broil until cheese is browned, 2-3 minutes more. TIP: Watch carefully to avoid burning. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: While penne bake cools, in a large bowl, toss together lettuce, croutons, and remaining dressing. Halve cheesy garlic bread on a diagonal. Transfer salad to a serving bowl; grate remaining Parmesan over top. Serve penne bake, salad, and cheesy garlic bread family style.

title: Zucchini Pomodoro Penne Bake
subtitle: with Mozzarella & Herbed Ricotta

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and dice half the onion (whole onion for 4 servings). Finely dice tomatoes. Trim zucchini, then grate on the largest holes of a box grater.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until almost al dente, 8 minutes (it’ll finish cooking in Step 6). Drain penne. (Keep empty pot handy for Step 5.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add diced onion, tomatoes, and a pinch of salt. instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot

instructions_json.title: Step 5

Cook, stirring, until tomatoes are softened, 2-4 minutes.Stir in half the chives and juice from half the lemon. Reduce heat to low, then stir in stock concentrate and ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (⅓ cup for 4).Whisk in crème fraîche; season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add zucchini, mushrooms, and drained penne to pan with sauce; stir to combine. Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until melted. TIP: If necessary, add more pasta cooking water a splash at a time until penne is coated in a creamy sauce. Divide pasta between bowls. Sprinkle with Parmesan and remaining chives. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Lemony Greek-Style Bavette Steak & Orzo Soup
subtitle: with Zesty Toasted Ciabatta

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Zest one lemon (two lemons for 4 servings); quarter lemons. Trim, peel, and dice carrot into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, combine lemon zest and 1 tbsp olive oil (2 tbsp for 4). Season with salt and pepper. Pat steak* dry with paper towels and season generously all over with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a medium pot (large pot for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add steak to pot and cook until browned but not yet cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a plate; set aside. (The steak will finish cooking later.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add carrot and scallion whites to pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until carrot begins to soften, 2-3 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add 2¾ cups water (4¼ cups for 4 servings) and stock concentrates to pot, stirring to combine. Bring to a boil. Once water is boiling, add orzo; stir. Return steak to pot. Cook until steak is cooked to desired doneness and orzo is tender, 5-7 minutes. (You’ll add more to the pot later.) While orzo and steak cook, halve and toast ciabatta.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, add eggs* and juice from lemons; whisk to combine. Once steak is cooked to desired doneness, transfer to a cutting board to rest; reduce heat under pot to medium low. Reserve ½ cup hot broth (1 cup for 4 servings). (It’s OK if there is some orzo or veggies in the reserved broth.) To bowl with egg and lemon mixture, slowly whisk in reserved hot broth. (This is called tempering and will help prevent the eggs from curdling when added to the hot soup.) While stirring soup in pot, slowly pour egg and broth mixture into pot. Cook, stirring constantly, until broth is creamy and thickened, 30-60 seconds more. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Halve toasted ciabatta on a diagonal
instructions_json.body: Halve toasted ciabatta on a diagonal. Brush with lemon zest oil to taste. Thinly slice steak against the grain. Divide soup between bowls and top with sliced steak. Garnish with scallion greens and drizzle with any remaining lemon zest oil to taste. Serve with zesty ciabatta on the side.

Flip and cook until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.body: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Halve, peel, and finely dice onion. Trim, peel, and finely dice carrots.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add orzo to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add orzo to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 7-10 minutes.Reserve ¼ cup pasta cooking water (½ cup for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While orzo cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add turkey* and season with salt and pepper. instructions_json.title: Step 4

Simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and sauce has thickened slightly, 10-12 minutes. TIP: If sauce becomes too thick, add a splash of reserved pasta cooking water.Stir in crème fraîche. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

Once sauce and pasta are done, in a large bowl, toss mixed greens wiith as much vinaigrette as you like.Grate half the Parmesan over salad.

title: One-Pan Orzo Marinara

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat broiler to high or oven to 500 degrees with rack in upper position. Halve, peel, and and finely chop onion. Measure out 1½ cups orzo (we sent more—save the rest for another use).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat (we recommend using an ovenproof pan). Add sausage and break meat up into pieces. Cook, tossing occasionally, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add another drizzle of olive oil to pan, then toss in onion, kale, and a big pinch of salt. Cook, tossing, until veggies are softened, about 5 minutes. Toss in 5 tsp Italian seasoning (save the last teaspoon for step 5) and a pinch of chili flakes if you like it spicy. Cook, tossing, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir orzo, tomatoes, 1¾ cups water, 1 tsp sugar, and a few big pinches of salt and pepper into pan. Lower heat to medium. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until orzo is al dente, 12-15 minutes. (TIP: If mixture dries out, add water ¼ cup at a time to loosen.) Remove pan from heat. Add Parmesan and 2 TBSP butter, stirring to melt. Season with salt and pepper. If your pan is not ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish at this point.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Place 1 TBSP butter in a small microwave-safe bowl and microwave until melted, about 20 seconds. Stir in 1 TBSP olive oil, panko, Italian cheese, and remaining Italian seasoning. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

instructions_json.title: Step 6

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Trim and discard bottom inch from asparagus, then cut stalks into 1-inch pieces. Thinly slice garlic. Pick leaves from tarragon and finely chop.

instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add gnocchi to pot. Cook until tender and floating, 4-5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside in a medium bowl. Add asparagus to pot cook until bright green, 1-2 minutes. Reserve ¼ cup cooking water, then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

title: Pillowy Gnocchi

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Toss squash on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of olive oil and 1/2 TBSP maple syrup. Season with salt and pepper. Roast until starting to brown, 20-25 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Trim Brussels sprouts, then cut in half through the stem. Slice halves into thin ribbons across the stems. Pick sage leaves from stems and thinly slice.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add Brussels sprouts, season generously with salt and pepper, and cook until softened and starting to brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place gnocchi in boiling water, and cook until tender, 3-4 minutes, or until they float. Drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While gnocchi cooks, add 2 TBSP butter and 1/2 TBSP maple syrup to pan over medium-high heat. Season generously with salt and pepper. Add sage and stir until butter turns foamy and begins to brown, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Toss cooked butternut squash and Brussels sprouts into pan with sauce. Gently add gnocchi, season with salt and pepper, and stir to combine.

title: Gnocchi Bolognese
subtitle: with Fresh Tomato Sauce, Carrots, and Parmesan Cheese

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Peel and grate the carrots with a box grater. Mince or grate the garlic. Halve, peel, and finely dice the onion. Grate the tomatoes with the box grater, discarding any remaining skins.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the ground beef. Cook, breaking up the meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, about 3-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from the pan, but don’t drain the oil.

instructions_json.title: Add the onion and carrots to the pan
instructions_json.body: Add the onion and carrots to the pan. Cook, tossing, for 2-3 minutes, until softened, adding a drizzle of olive oil if necessary. Add the garlic, oregano, chorizo spice, and 4 Tablespoons tomato paste. Cook, tossing, for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the garlic is fragrant and tomato paste has coated the vegetables.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Simmer the sauce: Add the grated tomatoes, chicken stock concentrates, and 2 cups water to the pan. Stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer for 7-10 minutes, until thickened. Add the ground beef during the last 3 minutes of simmering. Season generously with salt and pepper. Taste and adjust the flavor with 3-4 teaspoons sugar, if needed, to balance the acidity.

instructions_json.title: Add the gnocchi to the boiling water
instructions_json.body: Add the gnocchi to the boiling water. Boil 3-4 minutes, until tender. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the gnocchi to the pan with the sauce. Stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Finish and plate: Divide the gnocchi Bolognese between bowls, and sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

title: Mushroom Ravioli with Bacon, Kale & Walnuts
subtitle: in a Brown Butter Crème Fraîche Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Halve, peel, and thinly slice shallot. Remove and discard any large stems from half the kale (all for 4 servings); thinly slice leaves. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add shallot and cook until slightly softened, 1-2 minutes.Add kale and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until tender, 5-7 minutes. TIP: If needed, add a splash of water to help soften kale.Stir in garlic and another drizzle of olive oil. Cook until fragrant, 30 seconds more.Turn off heat. Remove from pan; set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, gently add ravioli to pot, then reduce heat to low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and floating to the top, 3-4 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water, then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While ravioli cook, melt 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in pan used for kale over medium heat.Once butter has melted, add walnuts. Cook, stirring, until walnuts smell toasty and butter is foamy and flecked with amber brown bits, 2-3 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Add kale mixture to pan with walnuts
instructions_json.body: Add kale mixture to pan with walnuts.Stir in stock concentrate, crème fraîche, and ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (⅓ cup for 4 servings).Bring to a simmer, then stir in ravioli. Cook, stirring, until ravioli are thoroughly coated in sauce, 1-2 minutes. (Add more pasta cooking water a splash at a time if needed.) Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between bowls. Sprinkle with Parmesan and serve.

title: Prep & Bake Spinach Ravioli with Sirloin Steak
subtitle: Includes recyclable aluminum tray

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce.In oven-ready tray, combine crushed tomatoes, cream cheese, stock concentrate, half the Italian Seasoning, half the garlic powder, and ½ tsp salt. (For 4, evenly divide ingredients between two trays, using ½ tsp salt in each tray.)Nestle ravioli into sauce, then top with grape tomatoes and spinach (for 4, evenly divide ingredients between two trays).Coat a large piece of foil (two pieces for 4) with nonstick cooking spray. Cover tray tightly with prepared foil, then add a second layer of foil. TIP: Evenly spread out spinach and press down, making sure no leaves hang over the edges!

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Nestle ravioli into sauce, then evenly top with grape tomatoes and spinach. TIP: Spread out spinach and press down, making sure no leaves hang over the edges of tray!Coat a large piece of foil (two pieces of foil for 4 servings) with nonstick cooking spray or a drizzle of oil. Cover tray tightly with prepared foil, then cover with a second layer of foil.Top with spinach (For 4, divide everything between two trays). Coat a large piece of foil (two pieces for 4) with nonstick cooking spray. Cover tray tightly with prepared foil, then add a second layer of foil. TIP: Evenly spread out spinach and press down, making sure no leaves hang over the edges of your tray!

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Bake on top rack (be sure your oven has preheated!) until spinach has wilted, grape tomatoes begin to burst, and ravioli are warmed through, 30 minutes. (For 4 servings, bake two trays side by side on top rack.)

instructions_json.title: Meanwhile, grate Parmesan
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, grate Parmesan.When ravioli have 5 minutes left, place remaining Italian Seasoning, remaining garlic powder, and 1½ TBSP butter (3 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until melted, 30-45 seconds; stir to combine.Halve ciabatta. Spread cut sides with garlic herb butter.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once ravioli have baked 30 minutes, remove tray from oven and carefully remove foil (watch out for steam!). Stir ravioli bake until spinach is combined. Sprinkle with half the Parmesan; return to top rack and bake, uncovered, until cheese melts, 2-4 minutes.Place garlic bread, cut sides up, on a baking sheet; sprinkle evenly with remaining Parmesan. Toast on top rack (alongside ravioli) until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes (watch carefully!). (For 4 servings, toast garlic bread on middle rack.)Halve garlic bread on a diagonal.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide ravioli bake and cheesy garlic bread between plates. Serve. TIP: Add a pinch of chili flakes to the ravioli bake for a spicy kick!
