title: Garden Spinach Ricotta Ravioli & Chicken
subtitle: with Zucchini Ribbons, Tomato & Creamy Lemon Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim ends from zucchini; shave zucchini lengthwise into thin ribbons using a peeler, rotating as you go, until you get to the seedy core. Finely chop core.Dice tomato. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Zest and quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, gently add ravioli to pot. Immediately reduce to a low simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente and floating to the top, 4-5 minutes.Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water, then drain. TIP: Gently shake strainer with ravioli in it to remove as much moisture as possible.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chopped zucchini, tomato, scallion whites, and 1 tsp Italian Seasoning (2 tsp for 4 servings; use the rest of the Italian Seasoning as you like). Cook until veggies are just softened, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Reduce heat under pan with veggies to medium, then stir in stock concentrate, ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (⅓ cup for 4 servings), and a squeeze of lemon juice. Reduce heat to low and cook, 1-2 minutes.Stir in sour cream and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) until melted and combined. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved cooking water a splash at a time until sauce reaches a creamy consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Separate zucchini ribbons with your hands, then stir into pan with sauce.Gently stir in drained ravioli. Simmer until sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in lemon zest to taste.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between bowls

title: Silky Spinach Ravioli with Chicken
subtitle: plus Lemony Zucchini, Tomatoes, Crunchy Panko & Parsley

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Zest and quarter lemon. Pick parsley leaves from stems; roughly tear leaves.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add panko; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer to a small bowl. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for panko over medium heat. Add zucchini and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.Turn off heat. Stir in half the lemon zest; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add tomatoes and season with salt and pepper. Cook until tomatoes begin to burst, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan. TIP: If tomatoes haven’t burst, gently press them with a spatula to help them along.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, gently add ravioli to pot. Reduce to a low simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and floating to the top, 3-4 minutes.Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain and set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add tomato paste, garlic powder, and half the Italian Seasoning (all for 4). Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.Whisk in crème fraîche, cream cheese, stock concentrate, and ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water (½ cup for 4) until melted and combined.Stir in ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4); season with salt and pepper. Add a squeeze of lemon juice and remaining lemon zest to taste. Simmer until sauce is slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Gently stir drained ravioli into pan with sauce. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time until ravioli are coated in a creamy sauce.Divide ravioli between bowls. Top with zucchini, tomatoes, toasted panko, and parsley. Serve.

Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Halve buns.In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise with chipotle powder to taste (start with a pinch, then taste and add more from there if desired). Season with salt and pepper; set aside.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add sliced onion and season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 10-15 minutes. TIP: Lower heat and add a splash of water if onion begins to brown too quickly.Stir in half the BBQ sauce (you’ll use the rest later); cook until sauce is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more.Turn off heat; transfer to a medium bowl. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While onion cooks, toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, half the Fry Seasoning (you’ll use the rest later), salt, and pepper.Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While potatoes roast, in a large bowl, combine beef*, minced onion, remaining Fry Seasoning, salt (we used ½ tsp; 1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper. Form into two patties (four patties for 4), each slightly wider than a burger bun.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for onion over medium-high heat. Add patties and cook to desired doneness, 3-5 minutes per side. In the last 1-2 minutes of cooking, top each patty with cheddar; cover pan until cheese melts. While patties cook, toast buns until golden.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread bottom buns with remaining BBQ sauce. Spread top buns with chipotle aioli. Fill buns with patties and caramelized onion.Divide burgers between plates and serve with potato wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Smoky Mustard Turkey Burgers
subtitle: with Seared Onion & Mixed Greens Salad

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Peel and slice onion into ¼-inch-thick rounds, keeping the layers intact. Mince one round (two rounds for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion rounds in a single layer (work in batches if necessary!); cook until tender and browned at the edges, 2-4 minutes per side. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine turkey*, minced onion, panko, stock concentrate, Fry Seasoning, and 1 TBSP water (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4) and pepper. Form mixture into two patties (four patties for 4), each slightly wider than a burger bun. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for onion rounds over medium heat. Add patties and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-7 minutes per side.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a second medium bowl, toss mixed greens with as much dressing as you like. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.Halve and toast buns until golden brown.Spread smoky mustard on cut sides of buns. Fill buns with seared onion and turkey patties. Divide burgers and salad between plates; serve. TIP: Feel free to top your burgers with some salad!

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Mince two pickle slices (four slices for 4 servings). Halve buns.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, half the Old Bay Seasoning (you’ll use the rest later), and a big pinch of salt and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.In a small bowl, combine ketchup, mayonnaise, minced pickle, and a pinch of pepper. Set aside.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine pork*, half the Fry Seasoning, ½ tsp salt, and pepper (all the Fry Seasoning and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings).Form into two patties (four patties for 4), each slightly wider than a burger bun.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a second medium bowl, whisk together half the tempura mix, remaining Old Bay Seasoning, 4 TBSP cold water, and a pinch of salt and pepper (for 4 servings, use all the tempura mix and 6 TBSP cold water). TIP: If needed, add more cold water 1 TBSP at a time until mixture reaches a pancake-batter-like consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add patties and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side.In the last minute of cooking, top each patty with Monterey Jack; cover pan to melt cheese.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: While patties cook, heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a medium heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat.Pat remaining pickle slices dry with paper towels, then stir into batter until fully coated.Once oil is hot enough that a drop of batter sizzles when added to pan, working in batches, add coated pickles in a single layer. Cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes on the first side and 1-2 minutes on the second side.Using a slotted spoon, transfer pickles to a paper-towel-lined plate.

title: Cheesy Spiced Meatballs with Charred Corn Rice
subtitle: A meal easily customized for every type of eater

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. In a small pot, combine rice, ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Drain and rinse corn; dry thoroughly with paper towels. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a large bowl, combine beef*, panko, Mexican Spice Blend, cheddar, salt (we used ½ tsp; 1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper.Form into 10-12 1½-inch meatballs (20-24 meatballs for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place meatballs on one side of a lightly oiled baking sheet (for 4 servings, spread out across entire sheet). Toss zucchini on empty side of sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4, toss zucchini on a separate sheet; roast meatballs on middle rack and zucchini on top rack, swapping rack positions halfway through.) Roast on top rack until meatballs are cooked through and zucchini is browned and tender, 12-14 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While meatballs and zucchini roast, heat a medium dry, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add corn and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly charred, 4-6 minutes. (TIP: If corn begins to pop, cover pan.) Season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; stir in charred corn, garlic powder, 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Divide meatballs, rice, and zucchini between plates. For Adult Plate: Top with red pepper crema and cilantro. Serve. For Kid Plate: Top with red pepper crema if desired. Serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

title: Tunisian Spiced Beef Meatballs
subtitle: with Apricot Glaze, Roasted Carrots & Scallion Couscous

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; mince whites. Zest and quarter lemon. In a small bowl, combine jam, half the stock concentrates (you’ll use the rest later), and ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4 servings).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss carrots on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack, flipping halfway through, until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add couscous and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted, 2-3 minutes. Stir in 1 cup water (2 cups for 4) and remaining stock concentrates. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until tender, 6-8 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While couscous cooks, in a large bowl, combine beef*, scallion whites, panko, Tunisian Spice Blend, and ¾ tsp salt (1½ tsp for 4 servings). Season with pepper. Form into 10-12 1½-inch meatballs (20-24 meatballs for 4).

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned all over, 4-6 minutes. (TIP: If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.) Pour in jam mixture and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook until meatballs are cooked through and glazed, 5 minutes more. Stir in a squeeze of lemon juice to taste. (TIP: If glaze is too thick, add a splash of water.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff couscous with a fork; stir in lemon zest, half the scallion greens, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper. Divide couscous, carrots, and meatballs between plates. Top meatballs with remaining glaze from pan and remaining scallion greens. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges on the side.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

title: Gluten-Free-Friendly Organic Beef Meatballs
subtitle: with French Onion Gravy, Garlic Mashed Potatoes & Roasted Carrots

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Peel, halve, and finely dice onion. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4). Set aside for Step 6.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Place potatoes in a large pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil; cook until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain potatoes and return to pot. Keep covered off heat until ready to mash in Step 7.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss carrots on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper (spread out across entire sheet for 4 servings). Roast on top rack 10 minutes (you’ll add more to the sheet then).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While carrots roast, in a large bowl, combine breadcrumbs and 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Let sit until water has absorbed, about 1 minute. Add beef* and Fry Seasoning to bowl with breadcrumbs; season with salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4) and pepper. Gently combine, then form into 10-12 1½-inch meatballs (20-24 meatballs for 4).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once carrots have roasted 10 minutes, remove sheet from oven; carefully place meatballs on empty side of sheet and drizzle with oil. (For 4 servings, leave carrots roasting; place meatballs on a second lightly oiled baking sheet and roast on middle rack.) Return to top rack and roast until carrots are tender and meatballs are browned and cooked through, 12-14 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, melt 1 TBSP plain butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) and a drizzle of oil in a medium pan over medium heat. Add onion and 1 tsp herbes de Provence (2 tsp for 4). Cook, stirring, until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes. (Be sure to measure the herbes de Provence—we sent more!) Stir in ¾ cup water (1¼ cups for 4), Worcestershire, stock concentrates, and mustard. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced, 1-2 minutes. Add reserved cornstarch mixture to pan with gravy and stir until thickened, about 30-60 seconds. Remove from heat; taste and season with salt and pepper. TIP: If gravy seems too thick, add a splash of water.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Heat pot with cooked potatoes over low heat. Add garlic herb butter. Using a potato masher or fork, mash potatoes, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed, until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper. Divide meatballs, mashed potatoes, and carrots between plates. Top meatballs with onion gravy and serve.

title: Parm Meatballs with Organic Beef
subtitle: plus Cheesy Bread & Italian Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim and discard root end from lettuce; separate leaves and tear into bite-size pieces over a large bowl. Grate Parmesan over a small bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a second large bowl, combine beef*, panko, mayonnaise, Italian Seasoning, half the Parmesan, salt (we used ½ tsp; 1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper. Form into 8-10 1-inch meatballs (16-20 meatballs for 4).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat 2 TBSP oil in a large, preferably ovenproof, pan over medium heat. Add 5 meatballs and cook until browned on all sides, 30-45 seconds per side (they’ll finish cooking in next step). Transfer seared meatballs to a plate; repeat with remaining meatballs. Turn off heat; wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add marinara to pan used for meatballs (if your pan isn’t ovenproof, use an 8-by-8-inch baking dish instead). Arrange meatballs in pan, nestling each one in sauce. Bake on top rack until meatballs are cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven; carefully sprinkle meatballs and sauce with mozzarella. Return to top rack and bake until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes more.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While meatballs bake, halve ciabatta and place on a baking sheet. Drizzle cut sides with olive oil and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan. Toast on middle rack until cheese melts.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add dressing to bowl with lettuce; toss to coat. Divide chicken Parm meatballs and cheesy bread between plates. Serve with salad on the side.

title: Pork Meatball & Mushroom Ramen
subtitle: with Garlic Chili Oil

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Peel and mince or grate garlic. Finely chop chili. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; mince whites. Peel and mince ginger until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Trim, peel, and halve carrot lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine ¼ of the garlic with 2 TBSP oil (4 TBSP for 4 servings); microwave until fragrant, 30 seconds. Season with salt and add as much chili as you like. Set aside.In a medium bowl, combine pork*, panko, scallion whites, 2 tsp minced ginger (4 tsp for 4), ¾ tsp salt (1½ tsp for 4), and pepper. Form into 1-inch meatballs.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat (use a large pot for 4 servings). Add mushrooms and carrot; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until browned and tender, 5-7 minutes.Add another drizzle of oil, remaining garlic, and remaining minced ginger. Cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add 3 cups water (6 cups for 4 servings), pork ramen stock concentrates, and mushroom stock concentrate to pot with veggies; bring to a boil.Meanwhile, add half the noodles (all for 4) to pot with salted water (not the broth!); cook until just tender, 1-2 minutes.Drain and rinse noodles under cold water. Toss with a drizzle of oil.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once broth is boiling, reduce to a simmer and add meatballs; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes.Taste broth and season generously with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide noodles between bowls; top with meatballs, veggies, and as much broth as you like. (You may have some broth left over for seconds!) Top with scallion greens and as much garlic chili oil as you like. Serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Peel and mince or grate ginger. Peel and mince garlic. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Finely chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add half the ginger; cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.Stir in rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a large bowl, combine pork*, panko, ponzu, garlic, remaining ginger, salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4 servings), and pepper.Form mixture into 10-12 1½-inch meatballs (20-24 meatballs for 4 servings) and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet.Roast on top rack until browned and cooked through, 14-16 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While meatballs cook, in a medium bowl, combine cucumber, carrots, half the cilantro, and ¼ of the vinegar. Season with salt and pepper.In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ¼ of the vinegar, and up to half the chili sauce to taste (save the rest for the next step).

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a second large bowl, combine 2½ TBSP sweet soy glaze (5 TBSP for 4 servings; be sure to measure–we sent more), ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4), and remaining chili sauce to taste.Once meatballs are done, carefully transfer to bowl with sauce; toss until meatballs are thoroughly coated and sauce is just warmed through.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; season with salt and pepper.Divide rice between bowls and top with meatballs, any remaining chili sauce from bowl, and pickled veggie salad. Drizzle with chili mayo. Garnish with remaining cilantro and serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Meatballs with Ginger Sauce
subtitle: plus Roasted Carrots, Ginger Rice & Creamy Sriracha

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Toss on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While carrots roast, peel and mince or grate ginger. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; mince whites.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add half the ginger; cook until fragrant, 1 minute.Stir in rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a large bowl, combine beef*, scallion whites, panko, remaining ginger, and 1 TBSP umami ginger sauce (2 TBSP for 4 servings). (You’ll use the rest of the umami ginger sauce in the next step.) Season with salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4) and pepper.Form into 1½-inch meatballs and spread out on a second baking sheet.Bake on middle rack until browned and cooked through, 14-16 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine sour cream with Sriracha to taste. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.Once meatballs are done, gently transfer to a second large bowl; add remaining umami ginger sauce and toss to coat.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; taste and season with salt if desired.Divide rice between plates and top with carrots, meatballs, and any umami ginger sauce from bowl. Drizzle with creamy Sriracha. Garnish with scallion greens and as many sesame seeds as you like. Serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

title: Fajita Bowls with Chicken
subtitle: plus Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, Pico de Gallo & Chili Lime Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Dice tomato. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Zest and quarter lime. Mince jalapeño, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a small bowl, combine tomato, minced onion, a squeeze of lime juice, and as much jalapeño as you like. Season with salt and pepper.In a separate small bowl, combine sour cream, a squeeze of lime juice, and a pinch of chili powder (you’ll use the rest later). Season with salt and pepper. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper and sliced onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 7-9 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: Lower heat and add a splash of water if veggies begin to brown too quickly. Turn off heat; transfer to a medium bowl and cover to keep warm. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once veggies are done, heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add pork*, Southwest Spice Blend, and remaining chili powder. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.Stir in stock concentrate and a splash of water; cook until saucy, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; stir in lime zest and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper.Divide rice between bowls and top with pork and veggies. Drizzle with crema. Top with Monterey Jack and pico de gallo. Serve with tortilla chips and any remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.
appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: One-Pan Cantina Fajitas with Organic Chicken
subtitle: plus Spicy Guacamole & Smoky Red Pepper Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Quarter lime. Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion.In a small bowl, combine guacamole, a squeeze of lime juice, and a dash of hot sauce (save the rest for serving). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper and onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 4-5 minutes.Add half the Fajita Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest in the next step) and cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels.Push veggies to one side of pan; add a drizzle of oil to empty side. Add shrimp and remaining Fajita Spice Blend. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes.Stir veggies and shrimp to combine. Add a big squeeze of lime juice and season with salt and pepper to taste. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.Divide tortillas between plates; fill with shrimp and veggie filling and spicy guacamole. Drizzle with smoky red pepper crema. Serve with remaining hot sauce and any remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Fajita-Spiced Chicken & Bulgur Bowls
subtitle: with Tomato, Pickled Jalapeño & Garlic Lime Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince or grate garlic; reserve a pinch in a small bowl (you’ll use it in Step 5). Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds, removing ribs and seeds for less heat; mince a few rounds until you have 1 tsp (2 tsp for 4 servings). Zest and quarter lime. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium heat. Add scallion whites, remaining garlic, and ½ tsp Fajita Spice Blend (1 tsp for 4 servings). Cook, stirring, until softened and fragrant, 2-3 minutes.Add bulgur, stock concentrates, 1 cup water (2 cups for 4), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until water is absorbed and bulgur is tender, 12-15 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine sliced jalapeño, juice from half the lime, ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt.Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 30 seconds. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Pat pork* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels. Season all over with remaining Fajita Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side.Transfer to a cutting board to rest.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To bowl with reserved garlic, add mayonnaise, sour cream, a squeeze of lime juice (two squeezes for 4 servings), a big pinch of lime zest, and a pinch of minced jalapeño to taste. TIP: If you like some zesty heat, add a small splash of jalapeño pickling liquid in place of, or in addition to, lime juice.Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Fluff bulgur with a fork
instructions_json.body: Fluff bulgur with a fork. Stir in tomato, half the scallion greens, remaining lime zest, a squeeze of lime juice, and as much remaining minced jalapeño as you like. Season with salt and pepper.Thinly slice pork crosswise.Divide bulgur between shallow bowls; top with pork. Drizzle everything with crema; garnish with remaining scallion greens and as much pickled jalapeño (draining first) as you like. Serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Salsa Macha Rice Bowls with Organic Chicken
subtitle: with Fajita Veggies & Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Roughly chop peanuts. Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer.Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a small, preferably nonstick, pan, add 3 TBSP oil (6 TBSP for 4 servings), 2 tsp Fajita Spice Blend (4 tsp for 4; be sure to measure—we sent more!), peanuts, sesame seeds, 1/2 tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4), and vinegar. (Mix off heat!) Stir until combined.

instructions_json.title: Heat pan with salsa macha over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat pan with salsa macha over medium heat. Once oil is hot and mixture begins to fry, cook, stirring constantly, until sesame seeds, peanuts, and spices are toasted, 3-4 minutes.Remove pan from heat and set aside. (TIP: Keep an eye on the mixture! If toasting too quickly, remove pan from heat and transfer mixture to a bowl.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper and onion and lightly season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.Stir in half the Mexican Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest in the next step); cook, stirring, until veggies are lightly browned, 1-2 minutes more. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Pat organic chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with remaining Mexican Spice Blend and salt. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add organic chicken; cook until browned and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. (TIP: If chicken is browning too quickly, reduce heat to medium.) Transfer to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, place sour cream in a small bowl. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt. Fluff rice with a fork. Thinly slice organic chicken crosswise. Divide rice between bowls. Top with organic chicken and fajita veggies in separate sections; drizzle everything with crema and as much salsa macha as you like. (TIP: Refrigerate any extra salsa macha in an airtight container for up to 3 days.) Garnish with cilantro and hot sauce to taste. Serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a small, preferably nonstick, pan, add 3 TBSP oil (6 TBSP for 4 servings), 2 tsp Fajita Spice Blend (4 tsp for 4; be sure to measure—we sent more!), peanuts, sesame seeds, 1/2 tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4), and vinegar. (Mix off heat!) Stir until combined.

instructions_json.title: Heat pan with salsa macha over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat pan with salsa macha over medium heat. Once oil is hot and mixture begins to fry, cook, stirring constantly, until sesame seeds, peanuts, and spices are toasted, 3-4 minutes.Remove pan from heat and set aside. (TIP: Keep an eye on the mixture! If toasting too quickly, remove pan from heat and transfer mixture to a bowl.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper and onion and lightly season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.Stir in half the Mexican Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest in the next step); cook, stirring, until veggies are lightly browned, 1-2 minutes more. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with remaining Mexican Spice Blend and salt. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook until browned and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. (TIP: If chicken is browning too quickly, reduce heat to medium.) Transfer to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, place sour cream in a small bowl. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt. Fluff rice with a fork. Thinly slice chicken crosswise. Divide rice between bowls. Top with chicken and fajita veggies in separate sections; drizzle everything with crema and as much salsa macha as you like. (TIP: Refrigerate any extra salsa macha in an airtight container for up to 3 days.) Garnish with cilantro and hot sauce to taste. Serve.

title: Cantina Fajitas with Steak

instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. subtitle: plus Pepper Jack, Pickled Jalapeño & Lime Sour Cream

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Cut sweet potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Season with salt and pepper.Roast on top rack until tender and lightly crisped, 25-30 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Zest and quarter lime
instructions_json.body: Zest and quarter lime. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; dice a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips. Dice tomato. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.body: In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine half the sliced onion, juice from half the lime, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt.Microwave for 30 seconds. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Slice bacon* crosswise into ¼-inch pieces
instructions_json.body: Slice bacon* crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid.Heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. Add bacon in an even layer; cook, undisturbed, until bottom is crispy, 2-3 minutes. Stir in chicken, green pepper, scallion whites, Mexican Spice Blend, and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat if browning too quickly, until bacon is crispy, chicken is cooked through, and green pepper is tender, 4-6 minutes. TIP: Add a drizzle of oil if pan seems dry.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While filling cooks, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave until warm and pliable, 30 seconds.Once filling is done, lay tortillas on a clean work surface. Place a small amount of filling on the bottom half of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create enchiladas.Arrange enchiladas, seam sides down, in an 8-by-8-inch baking dish or ovenproof pan (use a 9-by-13-inch baking dish for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Cover enchiladas with as much enchilada sauce as you like (we sent extra!). Sprinkle with Mexican cheese blend.Bake on top rack until sauce is bubbling and cheese melts, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While enchiladas bake, zest and quarter lime.In a small bowl, combine sour cream, juice from one lime wedge (two wedges for 4 servings), and as much lime zest as you like. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide enchiladas between plates and top with lime crema and scallion greens. Serve with hot sauce and any remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: Southwest Organic Beef, Corn & Zucchini Flautas
subtitle: with Enchilada Sauce & Queso Blanco

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with oil. Wash and dry produce. Trim zucchini and grate on the largest holes of a box grater. Place in the center of a clean kitchen towel. Gather into a tight bundle and squeeze over the sink to remove as much liquid as possible.Drain corn, then pat dry with paper towels. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef* or organic beef*; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and softened, 3-4 minutes. Add corn and scallion whites; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 2-4 minutes. TIP: Cover pan if corn starts to pop. Add Southwest Spice Blend and half the enchilada sauce; cook, stirring often, until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; stir in Monterey Jack until melted. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Use pan used for beef here. Once scallion whites are charred, return beef or organic ground beef to pan and cook through the rest of this step as instructed.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, drizzle tortillas with 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to completely coat on both sides.Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Once corn and zucchini filling is done, add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create flautas.Place flautas, seam sides down, on prepared sheet. TIP: Arrange your flautas snug on the sheet to keep them from unrolling.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Bake flautas on top rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Place remaining enchilada sauce in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until warmed through, 45-60 seconds.In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine queso blanco with 1 TBSP water (2 TBSP for 4 servings); microwave until warmed through, 25 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Divide flautas between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide flautas between plates. Drizzle with queso blanco and as much remaining enchilada sauce as you like. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Cheesy Shrimp & Black Bean Enchiladas
subtitle: with Old El Paso™ Enchilada Sauce, Cilantro, Pico de Gallo & Lime Crema

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 475 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Dice tomato. Roughly chop cilantro. Halve, peel, and finely dice onion. Quarter lime. Core, deseed, and dice green pepper. Drain beans over a small bowl, reserving liquid.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a second small bowl, combine tomato, cilantro, 2 TBSP onion (4 TBSP for 4 servings), and a squeeze of lime juice to taste. Season with salt and pepper.In a third small bowl, combine sour cream with a squeeze of lime juice to taste. Season with salt and pepper. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper; cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes.Add remaining onion; cook until just softened, 2-3 minutes.Add Southwest Spice Blend, half the beans, and 2 TBSP bean liquid (you’ll use more beans and bean liquid later). Cook, stirring, until fragrant and warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add remaining beans; cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes.Add 3 TBSP bean liquid (5 TBSP for 4 servings). (You may have some bean liquid left over.) Simmer until warmed through, 1-2 minutes.Lower heat, then stir in 1 TBSP butter and salt (we used ½ tsp). (For 4, use 2 TBSP butter and 1 tsp salt.)Turn off heat; mash with a potato masher or fork until mostly smooth. Season with pepper.

instructions_json.title: Spread tortillas with mashed beans
instructions_json.body: Spread tortillas with mashed beans. Place a small amount of filling on one half of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create enchiladas. Place, seam sides down, in an 8-by-11-inch baking dish or large ovenproof pan. (For 4 servings, use a 9-by-13-inch dish or two smaller ones.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Pour red enchilada sauce over enchiladas to thoroughly coat. (You may not need all the sauce.) Top with Mexican cheese blend.Bake on top rack until sauce is bubbly and cheese melts, 5-7 minutes.Top enchiladas with lime crema and pico de gallo. Serve directly from baking dish with any remaining lime wedges on the side.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 8 servings) and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ½-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, Fajita Spice Blend, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 8 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 5.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just beginning to brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Keep the heat on—you'll add more to the pan in the next step!)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add beef* to pan used for bell pepper; season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes. (TIP: If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.) Stir in bell pepper, scallion whites, Mexican Spice Blend, garlic powder, and stock concentrates until thoroughly combined and beef is cooked through, 1 minute more. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Turn off heat. Transfer beef mixture to a medium bowl (large bowl for 8 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once rice is done, transfer to bowl with beef mixture; stir to combine.Place a small amount of filling on one half of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create enchiladas. Place, seam sides down, in a 9-by-13-inch baking dish (two baking dishes for 8 servings). TIP: If you have any extra filling left over, serve it on the side!Top half the enchiladas with enchilada sauce; top remaining enchiladas with green salsa. Sprinkle evenly with Mexican cheese blend. Bake on middle rack until lightly browned and cheese has melted, 15-18 minutes. (For 8, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Remove enchiladas from oven; top with sour cream and scallion greens.Serve enchiladas family style or divide between plates.

title: Smothered Three-Bean & Shrimp Burritos
subtitle: with Rice, Enchilada Sauce, Tomato & Sour Cream

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1 cup water, ¼ cup enchilada sauce, and a pinch of salt (2 cups water, ½ cup enchilada sauce, and a big pinch of salt for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-20 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 4.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce. Trim and discard root end from lettuce; halve lengthwise and thinly slice crosswise. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Heat a second small pot over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat a second small pot over medium heat. Add beans and their liquid, ½ cup enchilada sauce (1 cup for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Simmer until sauce has reduced slightly and beans are warmed through, 4-6 minutes.Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper.While beans simmer, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Lay tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Lay tortillas on a clean work surface. Place about ⅓ cup rice in a line on the bottom third of each tortilla. Using a slotted spoon, top rice with about ½ cup bean mixture; sprinkle with half the Mexican cheese blend. Top with a pinch of lettuce and a pinch of tomato. (Save any remaining rice, beans, lettuce, and tomato for serving.)Fold up bottom side of each tortilla over filling, then fold over left and right sides toward filling. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to form burritos.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add burritos, seam sides down. Cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy all over, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide burritos between shallow microwave-safe serving bowls. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over burritos; sprinkle with remaining Mexican cheese blend. Microwave each dish until sauce is warmed through and cheese melts, 30-60 seconds per dish.Dollop burritos with sour cream. Serve with any remaining rice, beans, lettuce, and tomato on the side.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1 cup water, ¼ cup enchilada sauce, and a pinch of salt (2 cups water, ½ cup enchilada sauce, and a big pinch of salt for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-20 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 4.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce. Trim and discard root end from lettuce; halve lengthwise and thinly slice crosswise. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Heat a second small pot over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat a second small pot over medium heat. Add beans and their liquid, ½ cup enchilada sauce (1 cup for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Simmer until sauce has reduced slightly and beans are warmed through, 4-6 minutes.Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper.While beans simmer, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Lay tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Lay tortillas on a clean work surface. Place about ⅓ cup rice in a line on the bottom third of each tortilla. Using a slotted spoon, top rice with about ½ cup bean mixture; sprinkle with half the Mexican cheese blend. Top with a pinch of lettuce and a pinch of tomato. (Save any remaining rice, beans, lettuce, and tomato for serving.)Fold up bottom side of each tortilla over filling, then fold over left and right sides toward filling. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to form burritos.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add burritos, seam sides down. Cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy all over, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide burritos between shallow microwave-safe serving bowls. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over burritos; sprinkle with remaining Mexican cheese blend. Microwave each dish until sauce is warmed through and cheese melts, 30-60 seconds per dish.Dollop burritos with sour cream. Serve with any remaining rice, beans, lettuce, and tomato on the side.

title: Southwest Tofu Quesadillas
subtitle: with Mandarin Salsa & Red Pepper Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Finely dice tomato. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Roughly chop cilantro. Drain and finely dice mandarin orange slices. Quarter lime.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken, onion, Southwest Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.Add ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings); cook until evaporated, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a large bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface; sprinkle one half of each tortilla with Mexican cheese blend and chicken mixture.Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas.Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for chicken over medium heat. Add quesadillas and cook until tortillas are golden brown and cheese melts, 1-2 minutes per side. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine tomato, scallions, cilantro, mandarin orange, and juice from half the lime; season with salt.In a separate small bowl, combine red pepper crema and juice from remaining lime.Cut quesadillas into wedges; divide between plates. Top with salsa and serve with crema on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Tex-Mex Steak, Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
subtitle: A meal easily customized for every type of eater

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Dice tomatoes into ½-inch pieces; divide between two small bowls. Halve lime. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; finely chop a few slices until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Roughly chop cilantro. Mince jalapeño, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Drain and rinse beans.Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; finely chop a few slices until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Mince jalapeño, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Roughly chop cilantro. Quarter lime.To the other bowl of tomato, stir in juice from remaining lime, minced onion, cilantro, as much jalapeno as you like, and a pinch of salt.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: To one bowl with tomatoes, stir in juice from half the lime and a pinch of salt. Set aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.To second bowl with tomatoes, stir in chopped onion, cilantro, juice from remaining lime, a pinch of salt, and as much jalapeño as you like.Drain and rinse beans.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-4 minutes.Add beans and Tex-Mex paste; cook, stirring and scraping bottom of pan constantly, until warmed through, 2-5 minutes more (if a crust begins to form at bottom of pan, add splashes of water to help loosen it up; repeat as needed).Taste and season with salt or pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Place tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Sprinkle half of each tortilla with one-quarter of the Mexican cheese blend; top with bean filling and sprinkle with remaining Mexican cheese blend. Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas.Wash and dry pan used for beans.Top the kid portion with the plain salsa.Top the parent portion with loaded salsa and as much hot sauce as you like.Serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Melt ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4 servings) and a drizzle of oil in pan used for beans over medium heat. Add quesadillas and cook until golden brown on one side, 1-2 minutes.Add another ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4) and flip; cook until golden brown and cheese melts, 1-2 minutes more. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches, adding more butter and oil for each batch.Cut quesadillas into wedges.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Cut quesadillas into wedges and divide between plates.For Adult Plate: Top with jalapeño salsa and as much hot sauce as you like. Snip a corner of one sour cream packet and drizzle over top. Serve.For Kid Plate: Top with plain salsa and serve with remaining sour cream on the side for dipping if desired.For Kid Plate: Top with plain salsa. Serve.

title: Cantina-Style Organic Chicken Quesadillas
subtitle: with Rice, Black Beans & Charred Corn Salsa

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), stock concentrate, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat a low simmer. Cook, covered, until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat steak* dry with paper towels; thinly slice against the grain. In a medium bowl, combine steak, half the Fajita Spice Blend, ½ tsp salt (1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper. Set aside until ready to use.Wash and dry produce.Drain corn and pat dry with paper towels. Quarter lime. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Mince whites. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over high heat. Add corn and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 4-6 minutes. TIP: Cover pan with a lid if kernels start to pop.Turn off heat; transfer corn to a second medium bowl and add tomato, scallion whites, and juice from half the lime (whole lime for 4 servings). Stir to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.Set salsa aside until ready to use. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While corn cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a second small pot over medium heat. Add beans and their liquid, remaining Fajita Spice Blend, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally and smashing beans slightly with the back of a wooden spoon, until warmed through, 4-6 minutes.Remove from heat, cover, and set aside until ready to serve. TIP: Beans will thicken as they sit.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for corn over high heat. Add steak and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned all over, 2-4 minutes. TIP: Steak will cook a bit more in the quesadillas, so we cooked it to medium rare.Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wash and dry pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface; evenly top one half of each tortilla with Mexican cheese blend. Top with steak, then fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas.Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for steak over medium heat. Add quesadillas and cook until tortillas are golden brown and cheese melts, 2-4 minutes per side (work in batches for 4 servings). TIP: Lower heat if tortillas are browning too quickly.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Divide corn salsa between small bowls. Cut quesadillas into thirds.Divide quesadillas, rice, and beans between plates in separate sections. Top quesadillas with guacamole, sour cream, scallion greens, and as much hot sauce as you like. Serve with corn salsa and remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.
appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

title: Black Bean, Beef & Pepper Quesadillas
subtitle: with Salsa Fresca & Creamy Guacamole

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Core, deseed, and dice green pepper. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato. Zest and quarter lime (for 4 servings, zest one lime and quarter both).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium pot, combine beans and their liquid, Southwest Spice Blend, 1 TBSP butter, salt (we used ¼ tsp; ½ tsp for 4 servings), and pepper. instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper, salt, and pepper. instructions_json.body: Spread one half of each tortilla with a layer of mashed beans. (TIP: You may have some beans left over. Serve remaining on the side if you like.) Top with green pepper mixture, Mexican cheese blend, and Monterey Jack.Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas.

title: Tex-Mex Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
subtitle: A meal easily customized for every type of eater

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Dice tomatoes into ½-inch pieces; divide between two small bowls. Halve lime. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; finely chop a few slices until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Roughly chop cilantro. Mince jalapeño, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Drain and rinse beans.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: To one bowl with tomatoes, stir in juice from half the lime and a pinch of salt. To second bowl with tomatoes, stir in chopped onion, cilantro, juice from remaining lime, a pinch of salt, and as much jalapeño as you like. Set salsas aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-4 minutes. Add beans and Tex-Mex paste; cook, stirring and scraping bottom of pan constantly, until warmed through, 2-5 minutes more (if a crust begins to form at bottom of pan, add splashes of water to help loosen it up; repeat as needed). Taste and season with salt or pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Place tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Sprinkle half of each tortilla with one-quarter of the Mexican cheese blend; top with bean filling and sprinkle with remaining Mexican cheese blend. Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas. Wash and dry pan used for beans.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4 servings) and a drizzle of oil in pan used for beans over medium heat. Add quesadillas and cook until golden brown on one side, 1-2 minutes. title: Mexican-Inspired Chipotle Shrimp Quesadillas
subtitle: with Corn Tortillas, Pickled Cabbage & Creamy Chipotle Salsa

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and finely dice onion. Roughly chop cilantro. Quarter lime. In a small bowl, reserve ¼ cup onion (½ cup for 4 servings) for Step 4.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine cabbage, vinegar, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave until cabbage is slightly wilted, 1-2 minutes. Carefully remove and discard plastic wrap; set cabbage aside to pickle, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat shrimp* dry with paper towels; dice into ½-inch pieces. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add shrimp, remaining onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened and chicken is browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Stir in half the chipotle puree and a splash of water; cook, stirring, until sauce has thickened and shrimp is coated, 30-60 seconds more. Turn off heat; transfer shrimp to a plate. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While shrimp cooks, to bowl with reserved onion, add cilantro, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Set aside until ready to serve. In a second small bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, remaining chipotle puree, and a squeeze of lime juice (big squeeze for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper. Set relish and salsa aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in very damp paper towels; microwave for 1 minute. Let rest for 1 minute wrapped in paper towels. TIP: This will make it easier to fold your tortillas without tearing them. Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Evenly sprinkle one half of each tortilla with Mexican cheese blend; top with shrimp mixture. Fold in half to create quesadillas.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for chicken over medium heat. Working in batches, add quesadillas. Cook until tortillas are crisped and cheese melts, 1-2 minutes per side. (Add more oil between batches if necessary.)

instructions_json.title: Divide quesadillas between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide quesadillas between plates. Top with salsa and relish. Serve with pickled cabbage (draining first) and remaining lime wedges on the side. TIP: Enjoy the cabbage on top of the quesadillas for a tangy bite!

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and half the onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly crispy, 3-5 minutes. TIP: If pan seems dry, add another drizzle of olive oil. Remove pan from heat; add Mexican Spice Blend, stock concentrate, half the Tex-Mex paste, half the chili powder, and 1½ cups water (all the Tex-Mex paste, all the chili powder, and 2½ cups water for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Return pan with mushroom mixture to heat; bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until broth has reduced slightly and mushrooms are tender, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat; using a slotted spoon, transfer mushrooms to a medium bowl, leaving broth behind. Transfer broth to a separate medium heatproof bowl. Wipe out pan. TIP: Use the back of a spoon to press on mushrooms while transferring them from the pan to press out any excess broth.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While mushrooms cook, place beans and their liquid in a small pot and season with salt and pepper. Heat over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened and warmed through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat; mash beans with a potato masher or fork until mostly smooth. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Cover pot and set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface; sprinkle one half of each tortilla with mozzarella. Top with mushrooms and string cheese. Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in pan used for mushrooms. Add quesadillas; cook until tortillas are golden brown and cheese melts, 2-4 minutes per side. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches. If pan seems dry, add another drizzle of olive oil.

title: One-Pan Beef & Rajas Quesadillas
subtitle: with Salsa Fresca, Southwest Crema & Guacamole

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Dice tomatoes. Roughly chop cilantro. Quarter lime. Core, deseed, and dice green pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine minced onion, half the tomatoes, half the cilantro, and juice from half the lime. Season with salt and pepper.In a separate small bowl, combine half the sour cream with ¼ tsp Southwest Spice Blend (½ tsp for 4 servings). (You’ll use the rest of the sour cream and Southwest Spice Blend in the next step.) Season with salt and pepper. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion, green pepper, and a big pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, 7-8 minutes.Stir in remaining tomatoes, remaining Southwest Spice Blend, and 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes are softened and mixture is thickened and saucy. TIP: If veggie mixture seems dry, add up to 2 TBSP more water.Remove pan from heat; stir in remaining cilantro and remaining sour cream. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface; sprinkle one half of each tortilla with Mexican cheese blend.Top with veggie filling, then sprinkle with pepper jack.Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Wash out pan used for veggie filling; return to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.Add quesadillas and cook until tortillas are golden brown and cheese melts, 2-4 minutes per side. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Cut quesadillas into wedges; divide between plates and top with guacamole and salsa. Drizzle with crema. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: Crispy Southwest Turkey & Bean Burritos
