instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Finely dice tomato. Halve, peel, and finely dice onion. Roughly chop cilantro. Zest and quarter lime. Drain and rinse beans.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine tomato, cilantro, 2 TBSP diced onion, and a squeeze of lime juice (4 TBSP diced onion and a big squeeze of lime juice for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper.Place yogurt in a separate small bowl. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat. Add ground turkey and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Add remaining onion and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is browned and softened, 1-2 minutes. Add beans, half the Southwest Spice Blend, ¼ cup water, salt (we used ½ tsp; 1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper (use all the Southwest Spice Blend and ½ cup water for 4). Bring to a simmer and cook until liquid has mostly evaporated, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat. Using a potato masher or fork, mash beans until mostly smooth.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, whisk together honey, lime zest, juice from two lime wedges (four wedges for 4 servings), a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Lay tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Lay tortillas on a clean work surface. Top with 2 TBSP pico de gallo. Fold up bottom side of each tortilla over filling, then fold over left and right sides toward filling. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to form burritos. Heat a large pan over medium heat. Place burritos, seam sides down, in pan. Press down with a spatula until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Repeat until golden brown and crisp on all sides. TIP: Lower heat if tortillas are browning too quickly!

instructions_json.title: Step 6

title: Harvest Baked Brie Bread Bowl & Prosciutto Board
subtitle: with Caramelized Onion & Cranberry Topping | 2-4 Servings

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove brie from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Pick thyme leaves from stems. Halve, core, and thinly slice apple. Trim and quarter radishes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Slice about 1 inch off top of sourdough bread bowl. Place brie on cut surface of bread bowl and use it as a guide to determine size of opening. Trace around brie with a small knife and scoop out center of bread bowl, leaving about a ½-inch border around side and bottom. Dice top of bread and scooped-out bread into 1-inch pieces (they don’t need to be perfect, but try to make them roughly the same size so they’ll toast evenly!).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Place brie inside hollowed-out bread bowl and transfer to one side of a baking sheet. Toss bread pieces on empty side of sheet with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Bake on middle rack until bread pieces are golden brown and toasted, 8-12 minutes. Carefully remove bread pieces from sheet and continue baking bread bowl until brie is soft and gooey, 8-10 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a medium pan over medium heat. Add onion and most of the thyme (reserve a pinch for garnish); season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and caramelized, 10-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Add vinegar and cranberries to pan with onion and cook until slightly reduced and glazy, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in roasted onion and garlic spread until thoroughly combined.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Transfer baked brie bread bowl to center of a serving board or platter. Spoon caramelized onion and cranberry topping over brie. Garnish with reserved thyme. Arrange toasted bread pieces, apple, radishes, prosciutto, and cashews around bread bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken  & Maple Carrot Power Bowls
subtitle: with Turmeric-Toasted Couscous & Lemony Hummus

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 350 degrees. Wash and dry produce (be sure to dry the kale thoroughly so it crisps up in the oven!).Remove and discard any large stems from kale. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ¼-inch-thick pieces. Quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss kale on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. TIP: For easy cleanup, line baking sheet with aluminum foil first. Roast on top rack until browned and crisp, 13-15 minutes. (For 4 servings, divide kale between 2 sheets. Roast on top and middle racks, switching rack positions halfway through.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add couscous and ¼ tsp turmeric (½ tsp for 4 servings). Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and toasted, 1-2 minutes.Add stock concentrate, 1½ cups water (2¼ cups for 4), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until liquid has absorbed and couscous is tender, 6-8 minutes.Drain any excess liquid if necessary; keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add carrots, ¼ tsp harissa powder (½ tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. (TIP: If you prefer a milder flavor, use less harissa powder.) Cook, stirring occasionally, until just softened, 5-8 minutes.Add half the maple syrup (all for 4) and 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4); cook, stirring occasionally, until carrots are lightly browned and tender, 3-5 minutes. Remove pan from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine hummus, juice from one lemon wedge, 1 TBSP olive oil, and 1 TBSP water. (For 4 servings, use a medium bowl, juice from two lemon wedges, 2 TBSP olive oil, and 2 TBSP water.) Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Drain pineapple and orange slices over a large bowl, reserving juice. Roughly chop pineapple and orange slices. Peel and finely chop half the shallot (whole shallot for 4 servings); save remaining for another use. Quarter limes. Drain, rinse, and thoroughly dry corn with paper towels. Halve tomatoes. Finely chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp* and pat dry with paper towels.Whisk honey, half the garlic, 2 tsp Fajita Spice Blend (4 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper into bowl with reserved fruit juice. (Be sure to measure the Fajita Spice Blend—we sent more!) Add shrimp and toss; let marinate until ready to use in Step 5.In a second large bowl, combine chopped shallot and juice from half the lime.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over high heat. Add corn and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 4-6 minutes (if corn begins to pop, cover pan with a lid).Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for corn over high heat. Once oil is shimmering, remove shrimp from marinade and add to pan (discard marinade). Cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: To bowl with shallot, add chopped pineapple, chopped orange, corn, tomatoes, half the cilantro, remaining garlic, a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning with more lime juice, salt, or pepper if desired.Fluff rice with a fork; gently stir in remaining cilantro.Divide rice between shallow bowls. Top with shrimp and fruit and corn salsa (draining first). Serve with any remaining lime wedges on the side. TIP: Top with chili flakes or your favorite hot sauce if you like things spicy!

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine chili sauce, onion paste, half the vinegar, half the soy sauce, and ¼ cup water (use all the vinegar and ⅓ cup water for 4 servings).

instructions_json.body: Stir garlic powder into pan with veggies. Add drained noodles, chili-soy sauce, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). title: Sweet & Spicy Organic Beef & Noodle Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Bell Pepper, Cilantro & Peanuts

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Roughly chop peanuts. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper. Zest and quarter lime (zest one lime and quarter both for 4 servings). Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook until tender, 1-2 minutes.Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water, at least 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While noodles cook, briefly heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. Add peanuts and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and fragrant, 2-3 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites, bell pepper, and half the garlic powder (all for 4 servings); season with salt and pepper.Cook, stirring, until tender and lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Transfer veggies to a plate. Reserve pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Add another drizzle of oil to same pan over medium-high heat. Add pork*; season with salt and pepper. Cook, undisturbed, until browned on bottom, 3-4 minutes. Break up into pieces; cook until cooked through, 2-4 minutes more.Stir in veggies, sweet soy glaze, chili sauce, 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and chili flakes to taste. Cook, stirring, until well coated, 1-2 minutes; remove from heat.

title: Japanese-Style Dumplings, Noodles & Organic Beef

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice cucumbers into rounds. In a medium bowl, combine cucumbers, vinegar, half the sesame seeds, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Set aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels. Cut into pea-size pieces.In a large bowl, combine shrimp, pork*, garlic-ginger scallion paste, cornstarch, soy sauce, half the sesame oil, 2 tsp sugar, and a big pinch of salt (all the sesame oil and 4 tsp sugar for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Fill a small bowl with cold water
instructions_json.body: Fill a small bowl with cold water. On a clean work surface, working one at a time, add ½ TBSP filling to the center of each wonton wrapper, leaving a ¼-inch border around the edges. TIP: Cover filled and remaining wrappers with a damp paper towel as you work to keep them from drying out.Lightly brush edges with cold water using your fingers. Bring two opposite corners together, folding in half to form a triangle; pinch edges to seal. Lightly brush cold water on one bottom corner, then gently pinch two bottom corners together at the center; press firmly to adhere. (Save any remaining filling for noodle stir-fry!)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.Meanwhile, heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, pan over medium heat. Add dumplings, sealed sides up; cook until bottoms are golden brown, 1-2 minutes.Carefully add ¾ cup plain water, then cover with a tight-fitting lid. Steam until water has evaporated and dumplings are cooked through, 6-7 minutes. (You may need to cook dumplings in batches, adding a drizzle of oil and ¾ cup plain water between batches.)Turn off heat; transfer dumplings to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 1-2 minutes.Drain and rinse under cold water, at least 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6

instructions_json.title: Step 7

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot

title: Japanese-Style Shrimp & Pork Dumplings & Noodles
subtitle: Enjoy a multi-dish culinary tour of a new destination!

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice cucumbers into rounds. In a medium bowl, combine cucumbers, vinegar, half the sesame seeds, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Set aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels. Cut into pea-size pieces.In a large bowl, combine shrimp, pork*, garlic-ginger scallion paste, cornstarch, soy sauce, half the sesame oil, 2 tsp sugar, and a big pinch of salt (all the sesame oil and 4 tsp sugar for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Fill a small bowl with cold water
instructions_json.body: Fill a small bowl with cold water. On a clean work surface, working one at a time, add ½ TBSP filling to the center of each wonton wrapper, leaving a ¼-inch border around the edges. TIP: Cover filled and remaining wrappers with a damp paper towel as you work to keep them from drying out.Lightly brush edges with cold water using your fingers. Bring two opposite corners together, folding in half to form a triangle; pinch edges to seal. Lightly brush cold water on one bottom corner, then gently pinch two bottom corners together at the center; press firmly to adhere. (Save any remaining filling for noodle stir-fry!)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.Meanwhile, heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, pan over medium heat. Add dumplings, sealed sides up; cook until bottoms are golden brown, 1-2 minutes.Carefully add ¾ cup plain water, then cover with a tight-fitting lid. Steam until water has evaporated and dumplings are cooked through, 6-7 minutes. (You may need to cook dumplings in batches, adding a drizzle of oil and ¾ cup plain water between batches.)Turn off heat; transfer dumplings to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 1-2 minutes.Drain and rinse under cold water, at least 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add a drizzle of oil to pan used for dumplings over medium-high heat. TIP: If desired, add any remaining dumpling filling to pan; cook, undisturbed, until browned on bottom, 2-3 minutes. Break up filling into pieces, then cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 1-2 minutes more.Add edamame, half the sweet soy glaze, and chili sauce to pan. Cook, stirring frequently, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat.Add drained noodles; toss to coat. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with as many remaining sesame seeds as you like.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Divide dumplings and cucumber salad between plates or serve family style. Serve with remaining sweet soy glaze and noodle stir-fry on the side.

instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Open and drain tofu; press out excess water with paper towels. Dice into ½-inch cubes. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Trim scallions and slice whites into 1-inch pieces; thinly slice greens. In a medium bowl, combine sweet soy glaze, vinegar, ginger paste, and ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 8 servings).

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 5-7 minutes. Drain and set aside. (You’ll use the noodles in Step 5.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While noodles cook, place tofu in a large bowl; season with salt and pepper. Add cornstarch and toss until evenly coated. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add coated tofu in a single layer and cook until golden and crispy, 1-3 minutes per side. (For 8 servings, work in batches, adding another drizzle of oil per batch.) Turn off heat; transfer tofu to a paper-towel-lined plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for tofu over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and bell pepper; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until browned and tender, 3-4 minutes. Add scallion whites. (If pan seems dry, add another drizzle of oil.) Cook, stirring frequently and lowering heat if browning too quickly, until scallions are just tender, 1-2 minutes more. (You’ll add more to the pan in the next step.) While veggies cook, in a second medium bowl, combine curry paste and soy sauce.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To pan with veggies, add drained noodles and curry-soy mixture; toss until noodles are thoroughly coated, 30-60 seconds. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Turn off heat; transfer curry noodles to a serving bowl. Wipe out pan. In same pan, combine tofu and ginger–soy glaze sauce over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring, until sauce has thickened and tofu is coated, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; toss with half the sesame seeds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Halve, core, and dice bell pepper into ½-inch pieces. Quarter lime. Finely chop cilantro leaves and stems.In a medium bowl, whisk together curry paste, coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce, stock concentrate, 1 TBSP sugar, and 2½ cups water (2 TBSP sugar and 4½ cups water for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a medium pot (large pot for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add chicken and bell pepper; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.Add curry powder and as many chili flakes as you like; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add coconut-curry broth to pot; stir to combine. Bring to a boil. Add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally to break up noodles, until noodles are tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.Add juice from 2 lime wedges (4 wedges for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper to taste.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Divide soup between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide soup between bowls. Top with wonton strips. Garnish with cilantro and any remaining chili flakes to taste. Serve with a squeeze of lime juice.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Shoyu Ramen with Sesame-Soy Organic Chicken
subtitle: plus Spinach, Crispy Wonton Strips & Scallions

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Pat salmon* dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper.Place salmon, skin sides down, on a baking sheet. Roast on top rack until cooked through, 8-10 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While salmon roasts, peel and mince or grate ginger. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of cooking oil and half the sesame oil in a medium pot (large pot for 4 servings) over medium heat. Add ginger, garlic, and scallion whites to hot pot. Cook, stirring, until fragrant and beginning to soften, 1-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir 3½ cups water (7 cups for 4 servings), stock concentrates, and half the soy sauce into pot with veggies. Bring to a boil.Once broth is boiling, add noodles. Cook, stirring, until just tender, 1-2 minutes.Remove from heat; add spinach. Stir until spinach is wilted, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, whisk together remaining sesame oil, remaining soy sauce, and ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings).Once salmon is done roasting, carefully remove and discard skin. Transfer salmon to bowl with sauce. Using a fork, break salmon into pieces and stir to coat.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Divide broth and noodles between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide broth and noodles between bowls. Top with sesame-soy salmon. Garnish with scallion greens and wonton strips. Serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Cheesy Tex-Mex Ramen Skillet with Bacon
subtitle: with Tomato, Green Pepper & Toasted Panko Topping

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Core, deseed, and dice green pepper into ½-inch pieces. Thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces. Quarter lime.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add panko and cook, stirring, until golden brown, 3-5 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer to a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper and scallion whites. Season with Southwest Spice Blend, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 2-3 minutes.Add tomato paste; stir to combine. Cook, stirring, until tomato paste begins to darken slightly, 15-30 seconds.Stir in cream sauce base, cream cheese, and ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings); bring to a simmer. Cook, whisking, until smooth, 1-2 minutes.Whisk in cheddar until melted and smooth and sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook until tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water, at least 30 seconds.Remove cheese sauce from heat; stir in tomato and drained noodles. Taste and season with salt and pepper. TIP: If sauce seems too thick, add splashes of water. Top cheesy Tex-Mex ramen skillet with toasted panko, scallion greens, a squeeze of lime juice, and as much hot sauce as you like. Serve family style with remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Ramen with Beef in a Shoyu-Style Broth
subtitle: with Bok Choy, Chili Garlic Oil & Crispy Onions

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add pork* and scallion whites; season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned, 2 minutes (the pork will finish cooking in Step 3).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: To pot with pork mixture, add 3½ cups water, chicken stock concentrates, pork ramen stock concentrates, and half the soy sauce (7 cups water and all the soy sauce for 4 servings); cover and bring to a simmer.Meanwhile, in a small microwave-safe bowl, combine sesame seeds, garlic, half the sesame oil (all for 4), a drizzle of oil, a big pinch of salt, and as many chili flakes as you like. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once broth is simmering, reduce heat under pot to medium. Add noodles, bok choy and napa cabbage, and spinach; simmer, stirring, until noodles are tender and pork is cooked through, 2 minutes.Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Divide ramen between large soup bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide ramen between large soup bowls. Stir in as much chili garlic oil as you like.Top with scallion greens and a few crispy onions. Serve. TIP: Don’t add all the onions just yet! Add them as you eat to keep them nice and crispy.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Szechuan Noodle Stir-Fry with Organic Beef
subtitle: with Carrot, Scallion & Peanuts

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince garlic. Trim and cut scallions crosswise into 1-inch pieces; thinly slice one-quarter of the scallion greens. Trim and peel carrot; grate on the largest holes of a box grater. Roughly chop peanuts.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, whisk together sweet soy glaze, stock concentrate, half the Szechuan paste, half the vinegar, half the peanut butter, 1½ tsp sugar, ¼ cup water, and chili flakes to taste until smooth. (For 4 servings, use all the Szechuan paste, all the vinegar, all the peanut butter, 3 tsp sugar, and ⅓ cup water.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef*. Using a spatula, press into an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until browned on bottom, 3-4 minutes. Break up meat into pieces and continue cooking until beef is cooked through, 4-5 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add garlic and scallion pieces to pan with beef; cook until fragrant, 1-2 minutes. Stir in sauce; cook until reduced and thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water, at least 30 seconds. Add drained noodles, carrot, and 1 tbsp butter (2 tbsp for 4 servings) to pan with beef mixture. Toss until noodles are warmed through and everything is thoroughly combined, 1-2 minutes. (TIP: If needed, stir in water a splash at a time until noodles are thoroughly coated in sauce.) Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Divide stir-fry between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide stir-fry between bowls. Top with sliced scallion greens, peanuts, and remaining chili flakes to taste. Serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Miso-Sesame Shrimp & Bacon Ramen
subtitle: in Gochujang Broth with Bok Choy, Cabbage & Corn

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Drain corn.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 1-2 minutes.Drain and rinse noodles under cold water, 30 seconds. Toss with a drizzle of oil.Wipe out pot.

instructions_json.title: Slice bacon* crosswise into ¼-inch pieces
instructions_json.body: Slice bacon* crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.Heat dry pot used for noodles over medium-high heat. Add bacon in an even layer; cook, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat if browning too quickly, until crispy, 5-8 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate. Carefully discard all but a thin layer of bacon fat from pot.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat pot with reserved bacon fat over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites, garlic, and ginger. Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds.Stir in 3 cups water (6 cups for 4 servings), pork ramen stock concentrates, soy sauce, gochujang, and half the miso sauce concentrates. (TIP: Be sure to scrape up any browned bits at the bottom of the pot—these specks are full of flavor!) Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.Stir in bok choy and napa cabbage and half the corn (all for 4). Let simmer, covered, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

title: Chinese-Style Speedy Ramen & Chicken
subtitle: with Garlic Chili Oil & Sesame Seeds

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim scallions and cut whites into 1-inch pieces; thinly slice greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add beef*; using a spatula, press into an even layer. Season with a big pinch of salt and pepper; cook, undisturbed, until browned on bottom, 2-4 minutes. TIP: If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out. Add cabbage and carrot mix and scallion whites; cook, stirring occasionally and breaking up meat into pieces, until veggies are browned and tender and beef is cooked through, 2-4 minutes more.Stir in stock concentrate, sweet soy glaze, and ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings). Bring to a simmer; cook until thickened, 1 minute. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water, at least 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While noodles cook, in a small microwave-safe bowl, combine garlic, sesame seeds, half the chili flakes, 1 tsp oil, and a pinch of salt (all the chili flakes and 2 tsp oil for 4 servings). (Use fewer chili flakes if you prefer less heat.) Cover tightly with plastic wrap; microwave until fragrant, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Transfer drained noodles to pan with beef mixture; toss until thoroughly coated. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide beef ramen noodles between bowls; drizzle with garlic chili oil and sprinkle with scallion greens. Serve.

title: Summer Veggie Brothless Pork Ramen
subtitle: with Broccoli, Heirloom Tomatoes, Corn & Pickled Cuke

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim and discard woody bottom ends from asparagus; cut stalks crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice into ¼-inch-thick half-moons. Drain corn; pat dry with paper towels. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Halve tomatoes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss asparagus on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest later), salt, and pepper. Roast on middle rack until lightly browned and tender, 8-10 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, whisk together sesame oil, ponzu, and sweet soy glaze. Set aside until ready to use in Step 6.In a medium microwave-safe bowl, add cucumber, vinegar, 1 TBSP water, ½ tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt (2 TBSP water and 1 tsp sugar for 4 servings). Stir to combine. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave until cucumber is slightly softened and warmed through, 30-45 seconds.Carefully remove plastic wrap and stir. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels; season all over with remaining garlic powder, salt, and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork; cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side.Turn off heat; transfer pork to a cutting board. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for pork over medium heat. Add corn and ginger to hot pan. Season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until corn is warmed through and ginger is fragrant, 30-60 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 1-2 minutes.Drain and immediately transfer to bowl with sweet soy sesame sauce. Toss to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice pork crosswise
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice pork crosswise.Divide sweet soy sesame noodles between bowls. Top with gingery corn, pork, asparagus, pickled cucumber, tomatoes, and crispy onions in separate sections. Drizzle with spicy mayo to taste. Serve. TIP: Before eating, toss everything together in the bowl for a true mazemen eating experience!

instructions_json.body: Heat 1 TBSP oil and 1 TBSP butter in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add another drizzle of oil to pan; return pancake to pan and cook until cooked through, 1-2 minutes more (lower heat if browning too quickly!). Transfer to a cutting board.

title: One-Pan Shrimp Lo Mein
subtitle: with Udon Noodles, Green Beans, and Carrots

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Cut green beans into 1-inch pieces. Peel ginger, then mince until you have 1 TBSP. Mince or grate garlic. Trim, then thinly slice scallions. (TIP: Set aside some of the scallion greens for garnish, if you like.) Peel carrot, then cut in half lengthwise. Slice each half into thin half-moons.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, tallsided pan over medium-high heat. Add green beans and toss until softened slightly, 3-4 minutes. Add carrot and toss until both are fully tender, 3-4 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While veggies cook, stir together soy sauce, stock concentrate, 1 TBSP hoisin sauce (we sent more), 2 tsp sugar, and ¼ cup water in a small bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp and pat dry with a paper towel. Add shrimp, ginger, scallions, and garlic to pan with veggies. Cook, tossing, until shrimp are nearly opaque and firm, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir sauce into pan and let reduce slightly, 2-3 minutes. Add udon noodles and cook, tossing frequently, until tender and chewy, 3-4 minutes. (TIP: If noodles won’t loosen up or sauce seems dry, add a splash of water.) Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide lo mein between bowls, sprinkle with reserved scallion greens (if using), and serve.

title: Shiitake Mushroom Ramen
subtitle: with Ginger-Leek Broth & Udon

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with a pinch of salt. Meanwhile, peel the ginger with a spoon,then mince or grate along with the garlic. Thinly slice the scallions, keeping white and green parts separate. Trim and discard the root and tops of the leek, then halve and thinly slice. Rinse under water, tossing, to remove any silt. Drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the shiitakes and cook, tossing, 5-6 minutes, until soft and golden brown. Set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In the same pan, heat 1/2 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat. Add the leek to the pan and cook, tossing, 4-5 minutes, until softened. Add the porcini powder, scallion whites, ginger, and garlic to the pot and cook, stirring, another 30 seconds. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add 5 cups water, soy sauce, and stock concentrates to the pot and bring to a simmer for 10 minutes. Taste and season with salt, if necessary.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, add the udon to the boiling water and cook 9-10 minutes, until al dente. Drain and divide between two bowls.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Top the udon with the broth, then arrange the shiitakes and seaweed along the sides of the bowl. Garnish with scallion greens and enjoy!

instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Trim green beans if necessary; cut crosswise into 2-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add half the ginger and edamame; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1 minute.Stir in rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a medium microwave-safe bowl, add green beans and a splash of water; cover with plastic wrap. Microwave until tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain.Heat a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add peanuts, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), and 2 TBSP water. Cook, stirring, until water has evaporated and peanuts are coated and lightly toasted, 3-5 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer to a small bowl. Wash out pan.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for peanuts over medium-high heat. Add pork* and season with salt and pepper. title: Teriyaki Chicken & Lo Mein Stir-Fry
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces if necessary. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 5-7 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water, at least 30 seconds. (This stops the cooking and helps prevent sticky noodles.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add another drizzle of oil to same pan. Add broccoli, coleslaw mix, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir teriyaki sauce, scallion whites, stock concentrate, and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4 servings) into pan with veggies. Cook until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in drained noodles, chicken, and edamame until combined and warmed through. Divide stir-fry between bowls. Top with scallion greens and sesame seeds; drizzle with Sriracha to taste. Serve.

title: Surinamese-Style Organic Chicken Bami Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Pickled Cucumber & Onion

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Thinly slice celery on a diagonal. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Quarter lime.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine cucumber, vinegar, half the onion, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 1 minute. Carefully remove plastic wrap and set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, open package of organic chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add organic chicken; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Transfer organic chicken to a plate.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add celery, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and remaining onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften and brown, 2-4 minutes. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, until fragrant and browned, 30-60 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: To pan with veggie mixture, add organic chicken, drained spaghetti, soy sauce, 1 TBSP butter, ¼ cup reserved pasta cooking water, and juice from half the lime (2 TBSP butter and ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water for 4 servings). Cook, stirring, until everything is evenly coated in sauce, 30-60 seconds. TIP: Add more splashes of reserved pasta cooking water if sauce is too thick.

instructions_json.title: Divide stir-fry between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide stir-fry between bowls. Serve with pickled veggies (draining first) and remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Toss on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, oregano, half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest later), salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes. Halve, peel, and cut half the onion (whole onion for 4 servings) into ½-inch wedges. Cut tomato into ½-inch wedges. Roughly chop cilantro.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

In a medium bowl, combine cornstarch, half the cumin (all for 4 servings), remaining garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add steak and toss until coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook, tossing occasionally, until a crust forms, 4-6 minutes (steak will finish cooking in the next step). Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

Roughly chop cashews.Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. In a medium bowl, combine chicken, cornstarch, garlic powder, a pinch of salt, and pepper; toss until thoroughly coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

title: Soy-Glazed Steak with Broccoli Stir-Fry
subtitle: plus Jasmine Rice, Asparagus & Scallion-Ginger Oil

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince ginger. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine ginger, scallion greens, 2 TBSP oil (4 TBSP for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Microwave until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir and set aside.

title: Organic Teriyaki Chicken & Lo Mein
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces if necessary.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 5-7 minutes. Drain and thoroughly rinse under cold water, at least 30 seconds. (This stops cooking and helps prevent sticky noodles.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Open package of organic chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add organic chicken; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add a drizzle of oil to same pan. Add broccoli, coleslaw mix, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir in teriyaki sauce, scallion whites, stock concentrate, and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4 servings). Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat; stir in drained noodles, organic chicken, and edamame until combined and warmed through. Divide stir-fry between bowls. Top with sesame seeds and scallion greens; drizzle with Sriracha to taste. Serve.

title: Garden Veggie Tempura Fritters with Chicken
subtitle: with Rice, Pickles, Sweet Soy–Ponzu Sauce & Spicy Mayo

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-20 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce.Thinly slice cucumber into rounds. Trim scallions; thinly slice greens and cut whites into 1-inch pieces. Trim green beans if necessary; cut into 1-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion.In a small bowl, combine cucumber, scallion greens, vinegar, ½ tsp sugar, and ½ tsp salt (1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings). Refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, whisk together tempura batter mix, garlic powder, ⅔ cup cold water (1⅓ cups for 4 servings), and salt (we used 1 tsp; 2 tsp for 4). Add scallion whites, green beans, onion, and cabbage and carrot mix to bowl with batter. Stir until veggies are thoroughly coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot enough that a drop of batter sizzles when added to the pan, carefully add heaping ⅓-cup scoops of batter. TIP: Add batter close to the pan to avoid splatter. You may need to work in batches, adding more oil as needed and adjusting the heat if fritters are browning too quickly. You can also make smaller fritters if you like! Lightly press down on tops of fritters with a spatula until about 1 inch thick. Cook until golden brown and crisp, 3-4 minutes per side. Using a slotted spoon, carefully transfer fritters to a paper-towel-lined plate. Blot tops of fritters with paper towels. Season with a pinch of salt.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While fritters cook, in a second small bowl, combine ponzu and sweet soy glaze.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until melted. Divide rice, fritters, and pickles (draining first) between plates in separate sections. Serve with sweet soy–ponzu sauce and spicy mayo for dipping.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce.Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces if necessary. Trim and thinly slice scallions.In a medium bowl, toss broccoli with a large drizzle of oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Pat barramundi* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat barramundi* dry with paper towels. Using a sharp knife, slowly cut between flesh and skin ½ inch at a time, being careful not to cut into flesh, until skin is fully removed from fish; discard skin. Cut barramundi into ½-inch chunks. In a second medium bowl, toss barramundi with half the sweet soy glaze (you’ll use the rest later) until evenly coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Coat an air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray; arrange barramundi and broccoli in basket in separate sections. (TIP: Work in batches if necessary!) Air-fry at 390 degrees until barramundi starts to turn opaque, 4-6 minutes. Remove basket; carefully brush barramundi with remaining sweet soy glaze. Return basket to air fryer; cook until glaze is tacky and barramundi is cooked through, 1-2 minutes more. Transfer barramundi to a small bowl; continue to air-fry broccoli until tender, 2-3 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a second small bowl, combine mayonnaise, Sriracha, half the honey (all for 4 servings), and as many chili flakes as you like. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Fluff rice with a fork

title: Steamed Cantonese-Style Barramundi
subtitle: with Rice, Roasted Asparagus & Sweet Soy Ginger Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Pat barramundi* dry with paper towels; place in a large bowl. Add half the soy sauce and half the ponzu (you’ll use the rest later). Turn to coat. Set aside to marinate, skin sides up, at least 10 minutes. In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer.Cook until tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, trim woody ends from asparagus; cut on a bias into 2-inch pieces. Peel ginger and slice lengthwise into ¼-inch-thick planks; stack planks and slice lengthwise to create ¼-inch-thick matchsticks. Trim and halve scallions lengthwise; cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces, separating whites from greens. Roughly chop cilantro. In a medium bowl, whisk together remaining soy sauce, remaining ponzu, 2 TBSP warm water, and 1 tsp sugar (4 TBSP warm water and 2 tsp for 4 servings) until sugar dissolves.

instructions_json.title: Cut a 12-inch-long piece of aluminum foil

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on baking sheet to coat with oil. Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef* and season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Stir in garlic powder and sweet soy glaze until beef is evenly coated. Turn off heat and set aside until ready to use in Step 4.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle. (The dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!) Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more. (This will make the next step easier!)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, evenly sprinkle each dough rectangle with mozzarella, leaving a ½-inch border around edges. Top with beef. Gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one of the dough rectangles, starting with a long side. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log. Place stromboli, seam side down, on baking sheet; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: With a sharp knife, gently cut three small, shallow diagonal slits along the top of each stromboli. Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes (for 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through).

instructions_json.title: While strombolis bake, quarter lime
instructions_json.body: While strombolis bake, quarter lime. In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, Sriracha, and as much lime juice as you like.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Once strombolis are done, let rest at least 2 minutes. Halve strombolis crosswise and divide between plates. Serve with Sriracha-lime aioli on the side for dipping.

title: Stir-Fried Chicken & Korean Rice Cakes
subtitle: with Sweet Potatoes, Green Beans, Zucchini & Soy-Gochujang Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a small pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Dice sweet potatoes into ¼-inch pieces. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sweet potatoes; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and beginning to soften, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, trim green beans if necessary; halve crosswise (leave any smaller green beans whole). Halve, peel, and dice onion into ½-inch pieces. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-moons. Trim scallions; cut whites into ½-inch batons and thinly slice greens.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once sweet potatoes have cooked 4-6 minutes, add a drizzle of oil to pan. Add green beans, onion, zucchini, and scallion whites; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are lightly browned and tender, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add rice cakes to pot. Cook until softened, 1-2 minutes. Reserve ½ cup rice cake cooking water (¾ cup for 4 servings), then drain.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To pan with veggies, add drained rice cakes, sweet soy glaze, gochujang, ¼ cup reserved rice cake cooking water, and a pinch of sugar (½ cup reserved rice cake cooking water and a big pinch of sugar for 4 servings). Cook, stirring frequently, until sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes. TIP: If sauce seems too thick, stir in additional splashes of reserved rice cake cooking water. (For an extra-luscious sauce, stir in 1 TBSP butter!)

instructions_json.title: Divide stir-fry between shallow bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide stir-fry between shallow bowls. Garnish with scallion greens and sesame seeds. Serve.

title: Crispy Rice & Spicy Salmon Bites
subtitle: with Creamy Sriracha Guac & Sweet Soy Glaze | 4 servings

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites; cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in rice, half the sesame seeds, 1½ cups water, and a pinch of salt; bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until tender, 15-18 minutes (you’ll finish the rice in Step 3).

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat salmon* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Place, skin-sides down, on a baking sheet. Roast on top rack until salmon is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once rice is done, using a wooden spoon, stir rice until it begins to stick together, 1 minute. Add rice wine vinegar, cornstarch, and 1 tsp sugar; stir until well combined. Line an 8- x 8-inch baking dish with plastic wrap (make sure to leave a little overhang so the rice is easy to remove in Step 6) and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Press rice mixture into prepared baking dish in an even layer (TIP: To prevent the rice from sticking to your spoon, spray the top of the rice with nonstick spray). Transfer to freezer until rice is cooled, at least 15 minutes (and no longer than 30 minutes).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, whisk together guacamole, mayonnaise, and Sriracha to taste. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Remove skin from salmon (discard skin)
instructions_json.body: Remove skin from salmon (discard skin). Place in a medium bowl; using two forks, flake salmon into bite-size pieces. Add 1 TBSP creamy Sriracha guac and half the sweet soy glaze; stir to coat.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Using edges of plastic wrap, carefully lift rice out of baking dish and transfer to a cutting board (discard plastic wrap). Cut into 4 equal squares. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add rice squares; cook until browned and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side (you may need to cook in batches!). Transfer crispy rice to cutting board; cut each square into 4 smaller squares (16 squares total). AIR FRYER ALTERNATIVE: Coat an air fryer basket with cooking spray; arrange rice squares side by side in basket. Coat tops with cooking spray. Air fry at 380 degrees until golden brown, turning halfway through, 15-20 minutes. Work in batches if necessary.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Place crispy rice squares on a serving platter. Top each with remaining creamy Sriracha guac and jalapeño to taste, then divide sweet soy salmon between squares. Drizzle with remaining sweet soy glaze. Garnish with remaining sesame seeds and scallion greens. Serve with soy sauce on the side for dipping. Salmon is fully cooked when internal temperature reaches 145°.

instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce.Drain juice from mango into a medium microwave-safe bowl (save mango for serving). Trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds. TIP: If you prefer less heat, halve jalapeño lengthwise, scrape out seeds with a spoon, then slice crosswise into half-moons.To bowl with mango juice, add cucumber, half the vinegar, a pinch of salt, and as much jalapeño as you like. instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Coat air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray; add trout, skin sides down, and air-fry until starting to turn opaque, 4-6 minutes.Remove basket; carefully brush trout with a layer of remaining sweet soy glaze (save some for serving).Return basket to air fryer; air-fry until glaze is tacky and trout is cooked through, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.body: Serve pork chops and rice family style directly from baking dish. Garnish with scallion greens.

title: Firecracker Meatballs
subtitle: with Roasted Green Beans & Jasmine Rice

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; mince whites. Peel and mince ginger.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream, honey, 2 tsp soy sauce (4 tsp for 4 servings), and Sriracha to taste. (You’ll use the rest of the soy sauce later.) Set aside.

title: Firecracker Beef Ramen Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Green Beans

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce.Trim green beans if necessary; cut crosswise into 2-inch-long pieces. Trim scallions; cut whites into 1-inch pieces and thinly slice greens. Peel and mince or grate ginger.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, half the chili sauce (you'll use the rest later), and as much Sriracha as you like.Set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook until tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water, at least 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While noodles cook, heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add beef*, green beans, scallion whites, ginger, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until beef is cooked through and veggies are tender, 4-6 minutes. instructions_json.body: Add soy sauce, remaining chili sauce, and ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings) to pan with beef and green beans; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, 30-60 seconds.Remove from heat.

instructions_json.body: To pan with beef and green beans, add drained noodles and ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4 servings). Toss to combine; taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Divide stir-fry between shallow bowls. Drizzle with as much firecracker sauce as you like. Top with scallion greens and serve.

instructions_json.title: Heat broiler to high
instructions_json.body: Heat broiler to high. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Place potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While potatoes cook, trim, peel, and dice carrots into ¼-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ¼-inch pieces.Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid (¾ cup for 4 servings), then drain. Return potatoes to pot.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably ovenproof, pan (use a large, preferably ovenproof, pan for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add carrots and onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are just tender, 5-7 minutes. (TIP: If veggies begin to brown too quickly, add a splash of water.)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add organic ground beef* to pan with veggies and season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Add flour; cook, stirring, until thoroughly combined, 1 minute. Stir in ½ cup water, bulgogi sauce, and peas (1 cup water for 4 servings). Bring to a boil; cook until mixture is very thick, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish now.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir in ½ cup plain water (1 cup for 4 servings), bulgogi sauce, and peas. Bring to a boil; cook until mixture is very thick, 1-2 minutes.Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper. TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish now.Serve directly from pan.Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish now.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Top organic ground beef filling with an even layer of mashed potatoes, leaving a gap around edge of pan. Evenly sprinkle with cheddar. title: Korean-Style Organic Beef Bulgogi Pizzas
subtitle: with Sweet Potato & Pickled Onion

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings); preheat oven to 475 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Drizzle olive oil over a clean work surface. Remove pizza dough from packaging; place on oiled surface. Shape each piece into a ball. (TIP: Spray your hands with nonstick cooking spray to prevent sticking.) Evenly coat top of dough balls with a large drizzle of olive oil. Cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, halve sweet potato lengthwise, then slice into ¼-inch-thick half-moons. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Finely chop cilantro leaves and stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, high-sided pan over medium-high heat. Add beef* and sweet potato; season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until beef is cooked through and sweet potato begins to soften, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat. Add bulgogi sauce and stir to evenly coat. Set aside until ready to assemble pizzas in Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, line a baking sheet (2 baking sheets for 4 servings) with parchment paper. Carefully press and stretch each dough ball into a rough oval shape and place on one side of prepared sheet (you’ll have two dough ovals per sheet). TIP: If needed, use a rolling pin to help roll out dough. Cover dough with a clean kitchen towel; let rest 15 minutes more. (This will make stretching the dough into a larger shape even easier!)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, in a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine onion, vinegar, ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Tightly cover with plastic wrap and microwave until pickled, 30-60 seconds. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 15 minutes, using oiled hands, press and stretch on sheet into larger oval shapes, about 10 inches long and 5-6 inches wide. Evenly spread dough with BBQ sauce. Top with as much bulgogi beef and sweet potato as you like. Sprinkle mozzarella over top. Brush edges of dough with oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake pizzas on top rack until crusts are golden brown and crisp, 14-18 minutes. (For 4 servings, bake on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Top pizzas with gochujang aioli, pickled onion (draining first), cilantro, and as many chili flakes as you like. Slice pizzas as desired. Divide between plates and serve.

title: Bulgogi Beef Shepherd’s Pie
subtitle: topped with White Cheddar Mashed Potatoes

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and heat broiler to high. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid (¾ cup for 4 servings), then drain potatoes and return to pot. Mash with sour cream and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) until smooth and creamy, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed. Season with salt and pepper. Keep mashed potatoes covered off heat until ready to use in Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While potatoes cook, trim, peel, and dice carrots into ¼-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably ovenproof, pan (use a large, preferably ovenproof, pan for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add carrots and onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are just tender, 5-7 minutes. TIP: If veggies begin to brown too quickly, add a splash of plain water.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add beef* to pan with veggies and season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Add flour; cook, stirring, until thoroughly combined, 1 minute.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir in ½ cup plain water (1 cup for 4 servings), bulgogi sauce, and peas. Bring to a boil; cook until mixture is very thick, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; taste and season with salt and pepper. TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish now.

instructions_json.body: Top beef filling with an even layer of mashed potatoes, leaving a gap around edge of pan. Evenly sprinkle with cheddar. title: Steak & Mushroom Crispy Rice
subtitle: with Bok Choy, Garlicky Soy Sauce, Pickled Carrots & Fried Onions

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 5.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Pat sirloin steak dry with paper towels; season generously with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine carrots, scallion whites, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and ¼ tsp salt (2 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt for 4 servings). Microwave 45 seconds. Set aside.In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic powder, and 1½ TBSP sugar (3 TBSP for 4).In a separate small bowl, combine Sriracha and mayonnaise. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan (large pan for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 5-7 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp soy sauce mixture (4 tsp for 4), salt, and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to one side of a plate. Wipe out pan. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for mushrooms over medium-high heat. Add bok choy and napa cabbage and cook, stirring, until browned and tender, 4-5 minutes. Turn off heat; stir in 1 tsp soy sauce mixture. Transfer to empty side of plate; wipe out pan. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest 5 minutes, then thinly slice against the grain. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once rice is done, heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over high heat. Once oil is very hot and almost smoking, add cooked rice; spread out in an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until a crust forms on the bottom of rice, 1-2 minutes. TIP: Oil may splatter a bit—be careful! Remove pan from heat and pour remaining soy sauce mixture over top.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In pan, top crispy rice with steak, mushrooms, bok choy and napa cabbage, and pickled carrots (draining first) in separate sections. Garnish with scallion greens and crispy fried onions. Drizzle spicy mayo on top, and serve directly from pan.

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Peel, trim, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces.Toss carrots on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper.Roast on top rack until tender, 20-25 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small pot (medium pot for 4 servings), combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites and garlic; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds.Stir in kale, half the soy sauce (save the rest for serving), and ¾ cup water (1½ cups water for 4 servings). Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid has evaporated and kale is wilted and tender, 6-8 minutes.Stir in 1 TBSP butter and ¼ tsp sesame oil (2 TBSP butter and ½ tsp sesame oil for 4). instructions_json.title: Step 6

instructions_json.title: Fluff rice with a fork
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork. Stir in half the sesame seeds (all for 4 servings).Divide rice between bowls; top with kale, roasted carrots, and fried eggs in separate sections.
