instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Meanwhile, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Trim and peel carrots. Using a peeler, shave carrots lengthwise into ribbons, rotating as you go, until you get to the core; discard core. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Peel and mince ginger and garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine scallion whites, vinegar, and a pinch of salt. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.In a separate small bowl, combine sesame oil, half the soy sauce (you’ll use the rest later), 1 TBSP sugar (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and up to half the Sriracha to taste. Stir until sugar has dissolved.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add carrots; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.Add another drizzle of oil to pan. Add zucchini; season with salt and pepper. Cook until browned and tender, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove from pan and set aside with carrots.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add tofu, ginger, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is lightly browned, 4-5 minutes. Add remaining soy sauce and cook, stirring, until liquid has mostly evaporated, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork and season with salt and pepper; divide between bowls. Arrange tofu, carrots, and zucchini in separate sections on top. Top with pickled scallion whites (and pickling liquid). Drizzle with sauce and remaining Sriracha to taste. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

title: Chili Crisp & Egg Bibimbap
subtitle: with Purple Sweet Potato, Zucchini & Gochujang Aioli

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, dice sweet potato into ½-inch pieces. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Gently crush crispy fried onions in their package.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss sweet potato and zucchini on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan, combine 4 TBSP oil, garlic, scallion whites, sesame seeds, crispy fried onions, ¼ tsp salt, and as many chili flakes as you like (8 TBSP oil and ½ tsp salt for 4 servings); heat over medium-high heat. Once sizzling, cook, stirring frequently, until garlic is golden brown and mixture is fragrant, 2-3 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a small heatproof bowl. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When veggies have 5 minutes remaining, heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for chili crisp over medium heat. Once hot, crack eggs into pan and cover. Fry to preference; season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Fluff rice with a fork
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork. Divide rice between bowls; top with roasted veggies and fried eggs in separate sections. Drizzle with gochujang aioli and chili crisp. Garnish everything with scallion greens and serve. TIP: This dish is meant to be mixed in the bowl before being enjoyed!

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.
appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

title: Shrimp, Mushroom & Spinach Bibimbap
subtitle: with Garlicky Soy Sauce, Pickled Carrots & Fried Onions

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 5.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine carrots, scallion whites, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and ¼ tsp salt (2 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt for 4 servings). Microwave 45 seconds. Set aside.In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic powder, and 1½ TBSP sugar (3 TBSP for 4).In a separate small bowl, combine Sriracha and mayonnaise. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.Rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels. Season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan (large pan for 4 servings) over high heat. Once pan is hot, add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan (large pan for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 5-7 minutes.Stir in 2 tsp soy sauce mixture (4 tsp for 4), salt, and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to one side of a plate. Wipe out pan.Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for mushrooms over medium-high heat. Add spinach and cook, stirring, until wilted, 3-4 minutes.Turn off heat; stir in 1 tsp soy sauce mixture. Transfer to empty side of plate; wipe out pan. Use pan used for shrimp here.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once rice is done, heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over high heat. Once oil is very hot and almost smoking, add cooked rice; spread out in an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until a crust forms on the bottom of rice, 1-2 minutes. TIP: Oil may splatter a bit—be careful! Remove pan from heat and pour remaining soy sauce mixture over top.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In pan, top crispy rice with mushrooms, spinach, and pickled carrots (draining first) in separate sections.Garnish with scallion greens and crispy fried onions. Drizzle spicy mayo on top, and serve directly from pan.Top crispy rice with shrimp, along with mushrooms, spinach, and pickles (draining first) in separate sections.

title: Zucchini & Mushroom Bibimbap Bowls
subtitle: with Sweet Sesame Sauce & a Fried Egg

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Trim and peel carrot. Using a peeler, shave carrot lengthwise into ribbons, rotating as you go, until you get to the core; discard core. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-moons. Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add ginger and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir in rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a small bowl, combine scallion whites, vinegar, and a pinch of salt; set aside to pickle. In a separate small bowl, combine sesame oil, soy sauce, 1 TBSP sugar (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and about half the Sriracha (save the rest for serving).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add carrot and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until just tender, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl. Add zucchini and another drizzle of oil to pan. Cook, stirring, until tender, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to bowl with carrot. Add mushrooms and another drizzle of oil to pan. Cook, stirring, until tender, 3-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to same bowl. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium heat. Once hot, crack eggs* into pan and cover. (For 4 servings, you may want to cook eggs in batches.) Fry eggs to preference. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; season with salt and pepper. Divide rice between bowls; arrange carrot, zucchini, and mushrooms on top. Top each bowl with a fried egg and pickled scallion whites (draining first). Drizzle with sweet sesame sauce and remaining Sriracha to taste. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.body: Serve pasta, salad, and toasts family style.

instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Zest and quarter lime. instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine Blackening Spice, half the garlic-ginger scallion paste, 2 tsp salt (4 tsp for 4 servings), and a large drizzle of oil. Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; place on a baking sheet. Rub blackening paste all over chicken, making sure to coat undersides. Roast chicken, skin side up, on middle rack until browned and cooked through, 35-45 minutes. Let rest at least 5 minutes. TIP: To ensure chicken is cooked through, insert a thermometer into the innermost part of the thigh and breast (avoiding any bones).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While chicken roasts, thoroughly shake coconut milk in container before opening. In a small pot, combine rice, coconut milk, ⅔ cup water (1 cup for 4 servings), a pinch of sugar, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-20 minutes. TIP: If rice seems dry, add another 2 TBSP water and continue cooking, covered, until water has absorbed. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

Microwave until bell pepper is slightly tender, 1-2 minutes. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Brush half the mango-lime BBQ sauce onto chicken. Fluff rice with a fork; stir in scallion greens and remaining garlic-ginger scallion paste. title: One-Pan Indian-Style Organic Chicken Curry
subtitle: with Cauliflower, Creamy Coconut Sauce & Cashews

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Cut cauliflower into bite-size pieces. Roughly chop cashews.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add cauliflower; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to brown, 2-4 minutes. While cauliflower cooks, rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels. To pan with cauliflower, add another drizzle of oil, shrimp, tomato paste, curry powder, and garam masala. Season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Thoroughly shake coconut milk in container before opening. Add coconut milk and ⅔ cup water (1⅓ cups for 4 servings) to pan with shrimp and cauliflower. Stir until combined; cover and cook until curry is reduced and creamy and cauliflower is tender, 3-5 minutes. Add peas, two packets of sour cream, and ½ tsp salt (four packets of sour cream and 1 tsp salt for 4). Cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are warmed through, about 1 minute more. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Divide curry between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide curry between bowls. Drizzle with remaining sour cream and garnish with cashews. Serve.

title: Samoan Stewed Organic Chicken
subtitle: with Toasted Coconut Rice

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a medium dry pan over medium heat, toast coconut, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 4-5 minutes. TIP: Watch carefully to avoid burning. Turn off heat; transfer coconut to a small bowl. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ½-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ½-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions. In a second small bowl, combine half the cornstarch and 2 TBSP water (all the cornstarch and 4 TBSP water for 4 servings). In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, stock concentrate, garlic-ginger scallion paste, half the vinegar, ¾ cup water, and 1 TBSP sugar (all the vinegar, 1¼ cups water, and 2 TBSP sugar for 4).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for coconut over medium-high heat. Add chicken; season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer chicken to a plate.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in same pan over medium heat. Add bell pepper and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Add sauce and cook for 1 minute. Stir in chicken and cornstarch mixture and cook until thickened, 30-60 seconds more. Turn off heat. Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; stir in toasted coconut, 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and a pinch of sugar. Divide rice and chicken stew between shallow bowls. Top with scallions and serve.

instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Remove half the wonton wrappers (all for 4 servings) from package. TIP: Extra wonton wrappers freeze well for up to three months! Separate wonton triangles into a pile and cover with a clean kitchen towel.

instructions_json.body: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. title: Prep & Bake Pesto Barramundi & Salad
subtitle: Includes recyclable aluminum tray

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Halve tomato lengthwise and thinly slice crosswise into half-moons.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Reserve half the pesto in a small bowl for serving. Pat barramundi* dry with paper towels and season all over with salt and pepper. Add a drizzle of oil to oven-ready tray, then add barramundi, skin sides down, spacing evenly. (For 4 servings, add a drizzle of oil to each tray and divide barramundi between trays.) Spread tops of barramundi with a thin layer of remaining pesto. Roast on top rack (be sure your oven has preheated!) until barramundi is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. (For 4, bake two trays side by side on top rack.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: When barramundi has a few minutes remaining, in a large bowl, combine mustard, vinegar, 1 tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp sugar, salt, and pepper (2 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp sugar for 4 servings); whisk until smooth. Add mixed greens, scallions, and tomato; toss until evenly coated. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Divide salad between plates; top with almonds and barramundi. Drizzle with reserved pesto and serve.

title: Tom Yum Gai Chicken Soup
subtitle: with Thai Chili, Lemongrass & Jasmine Rice

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Thinly slice chili, removing seeds for less heat. Small dice tomato. Zest and quarter lime. Finely chop cilantro leaves and stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat. Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Add to pot along with ginger, garlic, mushrooms, and as much chili as you like. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken begins to brown and mushrooms begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add tomato, lemongrass puree, fish sauce, and 2 cups water (4 cups for 4 servings) to pot. Stir in stock concentrates and ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4). Bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is fully cooked, 3-4 minutes. Turn off heat; stir in lime zest and juice from two lime wedges (four wedges for 4 servings).

subtitle: with Zucchini, Feta & Harissa Lemon Chickpea Smash

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2

Wash and dry bowl used for panko.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss zucchini on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, spread zucchini out across entire sheet.) Place chicken, coated sides up, on empty side of sheet (for 4, place chicken on a second sheet; roast zucchini on top rack and chicken on middle rack). Roast on top rack until zucchini is tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In bowl used for panko, combine lemon zest, mayonnaise, remaining Shawarma Spice Blend, juice from one lemon wedge (two wedges for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Set aside until ready to serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

Stir in chickpeas and their liquid. Bring to a simmer, then turn off heat. Mash with a potato masher or fork until almost smooth. (TIP: It’s OK if there are still some larger chickpea pieces.) Taste and season with salt and pepper. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Shawarma-Spiced Shrimp Pitas
subtitle: with Garlic Sauce, Pickled Radishes & Mixed Greens with Feta

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice radishes. Trim ends from cucumber; using a peeler, shave cucumber lengthwise into ribbons, rotating as you go, until you get to the seedy core; discard core. Open and drain tofu; press out excess water with paper towels. Halve crosswise, then stand tofu upright and halve vertically. Lay flat and cut into ¾-inch cubes. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, garlic powder, 1 tsp water (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. (You’ll finish the sauce in Step 5.)

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine radishes, vinegar, 2 TBSP water, 2 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt (4 TBSP water and 4 tsp sugar for 4 servings). Microwave until radishes are softened, 30-60 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add tofu and cook, undisturbed, until lightly browned on bottom, 2-3 minutes. Add a large drizzle of oil, half the Shawarma Spice Blend (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is evenly browned, 2-3 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, toss together mixed greens, Greek vinaigrette, salt, and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To bowl with garlic mayo, add 2 tsp radish pickling liquid (4 tsp for 4 servings). Stir to combine. Wrap pitas in damp paper towels; microwave until warmed and pliable, 20-30 seconds. Divide wraps and salad between plates. Top salad with feta and serve. Divide wraps and salad between plates. Top salad with feta and serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide pitas and salad between plates; arrange tofu across the center of each pita. Top with cucumber ribbons and pickled radishes (draining first). Drizzle with garlic sauce and hot sauce if desired. Top salad with feta and serve. Add tofu in a line across the middle of each pita. Top with shaved cucumbers and pickled radishes (draining first). Drizzle with garlic sauce and hot sauce if desired. Divide wraps and salad between plates. Top salad with feta and serve.

title: Shawarma-Spiced Turkey Lettuce Wraps with Turkey
subtitle: with Tomato, Garlicky White Sauce, Almonds & Hot Sauce

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice half the onion; finely dice remaining half. Quarter lemons. Trim and discard root end from lettuce; separate leaves. Dice tomato.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine sliced onion, juice from one lemon, ½ tsp sugar, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, use juice from two lemons and 1 tsp sugar.) Microwave for 30 seconds; set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally.In a separate small bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, ¾ tsp garlic powder (1½ tsp for 4), and a squeeze of lemon juice. (You’ll use the rest of the garlic powder in the next step.) Season white sauce with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes.Add turkey*, Shawarma Spice Blend, and remaining garlic powder; generously season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.Stir in stock concentrates and ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4 servings), then reduce heat to medium low and simmer, scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pan, until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. TIP: Stir in a splash of water near the end of cooking to make sure your turkey is nice and saucy!

instructions_json.title: Divide lettuce between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide lettuce between plates. Fill with turkey, tomato, and as much pickled onion as you like (draining first). Drizzle wraps with white sauce and as much hot sauce as you like; sprinkle with almonds. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: XL Shawarma Organic Chicken & Turmeric Rice Bake
subtitle: 2x the portions for family dinner or leftovers

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Coat an 8-by-8-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray (for 8 servings, use a 9-by-13-inch baking dish or two 8-by-8-inch baking dishes). In a small pot (medium pot for 8), melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 8) over medium heat. Stir in half the turmeric (all for 8); cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in rice, 1½ cups water (2¾ cups for 8), Vidalia onion paste, and a pinch of salt. Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to use.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce. Quarter lemon. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Trim and discard root end of lettuce, then quarter lengthwise; lay each quarter flat side down and thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Quarter tomatoes. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream, half the garlic powder, lemon juice to taste (squeeze in as much as you like), salt, and pepper. TIP: If needed, add water a bit at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan (large pot for 8 servings) over medium-high heat. Add onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp* under cold water; pat very dry with paper towels. Add shrimp to pan with onion. Season with Shawarma Spice Blend and remaining garlic powder. Turn off heat and stir together (the shrimp will finish cooking in the oven!). Fluff rice with a fork and transfer to prepared baking dish. Top with shrimp mixture, then sprinkle with feta.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Bake shrimp and rice on top rack until shrimp are cooked through and feta is slightly softened, 12-15 minutes. Let shrimp and rice bake rest at least 2 minutes before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Top shrimp and rice bake with lettuce, tomatoes, and as much lemon-garlic sauce as you like. Serve family style with any remaining lemon wedges and lemon-garlic sauce on the side. TIP: If you enjoy hot sauce, this dish is asking for it!

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces. Halve cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice into half-moons.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, place kale in a large bowl; add a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt. Using your hands, massage kale (similar to how you would knead dough) until leaves are tender, 30-60 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Heat a large dry pan over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat a large dry pan over medium heat. Add half the Shawarma Spice Blend and toast, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds. instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While chicken cooks, to bowl with toasted Shawarma Spice Blend, add minced shallot, yogurt, mayonnaise, half the vinegar, 2 TBSP olive oil, and ½ tsp sugar (use all the vinegar, 4 TBSP olive oil, and 1 tsp sugar for 4 servings). Whisk until smooth; taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Slice chicken crosswise

title: Chicken Gyro Couscous Bowls
subtitle: with Hummus, Tomato-Cucumber Salad, and Creamy Feta Sauce

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Halve and peel shallot; thinly slice half the shallot and mince remaining. Fill a small bowl with cold water; add sliced shallot and let soak. (TIP: This helps mellow its sharp bite.) Quarter tomatoes. Trim and dice cucumber. Zest and quarter lemon (quarter both lemons for 4 servings). Pick and finely chop fronds from dill.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Drain sliced shallot and place in a medium bowl. Toss with tomatoes, cucumber, juice from half the lemon, a drizzle of olive oil, and 1 TBSP dill (2 TBSP for 4). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add minced shallot; cook until softened, 1-2 minutes. Add couscous and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until toasted, 2-3 minutes. Add ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4) and stock concentrate. Bring to a boil; cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until couscous is tender, 6-8 minutes. Drain any excess water, if necessary. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Keep covered off heat.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels; season all over with ½ tsp Za’atar Spice (1 tsp for 4 servings; we sent more), salt, and pepper. Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. (TIP: Work in batches, if necessary.) Transfer chicken to a cutting board. When cool enough to handle, thinly slice crosswise.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While chicken cooks, in a second small bowl, combine feta, sour cream, and lemon zest to taste; mash together with a fork. (TIP: If the feta is cold, massage in the bag first to soften.) Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. (It’s okay if the sauce isn’t completely smooth.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread hummus on one side of each serving bowl. Fluff couscous with a fork; divide between bowls next to hummus. Top couscous with chicken. Drain excess liquid from salad; arrange over hummus. Drizzle everything with feta sauce. Garnish with remaining dill if desired. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Chicken Gyro Salad
subtitle: with Tzatziki Dressing, Heirloom Tomatoes, and Cucumber

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Prep and cook the bulgur: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat the broiler (or grill) to high or oven to 500 degrees. Bring 1 cup water and a large pinch of salt to a boil in a small pot. Mince or grate the garlic. Zest and halve the lemon. Finely chop the oregano leaves. Add the bulgur to the boiling water, cover, and reduce to a low simmer for about 15 minutes, until tender. Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss the chicken in a large bowl with the paprika, a drizzle of olive oil, half the garlic, half the lemon zest, and half the oregano. Season generously with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Place the chicken on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Place under the broiler for 12-15 minutes, until slightly charred and cooked through. Let rest 3-4 minutes. TIP: The chicken can also be cooked on a grill!

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Grate 1 cucumber (about ¼ cup) with a box grater. In a small bowl, combine the grated cucumber, yogurt, a drizzle of olive oil, the remaining oregano and lemon zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of garlic (to taste). Season generously with salt and pepper. Thin to a pourable consistency with about 1 Tablespoon water.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice the romaine into ½-inch pieces. Halve the grape tomatoes. Halve, peel, and thinly slice the shallot. Thinly slice the remaining cucumber into rounds. Thinly slice the olives. Once rested, thinly slice the chicken.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Finish: Fluff the bulgur with a fork and season with salt and pepper. Plate the bulgur, then top with the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and shallot. Add the sliced chicken, drizzle on some tzatziki dressing, and enjoy!

title: Greek Gyro Skewers
subtitle: with Roasted Zucchini, Baked Pita Chips, and Cucumber Tzatziki

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and widthwise, then cut into ½-inch spears (like pickles). Mince or grate the garlic. Grate the shallot into a medium bowl. Peel and grate half the cucumber (you'll need about 1/4 cup) into a small bowl. Finely chop the mint. Halve the lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss the zucchini on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Place in the oven for 15-20 minutes, flipping once, until golden brown. Finish with a squeeze of lemon over the top.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Make the meat mixture: Add the ground beef, oregano, panko, 1 Tablespoon yogurt, half the garlic, and half the mint to the bowl with the shallot. Season with salt (we used ½ teaspoon kosher salt) and pepper. Thoroughly combine and form into 4 oval logs.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the beef logs to the pan. Cook 3-4 minutes, rotating to brown on all sides. Skewer each log lengthwise. Place onto the baking sheet with the zucchini. Bake 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Cut the pitas into wedges before tossing on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Bake about 10 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and crispy. TIP: Check on the pita chips after 5 minutes to make sure they don’t burn.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Make the tzatziki and serve: Add the remaining yogurt, a squeeze of lemon, the remaining mint, and a pinch of garlic (to taste) to the bowl with the cucumber. Season with salt and pepper. Slice the remaining cucumber into half moons. Serve the gyro skewers, pita chips, cucumber slices, and roasted zucchini with the tzatziki for dipping. Enjoy!

title: Mediterranean Za’atar Tofu Bowls
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Open and drain tofu; press out excess water with paper towels. Halve crosswise, then stand tofu upright and halve vertically. Lay flat and cut into ¾-inch cubes. Halve tomatoes. Roughly chop or tear apart artichokes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, toss tofu and pepitas with a drizzle of olive oil, Za’atar Spice, salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add seasoned tofu and pepitas. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is lightly browned and pepitas are toasted, 3-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, massage grain blend in package to separate grains; partially open package. Microwave until warmed through, 1½-2 minutes. Transfer grain blend to bowl used for tofu. Add kale, tomatoes, olives, artichokes, honey garlic sauce, feta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine until kale is slightly wilted.

instructions_json.title: Divide grain salad between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide grain salad between bowls. Top with tofu and pepitas and drizzle with tzatziki. Serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Mediterranean Veggie Pitzas with Feta & Balsamic
subtitle: plus Za’atar-Spiced Sun-Dried Tomato Sauce & Arugula Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to low broil. Wash and dry produce. Core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ½-inch pieces. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch-thick quarter-moons. Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-moons.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and zucchini; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-7 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer veggies to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add sun-dried tomatoes and tomato paste; cook until tomato paste is brick red and fragrant, 30-60 seconds. Add ½ cup water, Za’atar Spice, garlic powder, ½ tsp sugar, salt, and pepper (1 cup water and 1 tsp sugar for 4 servings). Cook, stirring frequently, until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place pitas on a lightly oiled baking sheet (divide between two sheets for 4 servings). Evenly spread with sauce; top with bell pepper and zucchini and feta. Broil pitzas on middle rack until cheese melts and edges are golden brown, 4-6 minutes. (For 4, broil pitzas on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.) Transfer to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While pitzas broil, in a large bowl, toss cucumber and arugula with vinaigrette, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Drizzle pitzas with as much balsamic glaze as you like. When cool enough to handle, cut into wedges. Divide pitzas and salad between plates and serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Mediterranean Chicken & Bell Pepper Pizzas
subtitle: with Hummus, Tzatziki, Fresh Dill & Lemon

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 475 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Remove each piece of dough from packaging and place on a plate. Drizzle both pieces with olive oil; shape each piece into a ball. TIP: Rub your hands with nonstick cooking spray or olive oil to prevent sticking.Evenly sprinkle another drizzle of olive oil over dough balls. Cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ½-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and thinly slice shallot. Roughly chop dill fronds and stems. Zest and quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and shallot; cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften, 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add chicken*, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Turn off heat. Add half the dill and juice from half the lemon; stir to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, line a baking sheet (two sheets for 4 servings) with parchment paper. Carefully press and stretch each dough ball into a rough oval shape and place on one side of prepared sheet (you’ll have two ovals per sheet). TIP: If needed, use a rolling pin to help roll out dough.Cover dough with a clean kitchen towel; let rest 15 minutes more. TIP: This will make stretching the dough into a larger shape even easier!

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 15 minutes, using oiled hands, press and stretch dough on baking sheet into larger oval shapes, about 10 inches long and 5-6 inches wide. Spread dough with hummus; sprinkle with mozzarella. Top with as much seasoned chicken and veggies as you like. Drizzle or brush edges of dough with olive oil; season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Bake pizzas on top rack until crusts are golden brown and crisp, 14-18 minutes. (For 4 servings, bake on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Drizzle pizzas with tzatziki and hot sauce to taste. Garnish with lemon zest and remaining dill.Slice pizzas as desired. Divide between plates and serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Roasted Bavette Steak & Garlic Herb Potatoes
subtitle: with Roasted Carrot, Zucchini, Red Onion & Feta

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Trim and cut zucchini on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick rounds. Halve, peel, and cut onion into ½-inch-thick wedges.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, garlic powder, half the Mediterranean Spice Blend (all for 4 servings), and salt. TIP: Line sheet with parchment paper or foil for easy cleanup! Toss carrots, zucchini, and onion on empty side of sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack for 5 minutes (veggies will finish roasting in next step).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While veggies roast, pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season with a drizzle of oil, half the Fry Seasoning (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Place on a second lightly oiled baking sheet. Once veggies have roasted 5 minutes, carefully transfer sheet with veggies to middle rack. Place sheet with chicken on top rack. Roast until veggies are browned and tender and chicken is cooked through, 18-22 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Transfer carrots, zucchini, and onion to a large bowl. Add feta and toss to combine. Transfer chicken to a cutting board; slice crosswise. Divide chicken, veggie jumble, and potatoes between plates. Serve.

title: Mediterranean Chicken & Couscous Bar
subtitle: Build your way to the perfect plate

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim and slice zucchini crosswise into ½-inch-thick rounds. Dice tomato into ¼ inch pieces. Quarter lemon. Roughly chop dill.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss zucchini on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until lightly browned and tender, 14-16 minutes. TIP: If you added any other items to your meal (apps, sides, and/or dessert), you can get started on them now!

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While zucchini roasts, in a small pot combine couscous, stock concentrates, and 1½ cups water (3 cups water and a medium pot for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until tender, 8-10 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While couscous cooks, open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken, half the oregano (all for 4 servings), half the garlic powder, a pinch of salt, and pepper. (You’ll use the rest of the garlic powder in the next step.) Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine tomato, juice from half the lemon, a drizzle of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and pepper.In a separate small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, sour cream, and remaining garlic powder. Add water 1 teaspoon at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Serve zucchini, couscous, chicken, tomato salad, garlic sauce, dill, almonds, and remaining lemon wedges family style and let everyone build their own bowls. TIP: Dash with your favorite hot sauce if you like things spicy. Don’t forget to serve with any extra items you may have ordered to build out your meal!

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: XL Mediterranean Pork Chilaquiles
subtitle: 2x the portions for family dinner or leftovers

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Finely chop parsley. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Roughly chop olives. Stack tortillas; cut into 6 equal wedges (you’ll have a total of 36 wedges; 72 for 4). In a small bowl, combine parsley, scallion greens, half the tomato, half the olives, and a large drizzle of olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss tortillas on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil. Bake on top rack, rotating sheet halfway through, until crisped, 5-10 minutes. (For 4 servings, divide tortillas between two baking sheets and roast on top and middle racks, rotating sheets and swapping rack positions halfway through.) Transfer crispy tortillas to a plate until ready to use in Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While tortillas bake, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork* and scallion whites. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To pan with pork, stir in romesco, remaining tomato, remaining olives, and ½ cup water (1 cup for 4 servings); cook, tossing, until well combined, 2-3 minutes. Turn off heat. (For 4, transfer mixture to a 9-by-13-inch baking dish and assemble in baking dish.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, crack eggs* into pan and fry to preference. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add crispy tortillas to pan with romesco pork and gently toss to coat. Top with fried eggs and garnish with feta, tomato-olive mixture, and as much hot sauce as you like. Serve chilaquiles family style directly from pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

title: Tuscan White Pizzas with Chicken Sausage

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings); preheat oven to 475 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Drizzle olive oil over a clean work surface. Remove pizza dough from packaging; place on oiled surface. Shape each piece into a ball. (TIP: Spray your hands with nonstick cooking spray to prevent sticking.) Evenly coat top of dough with a large drizzle of olive oil.Cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, line a baking sheet (two sheets for 4 servings) with parchment paper. Carefully press and stretch each dough ball into a rough oval shape and place on one side of prepared sheet (you’ll have two dough ovals per sheet). instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. When hot, add sausage*. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer sausage to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Return pan used for chicken to medium heat
instructions_json.body: Return pan used for chicken to medium heat. Add cream sauce base, cream cheese, remaining Tuscan Heat Spice, and 1½ TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings); whisk until smooth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, 2-3 minutes.Turn off heat; grate half the Parmesan into white sauce.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 15 minutes, using oiled hands, press and stretch on sheet into larger oval shapes, about 10 inches long and 5-6 inches wide. Evenly spread dough with white sauce; grate remaining Parmesan over top. Top with as much sausage as you like. Brush edges of dough with olive oil. instructions_json.title: Meanwhile, wash and dry pan used for sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Top pizzas with dollops of basil paste, honey, and crispy prosciutto.Slice pizzas as desired. Divide between plates and serve.

instructions_json.title: Add BBQ sauce mixture to pan with tofu
instructions_json.body: Add BBQ sauce mixture to pan with tofu. Cook, stirring, until tofu is coated and sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes.Remove pan from heat; sprinkle pepper jack over tofu and cover pan. Set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.body: Divide tofu subs between plates. Serve with potato wedges and garlic-lime mayo for dipping.

title: Organic Chicken with Garlic-Sage Gravy
subtitle: plus Mashed Sweet Potatoes, Candied Pecans & Brussels Sprouts

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Arrange rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice sweet potatoes into ½-inch pieces.Place sweet potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 10-12 minutes. Reserve ½ cup sweet potato cooking liquid, then drain and return sweet potatoes to pot. Cover to keep warm until ready to mash in Step 5.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While sweet potatoes cook, trim and halve Brussels sprouts (quarter any larger sprouts). Peel and mince or grate garlic. Pick sage leaves from stems and mince.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until golden brown and tender, 15-20 minutes. TIP: Tent sprouts with foil to keep warm until ready to serve. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add 2 TBSP water, brown sugar, ¼ tsp cinnamon, and a pinch of salt (4 TBSP water and ½ tsp cinnamon for 4 servings); whisk to combineStir in pecans and cook, stirring constantly, until pecans are fragrant and glazed, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Pat turkey* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat turkey* dry with paper towels. Season all over with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for pecans over medium-high heat. Add turkey and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-8 minutes per side. TIP: Cook in batches if necessary; reduce heat and cover pan if turkey begins to brown too quickly. Transfer turkey to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Mash sweet potatoes with sour cream, 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings), salt, and pepper until smooth and creamy, adding splashes of reserved sweet potato cooking liquid as needed. TIP: If you like a sweeter mash, stir in a pinch of white sugar!Cover and set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Melt 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in a medium pan over medium heat. Add garlic and half the sage. Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.Add flour and cook, whisking, until flour is lightly browned, 1 minute.Stir in stock concentrates and ¾ cup water (1¼ cups for 4). Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring frequently, until slightly thickened, 2-4 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Slice turkey crosswise
instructions_json.body: Slice turkey crosswise.Divide turkey, sweet potatoes, and Brussels sprouts between plates. Garnish sweet potatoes with pecans. Drizzle turkey with as much gravy as you like and garnish with remaining sage. Serve with any remaining gravy on the side.

instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and carrots; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are lightly browned and slightly softened, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Peel garlic and place whole cloves in the center of a small piece of foil; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Cinch into a packet. Quarter Roma tomatoes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: On a foil-lined baking sheet, toss grape tomatoes and quartered Roma tomatoes with a large drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread out in an even layer. Add garlic packet to sheet. Roast on top rack until tomatoes are lightly browned and garlic is tender, 20-25 minutes.Meanwhile, halve, peel, and dice onion into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Melt 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in a medium pot (large pot for 4) over medium heat. Add onion and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-8 minutes.Stir in basil paste, stock concentrates, and roasted onion and garlic spread. Add ½ cup water (1 cup for 4), marinara, and cream sauce base; stir to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Reduce heat under pot to medium low; cover and cook, stirring occasionally, while tomatoes and garlic roast.Once tomatoes and garlic are done, carefully remove garlic packet from baking sheet. Transfer roasted tomatoes to pot with soup. Carefully remove roasted garlic from foil and stir into pot.Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Using an immersion blender, blend soup directly in pot until smooth, 2-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. TIP: Don’t have an immersion blender? Carefully transfer soup to a blender or food processor. Pulse until smooth, then transfer back to pot. Cover soup with lid and keep warm over low heat until ready to serve.

TIP: Work in batches if necessary; lower heat if browning too quickly.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Cut grilled cheese sandwiches into 1-inch cubes.Divide roasted tomato and garlic bisque between bowls. Top with grilled cheese croutons. Serve. TIP: If you like your soup with a spicy kick, garnish with chili flakes or your favorite hot sauce!

title: Rib-Eye au Poivre & Garlic Herb Potatoes
subtitle: Bring elevated, restaurant-style flavors to your kitchen

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Halve potatoes lengthwise (leave any smaller spuds whole); toss on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, half the Fry Seasoning (you’ll use the rest later), salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While potatoes roast, place peppercorns in a zip-close bag and crush with a heavy-bottomed pan or rolling pin. Halve, core, and thinly slice apple. Finely chop chives.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Pat rib-eye steak* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat rib-eye steak* dry with paper towels. Season all over with remaining Fry Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook to desired doneness, 3-5 minutes per side for medium-rare. (TIP: If steak begins to brown too quickly, reduce heat to medium.) Turn off heat; transfer to a plate to rest. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Heat pan used for steak over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat pan used for steak over medium heat. Add demi-glace, mustard, ½ tsp crushed peppercorns (be sure to measure—we sent more!), and ¼ cup water (1 tsp crushed peppercorns and ⅓ cup water for 4 servings). Bring to a simmer, then cook, stirring, until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 tbsp plain butter (2 tbsp for 4) until melted. (TIP: If sauce seems too thick, stir in a splash of water.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, toss together mixed greens, apple, walnuts, half the blue cheese, and as much dressing as you like.Once potatoes are done cooking, transfer to a separate large bowl; toss with garlic herb butter and chives.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide rib-eye steak, salad, and garlic herb potatoes between plates. Drizzle steak with peppercorn sauce. Garnish salad with remaining blue cheese. Serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Garlicky Fried Tofu Sandwiches
subtitle: with Honey Mustard Mayo & Roasted Carrots

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim, peel, and cut carrots into sticks (like fries; ours were 3 inches long and ⅓ inch thick). Halve buns. In a shallow dish, combine panko, garlic powder, salt (we used 1 tsp; 2 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss carrots on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of olive oil. Season generously with salt and pepper.Roast on top rack until lightly browned and tender, 15-20 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; place between two large pieces of plastic wrap. Pound with a mallet or rolling pin until chicken is about ½ inch thick. Season all over with salt and pepper.Brush chicken all over with sour cream. Working one piece at a time, press chicken into panko mixture until fully coated on both sides.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot enough that a pinch of panko mixture sizzles when added to the pan, add coated chicken. Cook until crust is golden brown and chicken is cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. (TIP: Fry in batches if necessary; lower heat if chicken begins to brown too quickly.) Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate.AIR FRYER ALTERNATIVE: Coat an air fryer basket with cooking spray; arrange coated chicken side by side in basket. Coat tops of chicken with cooking spray. Air fry at 390 degrees for 6 minutes. Flip chicken and coat again with cooking spray; air fry until cooked through and crispy, 6 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey Dijon dressing, and hot sauce to taste (we used the whole packet). Season with salt and pepper.Toast buns until golden brown.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread top buns with as much honey mustard mayo as you like. Fill buns with chicken. Divide sandwiches and carrots between plates. Serve with any remaining honey mustard mayo on the side for dipping.

title: Hot Honey Pepperoni Strombolis
subtitle: with Italian-Dressed Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on baking sheet to coat all over. Place dough balls on sheet at least three inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle (the dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!).Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make the following step easier!).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, evenly sprinkle each dough rectangle with mozzarella, leaving a ½-inch border around edges. Top with pepperoni. Drizzle hot honey in a single lengthwise layer across middle of dough.Starting with one of the long sides, gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one of the dough rectangles. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log. Arrange strombolis, seam sides down, on baking sheet; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: With a sharp knife, gently cut three small, shallow diagonal slits along the top of each stromboli. Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes (for 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, switching rack positions halfway through).

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When strombolis have about 5 minutes remaining, in a medium bowl, toss mixed greens with dressing until evenly coated.

instructions_json.title: Halve each stromboli crosswise
instructions_json.body: Halve each stromboli crosswise.Serve strombolis with marinara and salad on the side.

instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to middle and top positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Dice sweet potato into ½-inch pieces. Trim and halve mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Halve, peel, and cut onion into ½-inch-thick wedges. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Zest and quarter lime. Peel and grate ginger.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, toss sweet potato, mushrooms, and onion on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, half the Fry Seasoning, salt, and pepper. (You’ll use the remaining Fry Seasoning in the next step.) Roast on middle rack for 5 minutes (you’ll start the zucchini then).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, toss zucchini on a second baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, remaining Fry Seasoning, and salt.Once veggies have roasted 5 minutes, place sheet with zucchini on top rack. Roast until everything is browned and tender, 15-20 minutes more.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine honey, miso sauce concentrate, a big squeeze of lime juice, and ginger to taste.In a separate small bowl, combine mayonnaise, chili sauce, and a squeeze of lime juice. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Once veggies and zucchini are done, combine on a baking sheet and toss with honey-miso dressing.Fluff rice with a fork; stir in lime zest and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt.Divide rice between shallow bowls or plates. Top with sweet potato and mushroom jumble. Drizzle with creamy chili sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

subtitle: plus Bell Pepper & Peanuts

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Using the tip of a spoon, remove and discard black gills from undersides of mushrooms; trim any large stems if necessary. Thinly slice mushrooms into strips (if strips are too long, cut them in half crosswise). Pat chicken dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Add onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Return chicken to pan. Stir in Szechuan sauce mixture; cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has reduced and slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot

instructions_json.title: While noodles cook, roughly chop peanuts

instructions_json.title: Divide lo mein between shallow bowls

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

ingredients_json.name: McCormick Grill Mates Brown Sugar Bourbon Seasoning

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Toss on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper.Roast on top rack until lightly browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.Let cool for at least 5 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces. Halve, core, and thinly slice half the apple (whole apple for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Place kale in a large bowl and lightly season with salt. Using your hands, massage kale (similar to how you would knead dough), until leaves are tender, 30-60 seconds. TIP: To make kale even more tender, add a drizzle of olive oil along with salt before massaging.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with McCormick Grill Mates Brown Sugar Bourbon Seasoning, salt, and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side.Transfer to a cutting board; let rest at least 5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Add cranberries, roasted carrots, and sliced apple to bowl with kale. Season with salt and pepper.Reserve a half packet of dressing (whole packet for 4 servings) in a small bowl for serving. Drizzle salad with remaining dressing to taste; toss to combine.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice chicken crosswise
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice chicken crosswise.Divide salad between bowls and top with chicken. Drizzle with reserved dressing. Sprinkle with sunflower seeds and serve.

title: Honey Mustard Roasted Half Chicken
subtitle: with Potato Wedges, Cheesy Broccoli & Smoky Mayo

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Cut potatoes into 1-inch-thick wedges. Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces if necessary.Toss potatoes on one side of a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, half the Fry Seasoning (you'll use the rest later), salt, and pepper (for 4, spread potatoes out across entire sheet).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Place 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave in 10-second bursts until softened (not melted!).Stir in dressing, garlic powder, and remaining Fry Seasoning.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season generously all over with salt and pepper (don't forget the underside!). TIP: See a feather? Simply grip the end with a paper towel and pull!Rub honey mustard butter all over chicken.Place chicken, skin side up, on opposite side of sheet from potatoes (for 4 servings, place chicken on a second sheet). Roast on middle rack until potatoes are tender and chicken is browned and cooked through, 35-45 minutes (for 4, roast chicken on middle rack and potatoes on top rack, swapping rack positions halfway through). TIP: To ensure chicken is cooked through, insert a thermometer into the innermost part of the thigh and breast (avoiding any bones). Once chicken is cooked, the bones may still appear pink—this is OK!Remove sheet from oven and let chicken rest for at least 5 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While potatoes and chicken roast, in a second small bowl, combine mayonnaise and smoky mustard.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once potatoes and chicken are done roasting, heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. Add broccoli, 2 TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Cover and cook until broccoli begins to soften, 1-3 minutes.Add a drizzle of oil to pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, 1-2 minutes more.Turn off heat; sprinkle Monterey Jack over broccoli and cover to melt, 30 seconds.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Transfer cheesy broccoli, potatoes, and chicken to a serving platter in separate sections. Serve family style with smoky mayo on the side.

subtitle: with Creamy Avocado & Mike's Hot Honey | 2 Servings

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add feta in four small piles (depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches); using a rubber spatula, form piles into rings about the size of a cracked egg.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
