title: Honey-Lemon Sirloin & Toasty Pistachio Salad
subtitle: with Apple & Shaved Parmesan

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Wash and dry produce.Zest lemons until you have ½ tsp zest (1 tsp for 4 servings). Halve lemons and squeeze juice into a small bowl. Halve, core, and cut apple into ¼-inch-thick slices; cut apple slices into ½-inch-thick matchsticks (make it easier on yourself by stacking a few slices at a time!). Using a peeler or grater, shave or grate Parmesan.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat sirloin steak* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Evenly top steak with lemon zest and half the honey. Use your fingers or the back of a spoon to rub the glaze evenly over top of steak. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak to pan and cook to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While steak cooks, heat 1½ TBSP olive oil (3 TBSP for 4 servings) and pistachios in a small pan over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until pistachios are deeply browned, fragrant, and starting to sizzle, 4-6 minutes. Transfer pistachios and olive oil to a large bowl to cool slightly.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To bowl with pistachios and olive oil, whisk in lemon juice, mustard, remaining honey, and 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4) to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To bowl with vinaigrette, add mixed greens, apple, and half the Parmesan. Toss until thoroughly coated.Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide salad between bowls and top with sliced steak. Garnish with remaining Parmesan and serve.

title: Prep & Bake Honey-Oregano Steak
subtitle: Includes recyclable aluminum trays

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Place sealed honey packets in a small bowl with enough hot water to cover (warming the honey helps make it pourable).Peel and gently smash garlic. Finely chop parsley.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In one oven-ready tray, combine tomatoes, smashed garlic, and ⅓ cup olive oil. Season with half the oregano (you’ll use the rest later), a big pinch of salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, divide ingredients evenly between two trays, using ⅓ cup olive oil and a big pinch of salt for each tray.)Roast on top rack (be sure your oven has preheated!) until tomatoes start to burst and garlic is fragrant and softened, 20-25 minutes. (For 4, roast two trays side by side on top rack.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While tomatoes bake, remove honey packets from bowl; pour out water. Wipe out bowl.In same bowl, combine honey, garlic powder, remaining oregano, a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper.When tomatoes have 10 minutes remaining, add salmon on top rack and bake for 8-10 minutes until skin is crisped and fish is cooked through. (For 4, transfer tomatoes to middle rack and bake salmon on top rack.)

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Pat salmon* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat salmon* dry with paper towels. Place, skin sides up, in remaining oven-ready tray; lightly season with salt and pepper. Pour honey mixture all over salmon. (For 4 servings, divide ingredients evenly between two remaining trays.)When tomatoes have 10 minutes remaining, place tray with glazed salmon on top rack next to tomatoes; roast until skin is crisped and fish is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. (For 4, transfer tomatoes to middle rack and roast two trays of salmon side by side on top rack.)

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When salmon and tomatoes are nearly done, massage grain blend in package to break up grains; partially open package.Microwave until warmed through, 1½-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Divide warmed grains between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide warmed grains between plates. Using a slotted spoon, top with tomatoes. Place salmon opposite tomatoes. Drizzle garlic oil from tray over grains. Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Figgy Apple & Turkey Picnic Sandos
subtitle: with Creamy Honey Mustard, Carrot Sticks & Hummus Dipper

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Halve, core, and thinly slice apple. TIP: If you have a lemon on hand, squeeze a few drops of juice on apple slices to prevent them from browning!Trim, peel, and cut carrots into sticks (like fries; ours were 3 inches long and ⅓ inch thick).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Open cream cheese packet and empty into a small microwave-safe bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave until softened, 30-45 seconds. TIP: No microwave? No problem! Submerge sealed cream cheese packet in a bowl of warm water to soften. Stir in dressing until combined.

instructions_json.title: Halve and toast ciabattas
instructions_json.body: Halve and toast ciabattas.Evenly spread creamy honey mustard on bottom ciabatta halves; spread jam on top ciabatta halves.Layer bottom ciabatta halves with apple and as much turkey as you like.Close to form sandos.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To serve: Divide sandos and carrot sticks between plates and serve with hummus on the side for dipping.To stash: Place two 10-inch pieces of parchment paper (four pieces for 4 servings) on a work surface with a long side facing you. Place a sando in the center of each piece of parchment. Working one at a time, fold up bottom side of parchment over sando, then fold left and right sides to the center. Carefully fold up sando in parchment until parchment seam is on the bottom. Halve wrapped sandos on a diagonal. (TIP: Use a serrated knife to easily cut through the parchment.) Refrigerate sandos, carrot sticks, and hummus in separate containers and pack as desired.

title: Honey Dijon Chicken & Kale Salad
subtitle: Now get 50% more protein per serving in this HelloFresh classic!

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces. Halve, core, and thinly slice apple. Place kale in a large bowl; season with a pinch of salt. Using your hands, massage kale with a large drizzle of olive oil (similar to how you would knead dough) until leaves are tender, 1-2 minutes. TIP: Don’t skip this step—massaging helps the kale leaves wilt slightly, lending a tender (never fibrous!) texture.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; place between two large pieces of plastic wrap. (TIP: Not sure how much chicken to use? Refer to the 'Before you start' section at left for guidance.) Pound with a mallet or rolling pin until chicken is about ½ inch thick. Season all over with garlic powder, half the thyme (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While chicken cooks, in a small bowl, whisk together honey Dijon dressing, mustard, and a drizzle of olive oil (large drizzle for 4 servings). Season lightly with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Slice chicken crosswise
instructions_json.body: Slice chicken crosswise. Add apple and Parmesan to bowl with kale. Toss with as much dressing as you like. Divide salad between shallow bowls or plates. Sprinkle with dried cranberries. Arrange chicken over top, drizzle with any remaining dressing, and serve.

title: Spicy Honey Garlic Lo Mein with Fried Eggs
subtitle: plus Kale, Carrots & Chili Crisp

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; cut into bite-size pieces if necessary. In a small bowl, combine honey garlic sauce, soy sauce, garlic powder, and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add noodles to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 5-7 minutes. Drain noodles and set aside until ready to use in Step 4. (Reserve pot.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pot used for noodles over medium-high heat (make sure pot is dry before adding oil!). Add scallion whites and carrots; cook, stirring constantly, until just beginning to soften, 1-3 minutes. Add kale; cook, stirring constantly, until wilted, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Reduce heat to medium and add drained noodles, sauce mixture, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) to pot; stir until everything is evenly coated. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When noodles are almost done, heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan over medium heat. (For 4 servings, use a large pan or fry eggs in batches.) Once hot, crack eggs* into pan and cover. Fry to preference. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Divide lo mein between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide lo mein between plates. Top each with a fried egg and as much chili crisp as you like. Garnish with scallion greens. Serve.

title: Roasted Chicken & Cheese-Stuffed Tomatoes
subtitle: with Mustard-Sherry Sauce & Garlic Mashed Potatoes

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Place in a large pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain and return to pot. Add garlic powder and 3 TBSP butter (6 TBSP for 4 servings) to pot with potatoes. Using a potato masher or fork, mash until smooth and creamy, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed. Season with salt and pepper. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: While potatoes cook, roughly chop parsley
instructions_json.body: While potatoes cook, roughly chop parsley. Halve tomatoes lengthwise; using a spoon, scoop out and discard insides. Halve, peel, and mince shallot. In a small bowl, combine cream cheese, half the sour cream, half the parsley, a pinch of salt, and pepper. In a separate small bowl, combine panko, ½ tsp herbes de Provence (1 tsp for 4 servings), a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. (Be sure to measure the herbes de Provence—we sent more!)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork; sear, turning occasionally, until browned all over, 4-6 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Place pork on one side of a baking sheet
instructions_json.body: Place pork on one side of a baking sheet. Toss tomatoes on empty side of sheet with a drizzle of olive oil. Arrange tomato halves cut sides up and fill with cream cheese mixture; evenly sprinkle with panko mixture. Roast on middle rack until pork is cooked through and tomatoes are tender, 8-10 minutes. Transfer pork to a cutting board and let rest at least 5 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While pork rests, heat a drizzle of olive oil in pan used for pork over medium heat. Add shallot and cook, stirring, until softened, 1-2 minutes. Stir in half the vinegar, stock concentrate, and ¼ cup water (all the vinegar and ⅓ cup water for 4 servings). Simmer until slightly reduced, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat. Stir in mustard, remaining sour cream, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice pork crosswise
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice pork crosswise. Divide pork, mashed potatoes, and cheese-stuffed tomatoes between plates. Top pork with sauce and garnish with remaining parsley. Serve.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Organic Chicken & Bacon Garlic Bread Sandos
subtitle: with Tomato, Potato Wedges & Smoky Mustard Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl; bring to room temperature. Wash and dry produce. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Thinly slice tomato into rounds; season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, ½ tsp Fry Seasoning, ½ tsp garlic powder, salt, and pepper (1 tsp Fry Seasoning and 1 tsp garlic powder for 4 servings). Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While potatoes roast, heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. Add bacon* and cook, turning occasionally and adjusting heat if browning too quickly, until crispy, 6-10 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate. Discard all but a thin layer of bacon fat from pan.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Pat organic chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with remaining Fry Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Heat pan with reserved bacon fat over medium-high heat. (If bacon did not yield enough fat, add a drizzle of oil.) Add organic chicken; cook until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side. (TIP: Lower heat if chicken begins to brown too quickly.) Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While chicken cooks, stir remaining garlic powder and a pinch of salt into bowl with softened butter until combined. (TIP: If butter is not yet softened, microwave in 10-second intervals until soft but not melted.) Halve buns; spread garlic butter on cut sides. Place buns, cut sides down, in pan used for chicken over medium-low heat. Toast, pressing down with a spatula, until golden brown, 1-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: While buns toast, in a second small bowl, combine mayonnaise, smoky mustard, and 1 tsp water (2 tsp for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Spread non-toasted sides of buns with a thin layer of smoky mustard sauce (the toasted sides will be on the outside!). Fill buns with chicken, bacon, and tomato. Divide sandwiches and potato wedges between plates. Serve with remaining smoky mustard sauce on the side for dipping.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: BBQ Pepperoni, Cheese & Bell Pepper Strombolis
subtitle: with Mixed Greens Ranch Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on baking sheet to coat all over with oil (divide dough balls between two baking sheets for 4). Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper; stir in scallion whites. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle. (The dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!) Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more. (This will make the following step easier!)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, evenly sprinkle each dough rectangle with mozzarella and cheddar, leaving a ½-inch border around edges. Top with bell pepper mixture and as much pepperoni as you like. Drizzle BBQ sauce in a single lengthwise layer across middle of dough. Starting with one of the long sides, gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one dough rectangle. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log with the filling enclosed. Arrange stromboli, seam side down, on baking sheet; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: With a sharp knife, gently cut three small, shallow diagonal slits along the top of each stromboli. Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes. (For 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When strombolis have about 5 minutes remaining, in a medium bowl, stir together half the ranch dressing and a squeeze of lemon juice (big squeeze for 4 servings). (Save remaining lemon wedges for another use.) Add mixed greens and scallion greens to bowl; toss until evenly coated.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Halve strombolis crosswise
instructions_json.body: Halve strombolis crosswise. Divide strombolis and salad between plates. Serve with remaining ranch dressing on the side for dipping.

title: BBQ-Spiced Steak & Arugula-Peach Salad
subtitle: with Tomato & Sherry-Dijon Vinaigrette

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Place one garlic clove on a cutting board. Lay the broad side of your knife on top and gently press down with the heel of your hand to crush the clove; remove peel. Repeat with remaining garlic. Halve peach and remove pit; thinly slice. Halve tomato lengthwise; cut into ½-inch-thick half-moons. In a medium bowl, whisk together vinegar, honey, mustard, and 2 TBSP olive oil (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat trout* dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium heat. Add trout, skin sides down. Cook until skin is crispy, 5-6 minutes. Flip and cook until opaque and almost cooked through, 3-5 minutes more. In the last minute of cooking, add crushed garlic, BBQ Seasoning, and 3 TBSP butter (6 TBSP for 4 servings). Carefully tilt pan so butter pools on one side. Using a large spoon, spoon hot butter over trout until coated and cooked through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, combine arugula, peach, and tomato. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle with as much vinaigrette as you like. Toss to coat.

instructions_json.title: Divide trout and salad between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide trout and salad between plates. Drizzle trout with as much remaining butter from pan as you like. Serve.

title: Chipotle Chicken & Cheddar Melts
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Drain corn; pat dry with paper towels. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Roughly chop cilantro. Quarter lime.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add corn; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 3-5 minutes. (Cover pan with lid if corn begins to pop.) Turn off heat; transfer corn to a large bowl. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Open package of chicken* and drain off any excess liquid. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for corn over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper, chicken, Southwest Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is lightly browned and bell pepper is slightly softened, 4-5 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a second large bowl. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To bowl with chicken mixture, add chipotle puree and cream cheese. Stir to combine. Spoon chicken mixture over half the sourdough slices; top with cheddar. Close with remaining sourdough slices to form sandwiches.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Melt 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) and a drizzle of oil in pan used for chicken over medium heat. Carefully add sandwiches (work in batches if necessary, adding more butter as needed; lower heat if browning too quickly). Cook, gently pressing down with a spatula, until bread is golden and cheese melts, 2-4 minutes per side (add another 1 TBSP butter when flipping; 2 TBSP for 4).

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: To bowl with corn, add coleslaw mix, cilantro, dressing, juice from half the lime, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat. Halve sandwiches on a diagonal and divide betewen plates along with slaw. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Halve squash lengthwise; scoop out and discard seeds with a spoon. Cut squash crosswise into ¾-inch-thick slices. Trim and halve Brussels sprouts. Zest and quarter lemon. Roughly chop pecans.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small microwave-safe bowl, add 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Microwave until completely melted, 45-60 seconds.Toss squash and Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet with melted butter, garlic powder, and a big pinch of salt and pepper. Roast on top rack, flipping veggies halfway through, until golden brown and tender, 20-25 minutes. (For 4, divide between two sheets; roast on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While veggies roast, in a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine maple syrup, honey, ⅛ tsp chipotle powder (¼ tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. (Be sure to measure the chipotle powder—we sent more!) Microwave for 20 seconds, then set aside.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Trim and mince scallions
instructions_json.body: Trim and mince scallions. Peel and mince garlic.In a third small bowl, combine scallions, garlic, half the lemon zest (all for 4 servings), 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4), and a pinch of salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Pat steak* dry with paper towels; season generously all over with salt and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook until browned on one side, 4-6 minutes. Flip steak; reduce heat to medium low and cook for 2 minutes more.Add 4 TBSP butter (6 TBSP for 4 servings) and cook until foamy. Tilt pan slightly towards the handle and spoon melted butter over steak, repeating often, until steak reaches desired doneness, 2-4 minutes.Transfer steak to a cutting board. Let rest for at least 5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: While steak cooks, in a medium bowl, whisk together ricotta, crème fraîche, a squeeze of lemon juice (two squeezes for 4 servings), 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4), and a pinch of salt and pepper until light and fluffy. Taste and season with more salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice steak against the grain
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice steak against the grain.Microwave chipotle syrup for 15 seconds.Spread whipped ricotta on one side of each plate. Pile roasted veggies over top; drizzle with as much chipotle syrup as you like. Garnish with pecans. Place steak next to veggies; top with 1 TBSP pan juices (2 TBSP for 4 servings) and gremolata. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Chipotle Tofu Tostadas
subtitle: with Guacamole, Lime Slaw & Pickled Red Onion

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Halve and peel onion. Thinly slice one half; finely chop remaining. Quarter lime. Dice tomato. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Drizzle tortillas with 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to coat all over. Arrange tortillas on a baking sheet in a single layer (divide between two baking sheets for 4). Gently prick each tortilla in a few places with a fork. Bake on top rack until lightly golden, 8-10 minutes, carefully flipping halfway through. (For 4, bake on top and middle racks, flipping and swapping rack positions halfway through.) TIP: Watch carefully to avoid burning.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine sliced onion, vinegar, a pinch of sugar, salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until onion is tender, 1-2 minutes. In a separate medium bowl, combine coleslaw mix, mayonnaise, juice from one lime wedge (two wedges for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. In a small bowl, combine tomato, cilantro, juice from two lime wedges (four wedges for 4), a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Open and drain tofu; press out excess water with paper towels. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Once pan is hot, crumble tofu into small pieces directly into pan. Add chopped onion, Fajita Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Stir tofu mixture to combine. Cook, undisturbed, until lightly browned on the bottom, 2-3 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir tofu mixture, then cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is slightly softened and tofu is browned, 3-4 minutes. TIP: If pan seems dry, add another drizzle of oil. Stir in chipotle puree and ⅓ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings). Cook until thickened, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Divide crispy tortillas between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide crispy tortillas between plates. Top with tofu, slaw, pickled onion (draining first), guacamole, and tomato salsa. Serve tostadas with any remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Cuban-Spiced Steak & Creamy Gravy
subtitle: plus Roasted Chipotle-Lime Broccoli & Carrots

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces if necessary. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Halve, peel, and finely chop shallot. Quarter lime.Toss broccoli and carrots on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, half the garlic powder (all for 4 servings), salt, pepper, and as much chipotle powder as you like (we used ¼ tsp; ½ tsp for 4).Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 12-15 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While veggies roast, pat pork* dry with paper towels and season all over with half the Cuban Spice Blend (all for 4 servings).Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork; cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. TIP: Lower heat if pork begins to brown too quickly.Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board. Wipe out pan.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for pork over medium-low heat. Add shallot and cook, stirring, until lightly browned, 1-2 minutes.Add ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4 servings), stock concentrate, and cream cheese. Cook, whisking constantly, until gravy is smooth and has slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4). Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Slice pork crosswise
instructions_json.body: Slice pork crosswise.Divide pork and roasted veggies between plates. Spoon gravy over pork. Top veggies with a squeeze of lime juice. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Chipotle-Honey Steak & Jasmine Rice
subtitle: with Spinach Salad & Lime

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce.Zest and quarter lime. Trim, peel, and grate carrot on the largest holes of a box grater. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; cut into ¼-inch-thick half-moons.Reserve ½ tsp chipotle puree (1 tsp for 4 servings) in a large bowl; set aside for use in Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels and thinly slice crosswise. Season all over with salt and pepper.In a medium bowl, combine honey, remaining chipotle puree, a squeeze of lime juice, and pinch of lime zest. Add pork and toss until fully coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork and marinade; cook until browned and cooked through, 2-4 minutes per side (for 4 servings, cook in batches if necessary).Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Reserve pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4 servings) in pan used for pork over low heat, whisking to scrape up any browned bits from bottom of pan.Bring to simmer, then remove pan from heat and stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4).Transfer pork to pan and stir until coated. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: To bowl with reserved chipotle puree, whisk in 1 TBSP olive oil, ½ TBSP water, ½ tsp sugar, juice from two lime wedges, and a big pinch of salt and pepper until fully combined and thickened. (For 4 servings, use 2 TBSP olive oil, 1 TBSP water, 1 tsp sugar, and juice from four lime wedges.)Add spinach, carrot, and cucumber; toss until combined. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Fluff rice with a fork
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork.Divide pork, rice, and salad between plates. Drizzle pork with pan sauce. Serve with any remaining lime wedges on the side.Divide pork, rice, and salad between plates. Drizzle pork with pan sauce. Serve with any remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.
appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

title: Southwest Chicken Tacos
subtitle: with Pico de Gallo & Hot Sauce Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Zest and quarter lime. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Finely dice tomato. Halve, deseed, and slice green pepper into ¼-inch-thick strips.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Open package of chicken and drain off any excess liquid, then pat dry with paper towels. In a medium bowl, toss chicken with Southwest Spice Blend and a squeeze of lime juice. Set aside to marinate.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a second medium bowl, combine minced onion, tomato, half the lime zest, ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4 servings), and a squeeze of lime juice to taste (save some for Step 5). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine sour cream with as much Cholula® Hot Sauce as you like. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper, sliced onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, 6-7 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add another drizzle of oil and chicken to pan. Cook until chicken is browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Stir in remaining lime zest and juice from remaining lime wedges. Season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds. Divide tortillas between plates and fill with chicken and veggies. Top with pico de gallo and crema. Serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, adjust rack to top position and set oven to high broil. Wash and dry produce. Cut each tortilla into six equal pieces (make this easier by stacking the tortillas, then cutting them all at once). Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Quarter limes. Drain and rinse beans. Dice tomato. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss tortillas on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper; spread out in a single layer. Broil on top rack until crisped and browned, 2-4 minutes. (TIP: Broil in batches if necessary and watch closely to avoid burning!) Transfer chips to a plate to cool. Carefully line the same baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside until Step 6.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine onion, juice from half the limes, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 1 minute. Keep covered, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve. In a separate small bowl, combine guacamole, sour cream, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef*; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. In the last 2 minutes of cooking, add Tex-Mex paste, ½ tsp sugar, 2 TBSP water, and a pinch of salt (1 tsp sugar and 4 TBSP water for 4 servings); cook, stirring, until sauce is fully incorporated.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: On prepared baking sheet, layer half the chips, half the beef, half the Mexican cheese blend, and half the queso blanco. Repeat layering with remaining chips, remaining beef, remaining Mexican cheese blend, and remaining queso blanco. TIP: Cut a small corner of queso package to neatly pipe the cheese onto nachos. Return to top rack and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes. While nachos broil, empty contents of salad kit into a large bowl and toss to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Transfer beans to a second large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave until warmed through, 30-60 seconds. Fluff rice with a fork; stir in beans and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Top nachos with tomato, pickled onion (draining first), creamy guac, and cilantro. Serve family style with rice and beans, salad, and remaining lime wedges on the side.

instructions_json.title: Step 2

instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, place green peppers on a baking sheet and drizzle each half with oil; rub all over to coat. Season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut sides down.Roast on top rack until browned and softened, 15-18 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably ovenproof, pan over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and season with salt and pepper. title: Tex-Mex Chicken Bowls
subtitle: with Dark Meat Chicken, Pineapple Salsa, Green Pepper & Lime Rice

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Drain pineapple, reserving juice; roughly chop. Roughly chop cilantro. Zest and quarter lime. Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-20 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion and green pepper; season with half the Southwest Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest in the next step), salt, and pepper. instructions_json.body: Drain pineapple, reserving juice in a small bowl. Roughly chop pineapple. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. instructions_json.body: Arrange tortillas on a clean work surface. Top one half of each tortilla with pork and Mexican cheese blend (make sure to leave half the tortilla empty!).

instructions_json.body: Heat pan used for pork over medium heat (no need to wipe out pan; add another drizzle of oil if it seems dry). title: Tex-Mex Pork Chops with Mango Salsa
subtitle: with Zesty Lime Rice & Smoky Red Pepper Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, drain mango over a small bowl, reserving juice; roughly chop. Zest and quarter lime. Roughly chop cilantro. Trim and thinly slice scallions.To bowl with mango juice, stir in Tex-Mex paste, juice from half the lime, and 2 TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine chopped mango, cilantro, scallions, and a squeeze of lime juice to taste. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels and season all over with half the Southwest Spice Blend (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork; cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. (TIP: Lower heat if pork begins to brown too quickly.) Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest for at least 5 minutes. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

title: Blackened Honey Butter Lobster & Cod
subtitle: with Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Kale & Crispy Fried Onions

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Slice sweet potatoes into ½-inch-thick rounds. Pick parsley leaves from stems and roughly chop; discard stems. Remove any large stems from kale; chop leaves into bite-size pieces if necessary. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Quarter lemon.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss sweet potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, garlic powder, 1 tsp Blackening Spice (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 25-30 minutes. While sweet potatoes roast, in a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine honey, remaining Blackening Spice, and 4 TBSP plain butter (8 TBSP for 4). Cover with plastic wrap; microwave until butter has melted, 30-60 seconds. Stir in half the parsley and half the Worcestershire sauce (all for 4). Season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Using kitchen shears, cut along underside of each lobster shell*, leaving meat intact and stopping at tail; pull sides of shell apart to expose meat (do not remove meat from shell). Cut two 10-inch-long pieces of foil (four pieces for 4 servings). Place one lobster tail, cut side up, in the center of each piece of foil. Drizzle each lobster tail with 1 TBSP blackened honey butter. Wrap foil up and around lobster tails, pinching to tightly seal. Place on a second baking sheet.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Roast lobster tails on middle rack until tender and cooked through, 10-15 minutes. TIP: Carefully open the foil packets to check that lobster is fully cooked! The shell and meat should be red. If lobster needs more time, reseal and return to oven until fully cooked. Once fully cooked, carefully cut a slit in the top of each foil packet to allow steam to escape.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While lobster roasts, pat cod* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add cod; cook until browned and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer cod to a plate and dollop each piece with garlic herb butter. Wipe out pan. TIP: Tent fish with foil to keep warm.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for cod over medium heat. Add kale and garlic; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until kale begins to soften, 2-3 minutes. Add mustard, 2 TBSP water, and juice from one lemon wedge (4 TBSP water and juice from two lemon wedges for 4 servings). Cook, stirring, until kale is tender and liquid has evaporated, 1-2 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Once lobster tails are cool enough to handle, remove from foil; using a clean kitchen towel, apply pressure to tops of shells until they crack. Turn tails over and, using your hands, peel back shell on each side of cut tails. Remove lobster meat; cut into bite-size pieces. Arrange sweet potatoes in a circle in center of plates; top with kale. Arrange cod over kale; top with lobster meat. Drizzle with remaining blackened honey butter to taste. (TIP: If the butter has cooled, microwave for 10-15 seconds; stir.) Garnish with crispy fried onions and remaining parsley. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim green beans if necessary. Core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ½-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ½-inch pieces. Roughly chop parsley.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, toss green beans on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 12-15 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While green beans roast, pat lamb chops* dry with paper towels and season generously all over with half the Cajun Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest later), salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add lamb chops and cook to desired doneness, 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Transfer to a cutting board and tent with foil until ready to serve. (TIP: If lamb chops are browning too quickly, lower heat and cover pan.) Let pan cool slightly.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Return pan used for lamb chops to medium heat; whisk in chicken stock concentrate, mustard, and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4 servings). Bring to a simmer and cook, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan, until sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove pan from heat; whisk in sour cream until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a small microwave-safe bowl. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Once rice is done cooking, rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat very dry with paper towels. Season all over with remaining Cajun Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Add cooked rice and parsley to pan and cook, stirring constantly, until everything is well combined, 1-2 minutes. (For 4 servings, cook shrimp and veggies in batches, then mix everything together in a large bowl.)

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice lamb chops against the grain
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice lamb chops against the grain. Divide dirty rice, green beans, and lamb chops between plates in separate sections. Top lamb chops with pan sauce and serve. TIP: If needed, reheat sauce in the microwave for 30 seconds.

title: Air Fryer Cajun Chicken & Bacon Sandwiches
subtitle: with Hot Honey Mayo, Quick Pickles & Ranch Slaw

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds.In a shallow dish, combine panko, half the Cajun Spice Blend, a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper. TIP: If chicken is more than 1 inch thick, place between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound with a mallet or rolling pin until about ½ inch thick.In a large bowl, combine sour cream, remaining Cajun Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Add chicken to bowl; rub sour cream mixture all over chicken.Working one piece at a time, press chicken into panko mixture until fully coated on both sides.Coat an air fryer basket with cooking spray; arrange chicken side by side in basket. (For 4 servings, work in batches if necessary.) Coat tops of chicken with cooking spray. Air fry at 375 degrees for 6 minutes. Flip chicken and coat again with cooking spray; air fry until cooked through and crispy, 6 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Coat an air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray; arrange coated chicken side by side in basket. (For 4 servings, work in batches if necessary.) Coat tops of chicken with nonstick cooking spray.Air-fry at 375 degrees for 6 minutes. Flip chicken and coat again with nonstick cooking spray; air-fry until cooked through and crispy, 6 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, place cucumber in a small microwave-safe bowl. Add vinegar, 2 TBSP water, 1 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt (4 TBSP water and 2 tsp sugar for 4 servings); stir to combine. Microwave until cucumber is dark green, 1-2 minutes. Refrigerate until ready to serve.In a separate small bowl, combine honey and Sriracha. (TIP: If honey is hard to squeeze out, place packet in warm water for a few seconds to soften.) Add half the mayonnaise; stir until combined.

instructions_json.title: Halve and toast buns
instructions_json.body: Halve and toast buns.In a medium bowl, combine coleslaw mix, dressing, remaining mayonnaise, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread cut sides of top buns with hot honey mayo. Fill buns with crispy chicken and pickles (draining first).Divide sandwiches and slaw between plates and serve.

Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Peel garlic and place in the center of a small piece of foil; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Cinch into a packet. Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Mince chives.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss zucchini on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil, 1 tsp Italian Seasoning (2 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Place garlic foil packet on same sheet.Roast on top rack, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is browned and tender, 14-16 minutes.Meanwhile, place tomatoes in a medium bowl; toss with 1 tsp Italian Seasoning (2 tsp for 4 servings), a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. (You’ll use the rest of the Italian Seasoning later.) Set aside to marinate.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once zucchini is tender, transfer to bowl with tomatoes; toss to combine.Leaving garlic foil packet on sheet, carefully wipe off any excess oil. Place flatbreads on same sheet. (For 4 servings, divide between 2 baking sheets; toast on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through toasting.)Return to top rack until flatbreads are lightly toasted and garlic is softened, 5-7 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While flatbreads toast, melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add flour, garlic powder, and remaining Italian Seasoning. Whisk constantly until lightly browned, 30 seconds.Reduce heat to medium low and whisk in cream cheese and ½ cup water (1 cup for 4) until melted and combined. Season generously with salt and pepper. Simmer until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove pan from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once roasted garlic is done, carefully transfer to a cutting board and roughly chop.Heat broiler to high.Evenly top flatbreads with sauce, roasted garlic, and veggies. Sprinkle with mozzarella.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Broil flatbreads until cheese melts, 1-2 minutes. (For 4 servings, broil in batches.) TIP: Watch carefully to avoid burning. Slice flatbreads into pieces; sprinkle with chives and chili flakes to taste. Divide between plates and serve.

title: Falafel & Feta Flatbreads
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust oven rack to top position and heat broiler to high. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Crumble falafel into pan (use your hands) and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and crispy, 2-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a plate.

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Pick fronds from dill.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, toss mixed greens with vinaigrette. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Arrange flatbreads, dimpled sides down, on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Broil on top rack until browned and crisped, 2-3 minutes. (For 4 servings, broil in batches!) Carefully flip flatbreads dimpled sides up and evenly spread with romesco. Top with falafel, then layer with cucumber, tomatoes, and dill. Cut flatbreads into pieces and divide between plates. Drizzle with tzatziki and top with feta. Serve with salad on the side.

title: Sweet & Sour Pork Flatbreads
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust oven rack to middle position and set broiler to high. Line a baking sheet with foil and lightly oil. Wash and dry produce. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Drain pineapple.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper, scallion whites, and pork*; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until bell pepper is tender and pork is cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Add sweet and sour sauce, ginger paste, stock concentrate, and 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Cook until liquid has thickened, 30-60 seconds more. Remove from heat; taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Place flatbreads, dimpled sides up, on prepared baking sheet. Top with mozzarella. Broil flatbreads on middle rack until edges are browned and lightly crispy, 3-4 minutes. (For 4 servings, assemble and broil flatbreads in batches.) TIP: Keep an eye on the flatbreads—the broiler is a powerful tool!

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Empty contents of salad kit into a large bowl. Drizzle with as much dressing as you like; toss to evenly coat. TIP: Want to save a bowl? Shake the salad, toppings, and dressing in the bag! Divide flatbreads between plates and top with pork and bell pepper. Garnish with pineapple and scallion greens. Serve with salad on the side. TIP: Halve or quarter flatbreads if desired!

title: Curried Organic Chicken & Cabbage Flatbreads
subtitle: with Mango Chutney, Yogurt, Cashews & Cilantro

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust oven rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and heat broiler to high. Wash and dry produce. Roughly chop cashews. Finely chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Place flatbreads, dimpled sides down, on a baking sheet (divide between two sheets for 4 servings). Brush or rub each flatbread with a large drizzle of olive oil; lightly season with salt and pepper. Toast on top rack until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side. (For 4, toast on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp* under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add curry powder; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds. Add shrimp, coleslaw mix, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through and coleslaw mix has wilted, 3-5 minutes more. Turn off heat; stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until melted.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once flatbreads are toasted, remove sheet from oven. Carefully flip dimpled sides up and place on a clean work surface. Top with curried shrimp and cabbage, yogurt, mango chutney, cashews, and cilantro. Cut flatbreads into pieces, divide between plates, and serve.

title: Spiced Chickpea Fritters & Chicken
subtitle: with Greek Salad, Pitas & Garlicky White Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. (TIP: If you have a toaster oven, feel free to skip preheating—you’ll use it to toast the pitas in step 5. Or, skip preheating; in step 5, microwave pitas instead.) Wash and dry produce. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Dice tomato. Halve, peel, and thinly slice half the shallot; mince remaining shallot. Pick and roughly chop fronds from dill. Quarter lemon. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine cucumber, tomato, sliced shallot, half the chopped dill, and half the feta (save the rest for serving). Stir in a drizzle of olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice to taste. Season with salt and pepper.In a separate small bowl, combine sour cream with a pinch of garlic to taste. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Drain and rinse chickpeas
instructions_json.body: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place in a medium bowl; mash with a potato masher or fork until almost smooth. (It’s OK if there are still some larger chickpea pieces.) In a large bowl, whisk together tempura mix, Shawarma Spice Blend, stock concentrate, salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4 servings), and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4) until smooth. TIP: If tempura mixture is too thick, add more water 1 TBSP at a time until it reaches a pancake-batter-like consistency.Stir in mashed chickpeas, minced shallot, remaining garlic, and remaining chopped dill. Season with pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. Once oil is shimmering and hot enough that a drop of batter sizzles when added to the pan, carefully add heaping ¼-cup scoops of chickpea batter. TIP: Add your batter to the pan close to the oil to avoid splatter. You may need to cook fritters in batches.Cook fritters until golden brown and crisp, 3-4 minutes per side.Using a slotted spoon, carefully transfer fritters to a paper-towel-lined plate. Season with a pinch of salt.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While fritters cook, toast pitas on top rack (use a baking sheet or place directly on oven rack) until warm and pliable. TIP: You can use your toaster oven instead, if you have one. Keep an eye on the pitas as they toast—they should be soft, not crispy. Alternatively, microwave pitas wrapped in a paper towel for 20 seconds.Halve pitas crosswise.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide fritters and salad (draining first) between plates. Top with remaining feta. Serve with pitas, sauce, and remaining lemon wedges on the side. TIP: If you like, stuff pitas with fritters and salad, then drizzle with sauce for falafel-inspired sandwiches!

title: Harissa-Spiced Lentil Soup & Chicken

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Peel, halve and dice onion into ¼-inch pieces. Trim, peel, and thinly slice carrots into rounds. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Drain lentils. Drain chickpeas. TIP: Drain lentils and chickpeas separately; you'll add them to the soup at different times!

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and carrots; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.Stir in garlic, harissa powder, smoked paprika, tomato paste, and ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4 servings); cook, stirring frequently, until mixture is fragrant and brick red in color, 1-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add diced tomato, stock concentrates, lentils, 2½ cups water (4½ cups for 4 servings), salt, and pepper to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soup has thickened and lentils are warmed through and tender, 6-8 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir chickpeas into pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid has reduced slightly and chickpeas are tender, 5-7 minutes more. In the last 3 minutes of cooking, using the back of a wooden spoon, gently mash about half the chickpeas and lentils. TIP: If you prefer a brothier soup, skip mashing!Taste and season with additional salt and pepper.

title: Tunisian-Style Chicken & Chickpea Stew
subtitle: with Harissa Chili Oil & Za’atar-Spiced Pitas

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Dice onion into ½-inch pieces. Pick cilantro leaves from stems. Reserve leaves; finely chop stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a large pot, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add onion and cilantro stems; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes. Add cumin, paprika, and half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest in the next step); continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.Stir in stock concentrates, crushed tomatoes, chickpeas and their liquid, 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt (2 tsp sugar and 2 tsp salt for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 15-20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While stew cooks, in a small microwave-safe bowl, combine harissa, remaining garlic powder, 3 TBSP olive oil, ½ tsp salt, and as many chili flakes as you like (6 TBSP olive oil and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings). Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until fragrant, 1 minute.Stir to combine. Set aside, covered, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Wrap pitas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, 30-60 seconds.In a second small bowl, combine Za’atar Spice, sesame seeds, 3 TBSP olive oil (6 TBSP for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt to taste.Lightly brush pitas with as much za’atar oil as you like. Cut each pita into four triangles.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once stew has slightly thickened, use a potato masher or the back of a large spoon to gently mash about half the chickpeas (this will help thicken the stew even more!). Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Divide stew between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide stew between bowls. Top with cilantro leaves, yogurt, and as much harissa oil as you like. Serve with za’atar-spiced pitas and any remaining za’atar oil on the side for dipping.

title: Prep & Bake Chicken Curry & Buttered Pitas
subtitle: Includes recyclable aluminum tray

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring 1 TBSP butter (1½ TBSP for 4 servings) to room temperature. Wash and dry produce. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick quarter-moons. Halve, peel, and dice half the onion (whole onion for 4) into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Rinse shrimp* under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. In oven-ready tray, mix together zucchini, diced onion, shrimp, curry sauce base, crème fraîche, half the curry powder (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper until thoroughly combined. (For 4, evenly divide ingredients between two trays.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Bake shrimp curry on top rack (be sure your oven has preheated!) until zucchini and onion are tender, shrimp are cooked through, and curry has slightly thickened, 28-32 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. (For 4 servings, bake two trays side by side on top rack.) When curry has 3 minutes left, remove tray from oven; add peas and stir to combine. Return to top rack and bake until peas are warmed through, 1-2 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Toast pitas
instructions_json.body: Toast pitas. Spread toasted pitas with softened butter, then cut each pita into quarters. Divide shrimp curry between bowls. Serve with buttered pitas on the side.

title: Tunisian-Style Shrimp & Chickpea Stew
subtitle: with Harissa Chili Oil & Za’atar-Spiced Pitas

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ½-inch pieces. Pick cilantro leaves from stems; reserve leaves and finely chop stems. Rinse shrimp under cold water; pat very dry with paper towels. Season all over with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a large pot, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add onion and cilantro stems; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes. Add cumin, paprika, and half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest in the next step); continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds. Stir in stock concentrates, crushed tomatoes, chickpeas and their liquid, 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt (2 tsp sugar and 2 tsp salt for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 15-20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While stew cooks, in a small microwave-safe bowl, combine harissa, remaining garlic powder, 3 TBSP olive oil, ½ tsp salt, and as many chili flakes as you like (6 TBSP olive oil and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings). Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until fragrant, 1 minute. Stir to combine. Set aside, covered, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Wrap pitas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, 30-60 seconds. In a second small bowl, combine Za’atar Spice, sesame seeds, 3 TBSP olive oil, and a pinch of salt to taste (6 TBSP olive oil for 4 servings). Lightly brush pitas with as much za’atar oil as you like. Cut each pita into four triangles.

instructions_json.title: Once stew has thickened, add shrimp to pot
instructions_json.body: Once stew has thickened, add shrimp to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Divide stew between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide stew between bowls. Top with cilantro leaves, yogurt, and as much harissa oil as you like. Serve with za’atar-spiced pitas and any remaining za’atar oil on the side for dipping.

title: Chicken & Greek Spiced Chickpea Fritters
subtitle: with Greek Salad, Pita & Garlicky White Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. (TIP: If you have a toaster oven, feel free to skip preheating—you’ll use it to toast the pitas in step 5. Or, skip preheating; in step 5, microwave pitas instead.) Wash and dry produce. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Dice tomato. Halve, peel, and thinly slice half the shallot; mince remaining shallot. Pick and roughly chop fronds from dill. Quarter lemon. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine cucumber, tomato, sliced shallot, half the chopped dill, and half the feta (save the rest for serving). Stir in a drizzle of olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice to taste. Season with salt and pepper.In a separate small bowl, combine sour cream with a pinch of garlic to taste. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Drain and rinse chickpeas
instructions_json.body: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place in a medium bowl; mash with a potato masher or fork until almost smooth. (It’s OK if there are still some larger chickpea pieces.) In a large bowl, whisk together tempura mix, Shawarma Spice Blend, stock concentrate, salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4 servings), and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4) until smooth. TIP: If tempura mixture is too thick, add more water 1 TBSP at a time until it reaches a pancake-batter-like consistency.Stir in mashed chickpeas, minced shallot, remaining garlic, and remaining chopped dill. Season with pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. Once oil is shimmering and hot enough that a drop of batter sizzles when added to the pan, carefully add heaping ¼-cup scoops of chickpea batter. TIP: Add your batter to the pan close to the oil to avoid splatter. You may need to cook fritters in batches.Cook fritters until golden brown and crisp, 3-4 minutes per side.Using a slotted spoon, carefully transfer fritters to a paper-towel-lined plate. Season with a pinch of salt. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While fritters cook, toast pitas on top rack (use a baking sheet or place directly on oven rack) until warm and pliable. TIP: You can use your toaster oven instead, if you have one. Keep an eye on the pitas as they toast—they should be soft, not crispy. Alternatively, microwave pitas wrapped in a paper towel for 20 seconds.Halve pitas crosswise.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide fritters and salad (draining first) between plates. Top with remaining feta. Serve with pitas, sauce, and remaining lemon wedges on the side. TIP: If you like, stuff pitas with fritters and salad, then drizzle with sauce for falafel-inspired sandwiches!

title: Epic Nacho Mac ’n’ Cheese with Bacon
subtitle: with a Tortilla Chip Topping & Smoky Red Pepper Crema

instructions_json.title: Heat broiler to high
instructions_json.body: Heat broiler to high. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Core, deseed, and dice green pepper into ½-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince garlic.Place smoky red pepper crema in a small bowl. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add cavatappi to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably ovenproof, pan (use a large, preferably ovenproof, pan for 4 servings) over medium heat. Add green pepper and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until softened, 4-5 minutes.Add Southwest Spice Blend, scallion whites, garlic, and 2 TBSP butter (3 TBSP for 4); cook, stirring, until butter has melted and scallion whites are softened, 1 minute.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir flour into pan until smooth and incorporated, 1 minute. Gradually stir in ½ cup water (¾ cup for 4 servings) until fully combined.Add cream cheese and cook, stirring, until fully incorporated and sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes.Turn off heat; stir in cheddar until melted and smooth. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir drained cavatappi into pan with sauce until coated. Taste and season with salt if needed. If mixture is too thick, add a splash more water. TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture now to a baking dish.Using your hands, crush tortilla chips and evenly sprinkle over mac ’n’ cheese. Top with an even layer of Mexican cheese blend.Broil until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes. TIP: Watch carefully to avoid burning.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide mac ’n’ cheese between bowls; drizzle with smoky red pepper crema. Top with scallion greens and as much hot sauce as you like. Serve.

title: XL Turkish-Spiced Steak & Creamy Risotto
subtitle: 2x the portions for family dinner or leftovers

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a large pot, bring 6 cups water (12 cups for 8 servings) to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside (you’ll use it in the next step). Wash and dry produce. Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick pieces. Dice tomatoes into ½-inch pieces. Roughly chop parsley.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a second large pot over medium heat. Add rice and cook, stirring frequently, until slightly fragrant and translucent, 1 minute. Carefully stir in reserved hot water and stock concentrates. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender and liquid has mostly absorbed, 18-22 minutes. TIP: Depending on your stove, you may need to increase the heat to achieve a steady simmer. If liquid evaporates before rice is tender, stir in a splash of plain water. Keep covered off heat until ready to finish the risotto in Step 5.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a medium bowl, combine cucumber, tomatoes, vinaigrette, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with Turkish Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To pot with cooked rice, stir in cream cheese, Vidalia onion paste, half the parsley, and 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 8 servings). Taste and season with salt (we used 1 tsp; 2 tsp for 8) and pepper. TIP: If risotto seems too thick, stir in another splash of plain water.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide risotto, chicken, and salad between plates or serve everything family style. Top chicken with tzatziki and remaining parsley. Sprinkle feta over salad.

version_notes: Official HelloFresh v1 Recipe (Normalized to 4 Servings)

title: Panko-Crusted Sirloin Steak Chimichurri
