instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Using a peeler, peel four long strips of orange zest from orange. Wrap zest in damp paper towels and set aside. Slice orange into ½-inch-thick rounds. In a medium pot, combine 1 cup water, ⅓ cup sugar, and a pinch of salt (2 cups water and ⅔ cup sugar for 4). Stir to combine. Add orange slices.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Bring pot with orange mixture to a boil over medium-high heat. (TIP: Cover pot with a lid to bring to a boil faster.) Cook, stirring occasionally, until sugar has dissolved, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat. Using a fine-mesh strainer, strain orange simple syrup over a medium bowl; discard orange slices. Stir vinegar, jam, and dried cherries into hot syrup. Place bowl in refrigerator to cool while preparing the rest of your meal. Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Halve, peel, and mince shallot. Peel and roughly chop garlic. Place peppercorns in a zip-close bag and crush with a heavy-bottomed pan or rolling pin.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Toss Brussels sprouts on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, spread Brussels sprouts across entire sheet.) Toss potatoes on empty side of sheet with a large drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until veggies are browned and tender, 20-25 minutes. (For 4, toss potatoes on a second baking sheet; roast on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat steak* dry with paper towels; season generously all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook to desired doneness, 5-7 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise and mustard. Melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in pan used for steak over medium heat. Add shallot and garlic; cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 30-60 seconds. Stir in stock concentrates, ¼ cup water, and ½ tsp peppercorns (⅓ cup water and 1 tsp peppercorns for 4). (TIP: Be sure to measure the peppercorns.) Simmer until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Turn off heat. Stir in another 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) until melted; season with salt, pepper, and more peppercorns if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Pour ¼ cup simple syrup and ¼ cup still or sparkling water in glasses. (TIP: We used short glasses for this amount, but feel free to use taller glasses and double the amount of syrup and water!) Fill glasses with ice and stir thoroughly. Garnish with a twist of reserved orange zest and a few cherries from the syrup to taste. TIP: If you prefer your drinks sweeter, add another splash of syrup!

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice steak against the grain
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice steak against the grain. Divide steak, Brussels sprouts, and potato wedges between plates. Spoon peppercorn sauce over steak. Serve with Dijonnaise on the side and enjoy with your nonalcoholic old-fashioned.

title: Creamy Parmesan Salmon Polenta Bowls
subtitle: with Lemony Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms & Asparagus

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Trim and cut mushrooms into ¼-inch-thick slices (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Trim scallions; cut whites into 1-inch pieces and thinly slice greens. Trim and discard woody bottom ends from asparagus; cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Zest and quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss Brussels sprouts, mushrooms, and scallion whites on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, half the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack for 5 minutes (you’ll add more to the sheet then).In a medium bowl, toss asparagus with a drizzle of oil, remaining garlic powder, salt, and pepper.Once veggies have roasted 5 minutes, remove sheet from oven. Carefully arrange asparagus over top. Return to top rack and roast until veggies are browned and tender, 12-15 minutes more.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While veggies roast, in a small pot, combine polenta and ⅓ cup water (⅔ cup for 4 servings) over medium heat. Mash with a potato masher or fork until mostly smooth, 30-60 seconds.Stir in half the Parmesan.Whisk in cream cheese, sour cream, stock concentrates, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4). Bring to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 3-4 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. TIP: If polenta seems too thick, stir in a splash of water.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once veggies are done, sprinkle with lemon zest; toss to combine. TIP: Be careful—baking sheet is hot!Before serving, briefly stir polenta (rewarm over medium heat if necessary).Divide polenta between bowls. Top with roasted veggies and a generous squeeze of lemon juice. Top with scallion greens, sunflower seeds, and remaining Parmesan. Serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Mushroom & Herb Turkey Shepherd’s Pie

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While potatoes cook, trim and quarter mushrooms. (Skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!) Trim, peel, and finely dice carrots. Halve, peel, and dice half the onion (whole onion for 4 servings). Strip thyme leaves from stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably ovenproof, pan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and a big pinch of salt. title: Veggie Supreme Strombolis
subtitle: with Green Pepper, Onion, Mushrooms, Mozzarella & Marinara

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on oiled sheet to coat all over. Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, halve, core, and slice bell pepper into strips. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Trim and slice mushrooms into ½-inch-thick pieces (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle. (The dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!) Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make stretching the dough into a larger shape even easier).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, sprinkle mozzarella evenly across each dough rectangle, leaving a ½-inch border on all sides. Top with veggies (draining first if needed). Drizzle basil paste lengthwise in a single layer across middle of dough. Starting with a long side, gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one dough rectangle. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log with the filling enclosed. Arrange stromboli on baking sheet, seam side down; pinch ends to close, then tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: When strombolis have about 5 minutes remaining, combine garlic powder and 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl. Add panko, a pinch of salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper.Lay two slices of prosciutto beside each other on a work surface. Place a chicken cutlet along bottom of slices; tightly roll up prosciutto around chicken. Repeat with remaining prosciutto and chicken.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in pan used for panko over medium-high heat. Add wrapped chicken and cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side (it’ll finish cooking in the next step). TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer chicken to a baking sheet now.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Top chicken with Swiss cheese; transfer pan to oven. Roast on top rack until chicken is cooked through and cheese has melted, 12-15 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer chicken to a cutting board to rest. Reserve pan.While chicken is roasting, once water is boiling, add rigatoni to pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (2 cups for 4 servings), then drain.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for chicken over medium-high heat; add shallot, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 2-4 minutes.Stir in stock concentrate, garlic herb butter, cream sauce base, cream cheese, and ¾ cup reserved pasta cooking water (1¼ cups for 4 servings). Cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 5-8 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add drained rigatoni and spinach to pan with sauce; cook, stirring, until spinach begins to wilt, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat and stir in 1 TBSP plain butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until melted. Taste and season with salt and pepper. title: Spinach Strombolis with Organic Chicken
subtitle: plus Artichokes, Mozzarella & Marinara Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on baking sheet to coat all over. (For 4, divide dough between two sheets.) Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add spinach (you may need to add in batches) and artichokes; cook, stirring, until spinach has slightly wilted, 1-2 minutes. Add garlic powder and Italian Seasoning. Cook, stirring, until spinach has fully wilted and garlic is fragrant, 1-2 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a medium bowl; let cool slightly.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle. (The dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!) Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make the next step easier!).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, evenly spread each dough rectangle with crème fraîche and sprinkle with mozzarella, leaving a ½-inch border around edges. Top with veggies (draining first). Gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one dough rectangle, starting with a long side. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log. Arrange stromboli, seam sides down, on baking sheet; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle. Bake strombolis on middle rack until deep golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes (for 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When strombolis are almost done, place marinara in a small microwave-safe bowl; cover tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave until sauce is warmed through, 30-45 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Let strombolis rest at least 2 minutes, then transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into quarters. Divide between plates. Serve with marinara on the side for dipping.

title: Chicken & Curry-Spiced Chickpea Wraps
subtitle: with Golden Raisins & Spinach Almond Salad

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Roughly chop raisins. Trim and thinly slice scallion greens (save whites for another use). Quarter lemon. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces.Place raisins in a small microwave-safe bowl; add enough water to cover. Microwave 30 seconds, then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Drain and rinse chickpeas; pat dry with paper towels.Place chickpeas in a medium bowl and mash with the back of a fork until about half the chickpeas are smooth (leave some larger pieces for texture-packed bites!).Stir in scallion greens, drained raisins, mayonnaise, 2 tsp curry powder (4 tsp for 4 servings), and juice from one lemon wedge (juice from two wedges for 4). (Be sure to measure the curry powder—we sent more!) Taste and season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, whisk together mustard, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), juice from two lemon wedges (juice from four wedges for 4), salt, and pepper until well combined. Slowly whisk in 2 TBSP olive oil (4 TBSP for 4) until smooth and creamy.Add spinach and tomato to bowl and toss to coat; taste and season with salt and pepper if needed. TIP: Use tongs to toss salad more easily!

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave until warm and pliable, 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Arrange tortillas on a clean work surface; place chickpea salad and a handful of spinach salad on bottom half of each tortilla.Fold bottom side of each tortilla up over filling, then fold over left and right sides toward the filling. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to form wraps.

instructions_json.title: Halve wraps on a diagonal
instructions_json.body: Halve wraps on a diagonal. Divide wraps and remaining spinach salad between plates. Top spinach salad with almonds. Serve.

title: One-Pot Chicken & Bean Soup
subtitle: with Kale & Carrot

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Trim, peel, and halve carrot lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces. Drain and rinse beans. Quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add sausage*; using a spatula, press into an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until browned on bottom, 2-3 minutes.Break up meat into pieces, then add carrot, kale, and ½ tsp salt (1 tsp for 4 servings). Cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is cooked through, carrot is slightly softened, and kale begins to wilt, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine cornstarch with 1 TBSP water (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until mixture is smooth and no lumps remain. TIP: Mix with your finger to ensure there are no lumps!Stir stock concentrates, cornstarch mixture, half the beans, and 1½ cups water (3 cups for 4) into pot with sausage and veggies. Using the back of a wooden spoon or spatula, partially mash beans in pot.Cover and bring to a boil, then immediately reduce to a low simmer. Cook until kale is wilted and broth has thickened slightly, 3-5 minutes. TIP: Check if the kale is wilting evenly and stir occasionally if necessary.Stir in cream sauce base, remaining beans, and a big squeeze of lemon juice. Cook until combined and warmed through, 1-2 minutes. (TIP: Add another splash of water if you prefer a thinner broth.) Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir in cream sauce base, remaining beans, and a big squeeze of lemon juice. Cook until combined and warmed through, 1-2 minutes. (TIP: Add another splash of water if you prefer a thinner broth.) Season with salt and pepper to taste.Divide soup between bowls. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Portuguese-Style Chicken Bifana Sandwiches
subtitle: with Kale Caldo Verde Soup

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Peel and dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion.Open and drain tofu; press out excess water with paper towels. Halve tofu crosswise, then slice each half widthwise. (You’ll have four thin, square planks; eight planks for 4 servings.)

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium pot over medium-high heat, combine potatoes, garlic powder, stock concentrates, half the Savory Paprika Blend (you’ll use the rest in Step 4), and 2½ cups water (5 cups for 4 servings). Season generously with salt.Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, until potatoes are tender, 15-20 minutes.Stir kale into pot and cook until kale is softened, about 5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While soup cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium heat. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.Transfer to a small bowl.Add 3/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp sugar (1 1/4 cup water and 1 tsp sugar for 4 servings), chimichurri, stock concentrate and remaining savory paprika blend. Stir to combine; add tofu planks to sauce and let sauce cook until slightly thickened and tofu absorbs flavor, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for onion over medium heat. Add tomato paste and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add ¾ cup water, chimichurri, remaining Savory Paprika Blend, and ½ tsp sugar (1¼ cups water and 1 tsp sugar for 4 servings); stir to combine.Add tofu to pan and cook until sauce has slightly thickened and tofu absorbs flavor, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Halve and toast ciabattas
instructions_json.body: Halve and toast ciabattas.Top bottom ciabatta halves with chimichurri tofu, spooning with excess sauce from pan. Top with onion. Close with top ciabatta halves to form sandwiches.Divide sandwiches between plates. Serve with soup on the side.

instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. instructions_json.body: Toss sliced shallot and chickpeas on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of olive oil, 1 tsp harissa powder (2 tsp for 4 servings), and salt. (You’ll use more harissa powder in the next step.) (For 4, divide between 2 sheets; roast on top and middle racks.) Cook until water has absorbed and bulgur is tender, 12-15 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 5.

subtitle: with Citrus Salad, Radishes & Wonton Strips

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Zest and quarter lemon. Zest orange; cut off top and bottom. Set upright on one cut side and remove peel with curved downward cuts, exposing the flesh and removing any remaining white pith; discard peel. Quarter orange and slice into quarter-moons.Dice grilling cheese into bite-size pieces. Trim and halve radishes; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Trim and discard root ends from lettuce; chop leaves into bite-size pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon zest, orange zest, dressing, a drizzle of olive oil (large drizzle for 4 servings), juice from half the lemon, salt, and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Spread out herbes de Provence on a plate
instructions_json.body: Spread out herbes de Provence on a plate. Working one piece at a time, press grilling cheese into herbs until fully coated.Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add cheese and cook, undisturbed, until browned on one side, 30-60 seconds. Flip cheese; cook on second side until browned, 30-60 seconds more. (For 4 servings, you may need to work in batches.)Turn off heat; transfer to a plate.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To bowl with citrus dressing, add radishes, lettuce, half the orange, and half the wonton strips; toss until evenly combined. Taste and season with more lemon juice, olive oil, salt, or pepper if desired.Divide salad between plates; top with grilling cheese, remaining orange, and remaining wonton strips. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Za’atar-Crusted Halloumi & Mixed Grains
subtitle: with Zucchini, Romesco Sauce & Yogurt

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch-thick quarter-moons. Cut grilling cheese into four large pieces (eight pieces for 4 servings). Place Za’atar Spice on a plate. Working one at a time, press cheese pieces into Za’atar Spice until fully coated.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat (for 4, use a large, high-sided pan). Add cheese and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side (while the cheese cooks, discard any remaining Za’atar Spice from plate; reserve plate). Turn off heat. Transfer cheese to plate used for spice. Reserve pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat another drizzle of oil in pan used for cheese over medium-high heat. Add zucchini; cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to brown, 3-4 minutes. Massage grain blend in package to separate grains. Reduce heat under pan to medium. Add grain blend, Vidalia onion paste, and stock concentrate to pan with zucchini. Stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is tender and grains are warmed through, 1-2 minutes. TIP: If grains begin to pop, cover pan with a lid.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Remove pan from heat and add romesco sauce; stir to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Divide zucchini and grains between shallow bowls. Drizzle with yogurt. Top with grilling cheese. Serve.

title: Charred Halloumi & Tomato Sandos
subtitle: with Potato Wedges & Scallion Marinara Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Slice grilling cheese crosswise into ¾-inch slices. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Halve baguettes lengthwise. Thinly slice tomato into rounds.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add grilling cheese and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side. (For 4 servings, you may need to work in batches.)Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Carefully wipe out pan. Add scallion whites, marinara, and half the Tuscan Heat Spice (you'll use the rest in the next step) to same pan. Stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place baguette halves, cut sides up, on a second foil-lined baking sheet. Spread bottom halves with 2 TBSP scallion marinara sauce. Top with tomato slices; season with remaining Tuscan Heat Spice, salt, and pepper. Drizzle olive oil over top halves. Bake on middle rack until bread is toasted and tomatoes are lightly browned, 5-7 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Divide grilling cheese between bottom baguette halves; top with as much remaining scallion marinara sauce as you like (save some for serving!). Sprinkle with scallion greens.Close sandwiches; halve on a diagonal if desired.

instructions_json.title: Divide sandos between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide sandos between plates. Serve with potato wedges and any remaining scallion marinara sauce on the side for dipping.

title: Indian-Style Halloumi Curry
subtitle: with Basmati Rice, Bell Pepper & Cilantro

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a medium pot, combine rice, ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce.Core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into 1-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and finely dice onion. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Roughly chop cilantro. Thinly slice chili.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-7 minutes. TIP: If needed, add a splash of water to help pepper and onion soften.Stir in garlic; cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While veggies cook, pat grilling cheese dry with paper towels. Cut into ½-inch cubes. Place cheese in a medium bowl and toss with yogurt, half the garam masala (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper until evenly coated. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add cheese in a single layer; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown on all sides, 2-3 minutes. Reduce heat to medium.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To the same pan, stir in curry sauce, paprika, stock concentrate, ½ cup water, and 1 TBSP butter (1 cup water and 2 TBSP butter for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low. Cook until sauce has thickened, 2-3 minutes. (TIP: If sauce seems too thick, stir in a splash of water.) Add veggies and sour cream; stir to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Fluff rice with a fork
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork. Divide between shallow bowls or plates. Top with cheese and sauce. Sprinkle with cilantro and sliced chili if desired. Serve.

instructions_json.title: • Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: • Wash and dry produce. • Halve, peel, and thinly slice shallot; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Peel and mince or grate garlic. Roughly chop pistachios. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Zest and quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: • Melt 1 TBSP butter in a small pot over medium-high heat (use 2 TBSP butter and a medium pot for 4 servings). Add minced shallot, half the garlic, half the pistachios (save the rest for serving), half the Shawarma Spice (you’ll use the rest later), and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring, 1 minute. • Stir in rice, stock concentrate, ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. • Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: • In a medium bowl, combine cucumber, tomatoes, and as much sliced shallot as you like. Toss with a drizzle of olive oil, a big squeeze of lemon juice, a pinch of lemon zest, salt, and pepper. • In a small bowl, combine sour cream with remaining garlic to taste. Season with salt. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: • Cut grilling cheese into four large slices (eight slices for 4 servings). Place on a plate; season all over with remaining Shawarma Spice, salt, and pepper. (TIP: It’s OK if not all the spice sticks.) Shake off any excess spice blend.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: • Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add seasoned grilling cheese and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side.

instructions_json.body: • Fluff rice with a fork; stir in 1 TBSP butter. Season with salt and pepper. • Divide rice between shallow bowls. Top with salad and grilling cheese. Drizzle cheese with garlicky white sauce and hot sauce to taste. Sprinkle with remaining pistachios. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Crispy Feta Fried Egg Sandos
subtitle: with Apple Slices & Creamy Peanut Butter Dip

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.

instructions_json.title: Roughly chop parsley
instructions_json.body: Roughly chop parsley. Peel and mince garlic. Halve, core, and thinly slice apple.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add feta in two small piles (four piles for 4 servings); using a rubber spatula, form piles into rings about the size of a cracked egg.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Crack eggs* into the center of each feta ring and fry to preference. Season eggs with salt and pepper. TIP: To keep the eggs from sticking together, use a spatula to gently push the feta toward each yolk.

instructions_json.title: While eggs cook, halve and toast buns
instructions_json.body: While eggs cook, halve and toast buns. In a small bowl, combine parsley, garlic, 1 TBSP oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and as many chili flakes as you like. Season lightly with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In a second small bowl, combine peanut butter and crème fraîche. Fill toasted buns with feta eggs and herb sauce; divide between plates. Serve with apple slices and creamy peanut butter for dipping.

title: Shakshuka-Inspired Gluten-Free Fresh Fusilli
subtitle: with Fried Eggs, Feta & Harissa Romesco Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add tomato paste; cook, stirring, until darkened in color, 30 seconds. Add scallion whites and diced tomato; season with a big pinch of salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until tomato has softened, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To pan with tomato mixture, stir in romesco, garlic powder, harissa powder, stock concentrate, ½ tsp sugar, and ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water (1 tsp sugar and 1 cup reserved pasta cooking water for 4 servings). TIP: For less heat, use half the harissa. If your pasta isn’t finished cooking, ladle cooking water directly from the pot. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until tomato is incorporated and sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes. (You’ll finish the sauce in Step 6.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While sauce simmers, heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Crack eggs* into pan and season with salt and pepper. Fry to preference. (For 4 servings, you may need to cook eggs in batches.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: To pan with sauce, stir in drained penne until fully coated. Add splashes of remaining reserved pasta cooking water as needed to reach desired consistency. Stir in half the feta. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between shallow bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between shallow bowls. Top with fried eggs and garnish with remaining feta and scallion greens. Serve.

Drain corn and pat dry with paper towels.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Divide mashed sweet potatoes and Caesar corn slaw between plates. Prop scallops alongside and drizzle with as much tartar sauce as you like. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side. Heat Bundt cakes according to package instructions. Serve.

title: Creamy Spinach & Artichoke Strombolis
subtitle: with Mozzarella & Marinara Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on baking sheet to coat all over. (For 4, divide dough between two sheets.) Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add spinach (you may need to add in batches) and artichokes; cook, stirring, until spinach has slightly wilted, 1-2 minutes. Add garlic powder and Italian Seasoning. Cook, stirring, until spinach has fully wilted and garlic is fragrant, 1-2 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a medium bowl; let cool slightly.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle. (The dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!) Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make the next step easier!).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, evenly spread each dough rectangle with crème fraîche and sprinkle with mozzarella, leaving a ½-inch border around edges. Top with veggies (draining first). Gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one dough rectangle, starting with a long side. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log. Arrange stromboli, seam sides down, on baking sheet; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle. Bake strombolis on middle rack until deep golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes (for 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When strombolis are almost done, place marinara in a small microwave-safe bowl; cover tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave until sauce is warmed through, 30-45 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Let strombolis rest at least 2 minutes, then transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into quarters. Divide between plates. Serve with marinara on the side for dipping.

title: Rigatoni Rosa with Chicken
subtitle: plus Cream Cheese, Zucchini & Parm

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Once water is boiling, add rigatoni; cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4 servings), then drain and set aside.Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-moons. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove pan from heat; transfer zucchini to a plate.Remove sausage* from casing if necessary; discard casing. Heat another drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add sausage to pan and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes (it’ll finish cooking in the next step).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Stir garlic and tomato paste into pan with sausage; cook until garlic is fragrant, tomato paste is well distributed, and sausage is fully cooked, 1-2 minutes.Stir in cream cheese, stock concentrate, ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water (ladle straight from the pot if pasta hasn’t finished cooking yet), 1 TBSP butter, ½ tsp sugar, and a pinch of chili flakes to taste. (For 4 servings, use ¾ cup pasta cooking water, 2 TBSP butter, and 1 tsp sugar.) Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add drained rigatoni and zucchini to pan with sauce. Stir in half the Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper to taste. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time until pasta is coated in a creamy sauce.Divide between bowls; top with remaining Parmesan and serve.

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Roughly chop cilantro. Quarter lime. Pat tofu dry with paper towels, gently pressing to remove excess liquid (this will help it brown and crisp up in the pan). Slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick planks; season with salt and pepper (you should have 12 planks; 24 planks for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl (large bowl for 4 servings), combine sesame dressing, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper. Add cabbage and carrot mix, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice; toss until everything is evenly combined. Taste and season with more lime juice, salt, or pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add tofu; cook, undisturbed, until golden brown and crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. title: Fideo Seco with Bavette Steak & Fried Eggs
subtitle: plus Guacamole, Pickled Shallot-Tomato Salad & Sour Cream

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring 5 cups water (8 cups for 4 servings) to a boil in a medium pot. Once boiling, reduce heat to low to keep warm. TIP: Start with hot water to speed things up!Wash and dry produce.Using your hands, roughly break spaghetti in its bag into 1- to 2-inch pieces.Halve, peel, and thinly slice shallot. Quarter lime. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add broken spaghetti, Tex-Mex paste, and tomato paste. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Stir 1 cup hot water (2 cups for 4 servings) from pot into pan with spaghetti mixture. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until water has absorbed. Repeat process with remaining hot water, adding ½ cup at a time, until water has absorbed and pasta is al dente, 10-15 minutes. TIP: It’s OK if you don't use all the hot water.Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, in a small microwave-safe bowl, combine shallot, juice from half the lime, ¼ tsp sugar, and ½ tsp salt (½ tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings). Microwave until bright pink, 30-60 seconds.Add diced tomato to bowl and stir to combine; season with salt and pepper. Set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, crack eggs into pan and cover. Fry to preference; season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between shallow bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between shallow bowls. Top with a fried egg, sour cream, guacamole, and pickled shallot-tomato salad (draining first). Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Trim and discard woody bottom ends from asparagus. Halve, peel, and mince shallot. Finely chop chives.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Spread half the truffle butter all around the inside of a small baking dish (medium baking dish for 4 servings). Drain off any excess liquid from potatoes and spread out evenly in dish.Melt remaining truffle butter in a small pan over medium heat. Add cream sauce base and ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4); bring to a simmer, then remove from heat. Pour mixture over potatoes and cover tightly with foil.Bake gratin on top rack until potatoes are tender and liquid is bubbling, 25-30 minutes.Carefully uncover and grate Parmesan all over gratin, then evenly top with panko. Return to top rack and bake, uncovered, until golden brown, 5-8 minutes more.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably ovenproof, pan (large, preferably ovenproof, pan for 4 servings) over medium heat. Add shallot, potatoes, and carrots; season with half the Old Bay Seasoning (you’ll use more in Step 4), salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, until veggies are browned and slightly tender, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) to pan with veggies. Once melted, stir in flour; cook for 1 minute. instructions_json.title: Step 3

title: Tomato, Bacon, Mozz & Creamy Pesto Panini
subtitle: with Arugula Salad & Dijon Vinaigrette

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Drop cream cheese packets in a glass of warm water to soften. Wash and dry produce. Thinly slice tomato into rounds. Thinly slice mozzarella into rounds.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, whisk together cream cheese and pesto.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Arrange half the sourdough slices on a clean work surface. Spread with creamy pesto. Layer with tomato and mozzarella; season with pepper. Close sandwiches.

instructions_json.title: While pasta cooks, wash and dry produce

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

title: Calzone Snake with Pepperoni
subtitle: plus Ranch Salad & Marinara

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on oiled sheet to coat all over (divide dough between two sheets for 4). Arrange on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, open package of pepperoni. Cut one slice of pepperoni into two equal-size triangles (these will be the snake’s eyes). (For 4 servings, cut two slices of pepperoni into four equal-size triangles.) From a second slice of pepperoni, cut one long triangle with sides longer than the base, then cut from the tip of that triangle down the center, stopping halfway (this will be the snake’s tongue). (For 4, cut two long triangles.)

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently roll and stretch each dough ball into a long, flat strip, about 3-4 inches wide and 10-12 inches long. Overlap strips by 1-2 inches and press to seal, making one long strip. (Make two long strips for 4 servings.) Arrange on sheet in an S-shaped curve. Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make the next step easier).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, layer half the marinara, remaining pepperoni, and mozzarella in center of dough, leaving at least ½ inch exposed on either side. Starting at one end, carefully pull up sides of dough and pinch seams together to seal. Drizzle baking sheet with olive oil, then gently roll stuffed dough so seam side faces down. Tuck ends underneath.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Gently roll one end of dough back and forth to make a “tail.” At the opposite “head” end, press both thumbs into the side to make eyes, then gently pinch the end to form a snout. Place the two equal-size pepperoni triangles in the eyes. Poke a small hole in the snout and insert the remaining pepperoni triangle for the tongue. TIP: If you’d like to add scales, use a sharp knife to gently cut crosshatches on the body of the snake, being careful not to cut all the way through the dough. Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes. (For 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: When calzone has about 5 minutes remaining, in a large bowl, toss mixed greens with half the dressing. Slice calzone snake into pieces. Divide between plates and serve with salad, remaining dressing, and remaining marinara on the side.

title: Zucchini & Tomato Calzones
subtitle: with Lemon-Basil Ricotta & Marinara

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Sprinkle flour over a clean work surface (reserve a little for dusting your hands in both this step and Step 4). Remove pizza dough from packaging and place on floured surface. Shape each piece of dough into a ball. TIP: Dust your hands with flour to prevent sticking. Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: While dough rests, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, wash and dry produce. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Zest and quarter lemon (for 4 servings, zest one lemon and quarter both).

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and tomatoes and cook, stirring, until zucchini is lightly browned and softened and tomatoes are broken down, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat; stir in garlic. In a small bowl, combine ricotta, half the lemon zest, basil paste, and lemon juice to taste. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, line a baking sheet (two sheets for 4 servings) with parchment paper. Carefully press and stretch each dough ball into a rough oval shape and place on one side of prepared sheet (you’ll have two dough ovals per baking sheet). TIP: If needed, use a rolling pin to help roll out dough. Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 15 minutes more (this will make stretching the dough into a larger shape even easier!).

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 15 minutes, use floured hands to press and stretch dough on baking sheet into larger circle shapes, 8-10 inches wide. Evenly spread lemon-basil ricotta over half of each piece of dough. Top with zucchini mixture. Fold empty half of dough over filling to form calzones; crimp edges to seal. Brush each calzone with 1 tsp oil, then use a knife to make a small slit in the top of each. Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes (for 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, swapping rack positions halfway through).

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Let calzones cool slightly, 3-4 minutes, then divide between plates. Serve with marinara on the side for dipping.

title: Cheesy Mushroom & Bacon Stromboli
subtitle: with Spinach & Marinara Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Let pizza dough come to room temperature (in its package) until ready to use in Step 3.Wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and slightly crispy, 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.Add another drizzle of oil, then stir in spinach (you may need to add spinach in batches). Cook, stirring, until spinach is slightly wilted, 1-2 minutes. Add garlic and half the Italian Seasoning (all for 4 servings). Cook, stirring, until spinach is fully wilted and garlic is fragrant, 1-2 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.Transfer to a medium bowl; let cool slightly.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While veggies cool, place ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave 30 seconds, or until melted.Remove pizza dough from package; cut in half and place on an oiled baking sheet. Using your hands, gently stretch each piece into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle. (For 4, assemble the first two strombolis before starting on the second two so they all fit on the same baking sheet.) TIP: It helps to stretch the dough on the baking sheet. If dough keeps retracting, let rest for a few minutes.TIP: If dough keeps retracting, allow to rest for a few minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Spread mozzarella evenly across each piece of dough, leaving a ½-inch empty border around all sides. Top with veggies (draining first if needed) and Parmesan.Gently roll up each dough rectangle, starting with one of the short sides, to form a log. Arrange strombolis on sheet seam sides down; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath.Brush strombolis with melted butter and sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Wash out bowl used for butter.Bake on middle rack until deep golden brown and crisp, 14-16 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When strombolis are almost done, place marinara in bowl used for butter; cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave until sauce is warmed through, 30-45 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Transfer strombolis to a cutting board and slice crosswise into quarters.Divide between plates. Serve with warm marinara on the side for dipping.

title: Salami & Sun-Dried Tomato Strombolis
subtitle: with Marinara & Mixed Greens Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Lightly coat a baking sheet (two baking sheets for 4) with a drizzle of olive oil. Remove pizza dough from packaging and roll dough balls on sheet to coat all over. Arrange dough balls on sheet at least 3 inches apart and cover with a clean kitchen towel; let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While dough rests, roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes until they are about the same size as the salami.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 20 minutes, gently press and stretch each dough ball into a 6-by-8-inch rectangle (the dough is stretchy and the shapes won’t be perfect—that’s OK!). Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest 12 minutes more (this will make the next step easier!).

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once dough has rested 12 minutes, evenly sprinkle each dough rectangle with Italian cheese blend, sun-dried tomatoes, and salami (add some freshly cracked black pepper if you have it!), leaving a ½-inch border around edges. Starting with one of the long sides, gently fold up a 1- to 2-inch portion of one of the dough rectangles. Repeat 2-3 times until dough forms a log. Arrange stromboli, seam sides down, on baking sheet; pinch ends to close and tuck underneath. Repeat with remaining dough rectangle.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: With a sharp knife, gently cut three small, shallow diagonal slits along the top of each stromboli. Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 18-22 minutes (for 4 servings, bake on middle and top racks, switching rack positions halfway through).

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: While strombolis bake, trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Once strombolis are done, remove from oven and let rest at least 2 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss mixed greens and cucumber with as much dressing as you like; season with salt and pepper. Halve strombolis crosswise and divide between plates. Serve with salad and marinara for dipping on the side.

title: Melty Mozzarella–Stuffed Arancini Board
subtitle: with Marinara & Garlic Aioli | 2–4 servings

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bring cream cheese to room temperature. In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water, half the stock concentrates, half the Tuscan Heat Spice, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer; cover and cook until tender, 15-18 minutes. Transfer rice to a large bowl. Spread out in an even layer up the sides of the bowl. Place bowl in the refrigerator or freezer until cooled, 5-10 minutes.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pick parsley leaves from stems; finely chop leaves. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Dice mozzarella into ½-inch pieces (10-12 pieces total). In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, 1 tsp water, a pinch of parsley, salt, pepper, and as much garlic as you like.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Melt 2 TBSP butter in a medium pan over medium heat. Add panko and toast, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: To bowl with cooled rice, add softened cream cheese, cornstarch, flour, remaining stock concentrate, remaining Tuscan Heat Spice, ¼ cup toasted panko, and 1 tsp salt. Mix until thoroughly combined.

instructions_json.title: Form rice mixture into 10-12 1½-inch balls
instructions_json.body: Form rice mixture into 10-12 1½-inch balls. Using your thumb, make a deep indentation in each ball. Divide mozzarella pieces between the centers of each ball, then pinch closed around cheese. Roll arancini in bowl with remaining toasted panko until evenly coated.

instructions_json.title: Arrange arancini on a baking sheet
instructions_json.body: Arrange arancini on a baking sheet. Bake on top rack until lightly browned and warmed through, 15-18 minutes. (It’s ok if some cheese leaks out!) AIR FRYER ALTERNATIVE: Coat an air fryer basket with cooking spray; arrange arancini side by side in basket. Coat tops of arancini with cooking spray. Air fry at 375 degrees until golden brown, turning halfway through, 15-20 minutes. Work in batches if necessary.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Place marinara in a second small microwave-safe bowl; cover with plastic wrap. Microwave until warmed through, about 30 seconds. Arrange arancini on a serving platter or board with bowls of marinara and aioli on the side for dipping. Garnish arancini and sauces with remaining parsley and serve family style.

title: Crispy Organic Chicken & Bacon Alfredo
subtitle: with Spinach, Parmesan & Chives

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Wash and dry produce.Mince chives.Place 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until melted, 30 seconds. Stir in panko, half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest later), and a large drizzle of oil. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Place on prepared baking sheet. Evenly spread a thin layer of sour cream onto tops of chicken (you may have some left over). Mound coated sides with panko mixture, pressing to adhere (no need to coat the undersides).Roast on middle rack until crust is golden brown and chicken is cooked through, 18-22 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve 1½ cups pasta cooking water (2 cups for 4 servings), then drain. (Keep empty pot handy for Step 5.)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. Add bacon*; cook, turning occasionally and adjusting heat if browning too quickly, until crispy, 6-10 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate. Once cool enough to handle, chop into small pieces.Let pan with bacon fat cool slightly, then carefully add spinach. (TIP: Allowing the pan to cool will help prevent splattering.) Cook over medium heat, stirring, until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once pasta and bacon are done, return empty pot used for pasta to stovetop over medium heat. Add cheese roux, remaining garlic powder and 1 cup reserved pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4); whisk to combine. Cook, whisking, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.Reduce heat to medium low and whisk in cream cheese until melted and combined.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add drained spaghetti, Parmesan, half the chives, and 2 TBSP butter (3 TBSP for 4 servings) to pot with Alfredo sauce. Cook, stirring, until butter has melted and pasta is coated in a creamy sauce.Stir in bacon and spinach. (TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time.) Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between plates. Top with chicken. Garnish with remaining chives and serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Place your hand on top of the chicken breast. Slice into the middle of the meat (parallel to the cutting board). Open up like a book, then cover with a piece of plastic wrap. Pound with a heavy pan or mallet until ½-inch thick. Repeat with the other chicken breasts. Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Set aside ¼ cup flour. Coat the chicken on all sides with the remaining flour, shaking of any excess. Heat a large drizzle of oil in another large pan over medium-high heat. Working in batches, if necessary, sear the chicken 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from pan and set aside to rest, tented loosely with foil.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Zest 1 tsp zest from lemon, then halve. instructions_json.body: Once water boils, add tagliatelle to pot. Cook until just tender, about 2 minutes. Scoop out and reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water, then drain. instructions_json.title: Step 6

title: Make-Ahead Overnight Oats Three Ways
subtitle: with Apple Compote, Coconut Crunch, Peach Cream & Apricots

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: • In a large bowl, whisk together three packets of crème fraîche, half the cinnamon, ¼ cup white sugar, and a pinch of salt (six packets of crème fraîche and ½ cup white sugar for 12 servings). (TIP: Add more sugar for sweeter oatmeal.) Whisk in 3 cups water (6 cups for 12) until no lumps remain. Stir in oats and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight until oats are tender. TIP: Divide oats between 6 jars (12 jars for 12) for an easy grab-and-go breakfast!

instructions_json.title: • Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: • Wash and dry produce. Peel, core, and dice apple into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: • Melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 12 servings) in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add almonds, coconut, 2 TBSP white sugar (4 TBSP for 12), and a pinch of salt; toast until golden, 2-3 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a small bowl. Wipe out pot.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: • Melt 1 TBSP butter in same pot over medium heat. Add apple and remaining cinnamon; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1 minute.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: • Add brown sugar, ½ cup water, 1 TBSP white sugar, and a pinch of salt (¾ cup water and 2 TBSP white sugar for 12 servings); stir to combine. Cook, covered, until apple is tender, 5-7 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: • Uncover pot and increase heat to medium-high. Cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is thickened and syrupy, 3-5 minutes more. Transfer to a second small bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: • While apple cooks, in a third small bowl, mix peach jam and remaining crème fraîche until smooth.

instructions_json.title: Step 8
instructions_json.body: • Tightly cover apple compote and peach cream with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. Store coconut almond crunch in an airtight container.

instructions_json.title: Step 9
instructions_json.body: • When ready to eat, divide overnight oats between bowls. Top with apricots, apple compote, coconut crunch, and peach cream as desired. TIP: Microwave compote for 30 seconds if you like!

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Open package of duck* and drain off any excess liquid. Pat dry with paper towels, then place, skin sides up, on a baking sheet. instructions_json.title: Step 5

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4); season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While potatoes cook, trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

title: Prosciutto Organic Chicken
subtitle: with Cherry Gastrique, Roasted Carrots & Green Beans

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to middle and top positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch-thick pieces. Trim green beans if necessary. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; finely mince whites.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss carrots on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on middle rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season all over with pepper (prosciutto is salty and will season the chicken as they cook together!).On a clean work surface, lay two slices of prosciutto side by side. Place one chicken cutlet along bottom of slices. Tightly roll prosciutto up around chicken. Repeat with remaining prosciutto and chicken.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add wrapped chicken; sear until browned and crispy, 2-3 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to one side of a second baking sheet. Wipe out pan.Add green beans to empty side of sheet and toss with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper.Roast on top rack until chicken is cooked through and green beans are browned and tender, 15-18 minutes. Transfer chicken to a cutting board.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: When chicken has 6 minutes remaining, add brown sugar in a single layer to pan used for chicken and heat over medium-high heat. Leave undisturbed to melt. Once brown sugar has melted, remove pan from heat; carefully add scallion whites, cherries, vinegar, stock concentrate, ½ cup water, and 1 TBSP butter (¾ cup water and 2 TBSP butter for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Return gastrique mixture to medium-high heat; stir, scraping up caramelized sugar from bottom of pan (this will become easier as the liquid heats up!). Cook, stirring and gently scraping constantly, until sugar has completely dissolved. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until syrupy, 2-4 minutes more (don't reduce too much; it will keep thickening as it cools!).Turn off heat; stir in scallion greens and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Slice chicken crosswise
instructions_json.body: Slice chicken crosswise.Divide chicken, carrots, and green beans between plates. Spoon cherry gastrique over chicken and serve.

title: Sweet & Smoky Sirloin Steak
subtitle: with Chili Roasted Carrots, Mashed Potatoes & Cherry Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Peel and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch pieces.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces; place in a large pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid, then drain and return potatoes to pot.Keep covered off heat until ready to mash.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, toss carrots on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, spread across entire sheet.) Roast on middle rack for 5 minutes (you’ll add more to the sheet then).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Pat pork* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels. Rub with a drizzle of olive oil; season with salt and pepper.In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine paprika and cinnamon. Rub 1¾ tsp spice mixture (3½ tsp for 4 servings) over pork.Once carrots have roasted 5 minutes, remove sheet from oven. Carefully place pork on empty side. (For 4, add pork to a second sheet and roast on top rack.) Return to middle rack and roast until pork is cooked through, 18-20 minutes more. Transfer pork to a cutting board.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While pork roasts, add jam and 1 tsp vinegar (1½ tsp for 4 servings) to bowl with remaining spice mixture; stir to combine. (Be sure to measure the vinegar—we sent more!) appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Mash drained potatoes with sour cream and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until smooth and creamy, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed.Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Slice pork crosswise
instructions_json.body: Slice pork crosswise.Toss carrots with a pinch of chili flakes to taste.Divide pork, mashed potatoes, and carrots between plates. Drizzle sauce over pork and serve.

Pull sides of shell apart to expose meat (do not remove meat from shell).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

Place on one side of a second baking sheet.

instructions_json.title: Step 4

instructions_json.title: Step 5

Add steak and cook until browned and cooked to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side.Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest at least 5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine shallot, vinegar, demi-glace, ½ tsp thyme, and ½ cup water (1 tsp thyme and 1 cup water for 4 servings).Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium high, whisking occasionally, until reduced to about 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4), 7-8 minutes.Remove from heat. Whisk in reserved butter one piece at a time until sauce is creamy. TIP: Return pot to low heat to melt butter.Whisk in crème fraîche. Stir in half the chives.

title: Thai Ginger-Poached Chicken & Crispy Garlic Rice
subtitle: with Spicy Cucumber Pickles & Scallion Broth

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Pat chicken* dry with paper towels. Using a sharp knife, at each of the leg joints, carefully make 1-inch cuts through the skin just into the meat (don’t cut through!). Place chicken, skin side up, in a medium pot (large pot for 4 servings) with enough water to cover by 2 inches.Thinly slice ginger crosswise. (TIP: It doesn’t need to be perfect and no need to peel; you’ll just use it to season the poaching liquid.) Add to pot with chicken along with half the soy sauce.Cover pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium; simmer, covered, until chicken is cooked through, 20-30 minutes.Transfer chicken to a cutting board; season with salt and pepper. Tent with foil to keep warm; set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While chicken cooks, in a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.While rice cooks, peel and mince garlic. Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Quarter lime. Thinly slice chili, removing seeds for less heat. Trim and cut scallions into 2-inch batons. Roughly chop cilantro. Roughly chop peanuts.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat 2 tsp oil (4 tsp for 4 servings) in a small pan over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook until browned and crispy, 1-2 minutes. TIP: Tilt pan to pool the oil and submerge the garlic so it browns evenly. Watch carefully as it can burn quickly! The garlic will continue to brown and crisp once removed from the oil, so remove from pan a bit earlier than you think.Transfer crispy garlic to a paper-towel-lined plate; set aside until ready to use in Step 6. Reserve garlic oil in a small heatproof bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine cucumbers, half the chili, 1 tsp sugar, and ½ tsp salt (2 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt for 4 servings), and a squeeze of lime juice. Refrigerate until ready to serve.To bowl with reserved garlic oil, add garlic-ginger scallion paste, remaining chili, and remaining soy sauce. Stir and set aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once chicken is cooked, reserve 2 cups poaching liquid (4 cups for 4 servings); strain ginger and discard. Return reserved liquid to pot used for chicken.Bring liquid to a boil over high heat. Add scallions and stock concentrate; cover and cook until scallions are tender, 5-8 minutes.Add half the cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice (big squeeze for 4); taste and season with salt and pepper. Divide broth between bowls.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: To pot with rice, add crispy garlic and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4); fluff with a fork.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Divide rice, chicken, and spicy cucumber pickles (draining first) between plates in separate sections. Top chicken with as much sauce as you like. Sprinkle with peanuts, crispy fried onions, and remaining cilantro. Serve with scallion broth and remaining lime wedges on the side.TIP: Carve the chicken using your sharpest knife (use a carving knife if you have one!). First, cut the skin near the thigh to expose the joint. Cut through the joint, removing the leg from the carcass. Cut the joint between the thigh and drumstick, separating the two. (Use the heel of your blade—near the handle—for the most force and stability.) Cut off the wing. Then, starting at the neck end, cut along the breastbone. Angle your knife and cut against the rib cage to remove the breast. Slice breast meat crosswise.
